5c2a82fc.description:
At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.
  
  
For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off-the-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.
  
  
Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.

**Title** : Sr Technical Program Manager

**Reporting to:** Sr Manager, Enterprise PMO
  
**Location** : Bangalore, India

**Department** : Program Management Office (PMO)

  
  

**Purpose**
-----------

Lead complex digital platform initiatives across the organization by driving cross-functional coordination, technical program execution, and operational excellence. Partner with engineering, marketing, design, and IT teams to deliver scalable, high-performing web experiences and digital infrastructure aligned to business priorities.

  
  

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Lead end-to-end execution of digital platform and web infrastructure programs across multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Drive alignment between business priorities, technical implementation, and delivery timelines to ensure successful execution of web initiatives.
* Partner with engineering, marketing, design, analytics, and IT teams to coordinate dependencies, manage risks, and remove blockers.
* Own program planning activities including roadmap coordination, prioritization, milestone tracking, and status reporting.
* Facilitate agile program execution through sprint planning support, backlog coordination, release tracking, and delivery governance.
* Establish and maintain program management best practices, documentation standards, communication cadences, and operational processes.
* Support optimization and governance of the CMS and related digital tooling ecosystem.
* Monitor and report on key performance indicators including uptime, site performance, accessibility compliance, release health, and conversion metrics.
* Identify opportunities to improve scalability, efficiency, and delivery quality across digital programs and workflows.
* Influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders without direct authority to achieve program objectives and organizational outcomes.
  

  

**Required Experience**
-----------------------

* 7+ years of experience in technical program management, digital program management, or related technical delivery roles.
* Experience leading large-scale cross-functional digital or web platform initiatives in complex environments.
* Strong understanding of web development lifecycles, agile methodologies, and release management practices.
* Experience working with CMS platforms such as Drupal, WordPress, Sitecore, or equivalent technologies.
* Proven ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive execution across technical and non-technical teams.
* Experience with digital analytics, SEO tools, accessibility standards, and website performance optimization.
* Strong communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience partnering closely with engineering and product organizations in SaaS or enterprise environments.
* Familiarity with modern web architectures, APIs, CI/CD processes, and cloud-based digital platforms.

We'll tell you when AI is encouraged throughout the selection process. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles.

Quickbase is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply – even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

f6225bb0.title: Membership Engagement Manager - India / EU
f6225bb0.description:
**Membership Engagement Manager**
**Location**
: India / EU
  
  
**About TM Forum**
TM Forum is an association of more than 850 member companies, which include the world’s top 10 network and communications providers and spans 180 countries. Our members tap into each other’s collective experiences and abilities to collaboratively solve complex industry-wide challenges, deploy new services, and create technology breakthroughs to accelerate change. We help communications service providers (CSPs) and their suppliers to digitally transform and thrive in the digital era. We do this by providing an open, collaborative environment and practical support that enable CSPs and suppliers to rapidly transform their business operations, IT systems, and ecosystems to capitalise on the opportunities presented in a rapidly evolving digital world.
  
  
You can learn more at www.tmforum.org
  
  
Our vision is to drive the next wave of digital business growth – the digitisation of every industry by providing a common innovation platform that connects businesses, industries, and ecosystems. We do this in a highly practical and agile way through collaboration programs and communities that lead to rapid prototypes, ranging from digital business models to interconnectivity APIs that lead to real world commercial applications. Complementing our collaboration programs, the Forum provides thought-provoking digital business research and publications, industry best practices and standards as well as training programs designed to accelerate adoption. We also deliver events and workshops that bring together leading business & IT executives to learn, network, and develop meaningful partnerships.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Meet or exceed the revenue targets for sales of member renewals (primary focus), support the sale of TM Forum services and programmes, including training, coaching, tools, conformance, and certifications and new memberships (secondary focus) – this is primarily an account management role focusing on member retention and services sales within those members. There is some scope for new member acquisition but that is not the primary function of this role.
* Primary focus on the India market (a mix of CSP’s, Global Systems Integration firms and technology vendors), with select account responsibilities extending beyond the region (i.e. global accounts).
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified sales opportunities in line with regional targets.
* Manage member renewals and engagement across named accounts. Maintain accurate Salesforce records and reporting to support effective pipeline management and forecasting.
* Broaden and deepen relationships with existing members through effective communication, face-to-face meetings, calls, and targeted use of marketing collateral.
* Raise the profile of TM Forum through active participation in relevant industry conferences and events.
* Work closely with regional teams, Engagement Managers, and colleagues to share best practices, support account development, and deliver consistent member experiences.
* Support the Global Research & Media and Events Sales Teams to unlock opportunities in existing members and beyond.
* Work closely with our Program Management, Marketing and Sales Enablement teams to ensure the voice of the members is clearly understood and reflected in our value propositions, marketing positioning, and collateral.
* Create and maintain accurate and comprehensive opportunity records, ensuring the organisation can effectively forecast revenue volume and timing.
* Develop a strong understanding of the telecommunications and technology landscape, staying abreast of industry trends and emerging challenges to become a trusted advisor to members and identify new opportunities for TM Forum.

**Experience And Requirements**

* Working experience in the telecoms industry is essential.
* Previous account management and sales experience is essential, with the ability to build trusted relationships, identify opportunities for growth, and manage a sales pipeline effectively – this is not an entry level role.
* Familiarity with the digital economy is advantageous. Experience of the Indian market and the wider telecommunications ecosystem is essential.
* Results-oriented, highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining a strong focus on outcomes.
* A customer-focused individual who can understand member needs and develop appropriate solutions that deliver value.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and organisational skills, with the ability to engage confidently with stakeholders at all levels and collaborate effectively across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
* Excellent digital and analytical skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint, and the ability to work confidently with CRM, reporting and business support systems.
* Experience of structured sales processes, with working knowledge of Salesforce or similar CRM platforms and other business intelligence platforms being advantageous.
* Self-disciplined, proactive, and able to work independently while contributing as part of a close-knit and highly collaborative team.
* Curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning. This role offers the opportunity to develop deep expertise in the telecommunications industry, TM Forum's frameworks and programmes, and the challenges facing our members. The successful candidate will be willing to invest time in building this knowledge and expertise.
* Comfortable working within a small, geographically distributed regional team. Success in the role requires proactive collaboration, knowledge sharing, and a willingness to learn from experienced colleagues across different markets and areas of expertise.

**Diversity & Inclusion at TM Forum**
*At TM Forum, we’re building a workplace where everyone can belong, feel respected, supported and able to do their best work. We welcome talent from all walks of life to join our global community, which is made stronger by the different perspectives, backgrounds and experiences each person brings. We hire based on skills, potential and values, never on assumptions about who someone is or where they come from. We actively work to ensure our recruitment and people practices are fair, inclusive and free from bias.*
We are a global alliance of 800+ organizations across the connectivity ecosystem. Members include the top 10 Communication Service Providers, top three hyperscalers, and a wide range of vendors, consultancies, and system integrators.
  
  
Together, we are building a sustainable future for the sector in connectivity and beyond

8e81adbf.title: SharePoint Architect – Financial Services (Bangalore)
8e81adbf.description:
We are calling on behalf of a Software Solutions company headquartered in East Brunswick, NJ. Incorporated in 2003, It provides solutions across GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare Provider and Oracle to customers globally.

**Job Title: SharePoint Architect – Financial Services Location: Bangalore**
, India Work Timing: US Business Hours Experience: 10+ Years Overall | 6+ Years SharePoint / Microsoft 365 Engagement Type: Long-term Contract or Full-Time

**Position Summary**
We are seeking a senior SharePoint Architect to lead enterprise-scale SharePoint and Microsoft 365 initiatives in a BFSI environment. The role owns platform strategy, future-state architecture, modernization, governance, business analysis, and delivery across SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Power Platform, RPA, and AI-enabled collaboration solutions. The architect will advise senior stakeholders and lead onshore/offshore teams supporting investment, operations, and portfolio functions. The ideal candidate combines deep SharePoint/M365 architecture expertise with an AI-first mindset, including practical exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Bots, Claude AI / Claude Code, multi-skill/multi-agent models, MCP, and Microsoft Power Platform AI capabilities.

Key Responsibilities SharePoint / Microsoft 365 Architecture & Modernization Own the SharePoint / Microsoft 365 platform roadmap and define scalable future-state architecture across SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, and Power Platform. Lead enterprise modernization and migration from legacy SharePoint environments to SharePoint Online, establishing architecture standards, governance, security, information architecture, and platform best practices. Partner with business and IT leaders using deep business analysis skills to understand new problem statements, map current/future processes, identify automation opportunities, and translate requirements into scalable solutions; guide and mentor distributed onshore/offshore delivery teams.

AI-First & Agentic Microsoft 365 Solutions Drive an AI-first development approach by embedding LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, conversational Bots, intelligent search, and AI-assisted workflows directly into SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and enterprise solutions. Leverage Claude AI / Claude Code and similar LLM platforms for multi-skill/multi-agent approaches across requirements, architecture, development, testing, documentation, modernization, and support. Apply Model Context Protocol (MCP) to securely connect AI models/agents with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, APIs, enterprise data, applications, and development tools for end-to-end software solution development. Apply enterprise security, data protection, grounding, guardrails, observability, human oversight, and Responsible AI practices for AI-enabled solutions, particularly within regulated financial-services environments. Business Analysis, Power Platform, RPA & Intelligent Automation Architect new end-to-end business flows and RPAs using Power Apps and Power Automate, from problem discovery and process analysis through solution design, automation, integration, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement. Provide hands-on architectural exposure to AI Hub in Power Automate, including AI prompts, AI models / AI Builder, and document intelligence capabilities for document extraction, classification, processing, workflow automation, and AI-enabled business scenarios. Identify opportunities to combine Power Automate, AI Builder/Document Intelligence, LLMs, agents, and enterprise data to modernize manual and legacy workflows. Assess and migrate existing RPAs/workflows built using competitive tools such as Alteryx, Automation Anywhere, and UiPath into Power Automate while preserving business controls, reliability, auditability, and operational continuity.

Governance, Security & Leadership Establish platform governance, security, lifecycle management, development standards, reusable patterns, and adoption practices across SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Power Platform, and AI-enabled solutions. Stay current with the Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Copilot/AI, and broader AI technology roadmaps; evaluate emerging capabilities and advise leadership on adoption, architecture, risk, and business value. Provide architecture reviews, technical direction, mentoring, stakeholder communication, and delivery governance in fast-paced, high-visibility enterprise programs.

Required Qualifications Bachelor's/master's degree in computer science, Engineering, IT, or related discipline with 10+ years overall experience and 6+ years of strong SharePoint / Microsoft 365 experience. Strong hands-on expertise in SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365, Teams, OneDrive, Power Apps, and Power Automate, with proven experience leading enterprise SharePoint programs, modernization initiatives, platform roadmaps, future-state architecture, and automation/RPA delivery. Practical exposure to AI-first application development using LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Bots, Claude AI / Claude Code, multi-skill/multi-agent models, and MCP-based enterprise integration. Exposure to Power Automate AI Hub capabilities including AI prompts, AI models / AI Builder, and document intelligence; ability to identify and architect practical AI-enabled automation scenarios. Deep business analysis and process-engineering capability to understand ambiguous/new problem statements, conduct discovery, map processes, define requirements, and design brand-new flows/RPAs. Experience assessing and migrating automations from Alteryx, Automation Anywhere, UiPath, or similar platforms to Power Automate. Strong governance, security, stakeholder management, communication, and distributed/offshore leadership skills; BFSI or regulated-industry experience strongly preferred.

Technical Skills SharePoint Online, M365, Teams, OneDrive | Power Apps/Automate, AI Hub, AI Prompts, AI Builder, Document Intelligence | Business Analysis, Process Mapping, RPA Design & Migration (Alteryx/Automation Anywhere/UiPath to Power Automate) | LLMs, RAG, Agents, Bots, Claude AI/Claude Code, MCP, Multi-Agent/Multi-Skill Orchestration | Architecture, Governance, Security, Integration.

Core Competencies SharePoint/M365 Architecture • Business Analysis & Process Discovery • New Flow/RPA Design • RPA Migration to Power Automate • AI-First/Agentic Solutions • Claude AI & MCP • Power Platform/AI Hub • Governance & Security • BFSI • Stakeholder & Distributed-Team Leadership.

We are looking for an AI-forward
**Customer Success & Implementation Lead**
to manage the complete post-sales journey for our enterprise customers—from contract handover and implementation to adoption, retention, and growth.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the Implementation and Onboarding team, drive successful enterprise deployments, and build scalable customer success processes. You will also use AI-powered development tools to prototype client requirements, automate workflows, analyse technical issues, and accelerate integrations without being completely dependent on the core engineering team.
  
  
**What will you do at Fynd?**
**Lead Implementation and Delivery**

* Lead and mentor a team of Implementation Managers and Onboarding Specialists.
* Own key implementation metrics, including time-to-go-live, catalog migration, deployment success, and user adoption.
* Manage the complete handover process from Sales to Implementation and Customer Success.
* Oversee the integration of store locations, ERPs, marketplaces, inventory systems, and supply chain workflows.
* Identify implementation risks, resolve delivery bottlenecks, and ensure projects are completed within committed timelines.
* Build scalable playbooks for onboarding, system configuration, customer training, escalation management, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).

**Drive AI-Assisted Technical Solutions**

* Use AI development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Bolt, Lovable, or similar platforms to build functional prototypes, front-end mock-ups, and custom widgets.
* Demonstrate client-specific use cases and Fynd API capabilities through working prototypes.
* Build scripts or lightweight applications to clean and transform retail catalog data, automate customer health scores, and improve onboarding workflows.
* Analyse API logs, JSON payloads, client-side code, and integration issues to identify potential root causes.
* Translate business and technical challenges into clear, actionable specifications for Product and Engineering teams.
* Use AI tools to reduce dependency on engineering teams for routine technical tasks and accelerate customer resolution timelines.

**Own Customer Retention and Growth**

* Build trusted relationships with CXOs, founders, e-commerce leaders, and senior stakeholders across enterprise accounts.
* Act as a strategic advisor and help customers achieve measurable business outcomes through Fynd’s solutions.
* Partner with Account Management and Sales teams to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities across Fynd’s product portfolio.
* Own key commercial and customer success metrics, including renewals, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), adoption, and customer health.
* Conduct regular business reviews and proactively address risks that could affect customer satisfaction or retention.
* Consolidate customer feedback and share actionable insights with Product and Engineering teams to influence the product roadmap.

**What We're Looking For**

* 6–10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Enterprise Implementation, Technical Account Management, or a related role.
* At least 2 years of experience leading an implementation, onboarding, customer success, or engineering-adjacent team.
* Strong experience in Retail Technology, E-commerce, Omnichannel Commerce, Order Management Systems, logistics, or supply chain platforms.
* Understanding of how storefronts, warehouses, ERPs, marketplaces, inventory systems, and physical stores work together.
* Hands-on experience using AI development tools to create functional code, prototypes, scripts, automations, or internal applications.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads, databases, and basic data transformation.
* Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with experience managing complex enterprise implementations.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience managing senior stakeholders, including CXOs, founders, and e-commerce leaders.
* A metrics-driven approach with a proven record of improving onboarding timelines, customer adoption, retention, or NRR.
* Strong ownership, problem-solving, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**What do we offer?**
**Growth**
At Fynd, growth is limitless. We nurture a culture that encourages innovation, embraces challenges, and supports continuous learning. As we expand into new product lines and global markets, we’re seeking talented individuals eager to grow with us.
  
  
We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, lead with confidence, and shape their careers.
  
  

* Learning Wallet: Enrol in external courses or certifications to upskill—we’ll reimburse the costs to support your development.

**Culture**
We believe in building strong teams and lasting connections.
  
  

* Regular community engagement and team-building activities
* Biannual events to celebrate achievements, foster collaboration, and strengthen our workplace culture

**Wellness**
Your well-being is our priority. Comprehensive Mediclaim policy for you, your spouse, children, and parents
  
  
**Work Environment**
We thrive on collaboration and creativity. Our teams work from the office five days a week to encourage open communication, teamwork, and innovation.
  
  
Join us to be part of a dynamic environment where your ideas make an impact!

**Knowledge And Skills**

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

* Mentor and inspire a high-performing organization of Project Managers, Scrum Masters, Tech Leads, and Software Engineers (onshore, offshore, and hybrid), cultivating a culture of psychological safety, accountability, continuous upskilling (including AI-assisted engineering tools like Copilot), and innovation

* 14 to 18 years of overall IT industry experience
* 6+ years in an IT Delivery Manager, Program Manager, or Delivery Director role overseeing multiple concurrent software development teams
* Proven record of successfully managing enterprise portfolios with budgets exceeding $5M+ and teams of 50+ engineers
* Background in software engineering, with hands-on experience across Java (Spring frameworks, Spring Boot, J2EE legacy) and/or .NET (C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core)

* Proficiency in scaling Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) across distributed engineering teams
* Competency in CI/CD, DevSecOps practices, and automated testing frameworks
* Skills in vendor management, SOW negotiation, and executive stakeholder engagement

**Nice to have**

* Background in collaborating with Enterprise Architects on cloud-native migration strategies

e91c7ffc.title: SaaS Solution Consultant: Construction Technology
e91c7ffc.description:
Bildwell Solution Consultant

Solution Consultant – SaaS | ConstructionTech / PropTech

Location: Gurgaon | Experience: 3–6 years | Compensation: ₹4.8–6.0 LPA + Incentives

Industry: ConstructionTech / PropTech / Construction ERP / B2B SaaS preferred

**ABOUT BILDWELL**

Bildwell is a ConstructionTech SaaS platform that helps contractors and construction businesses improve project visibility, BOQ management, quantity and material planning, procurement control, execution discipline and project cost visibility. It connects commercial, technical, procurement and execution workflows so businesses can move from fragmented spreadsheets to structured, data-driven project operations.

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a Solution Consultant who understands construction workflows, diagnoses a customer's business problem, turns it into a relevant use case and shows how Bildwell creates measurable business value. This is a consultative pre-sales role, not a scripted product-demo position.

You will discuss drawings, specifications, BOQs, quantities, estimation, materials, procurement, contracts, execution and cost control with contractors, architects, quantity surveyors, procurement teams, project teams and business owners. The objective is to bridge Construction Domain → Business Problem → Technology Solution, and to understand not just what a customer wants, but why a design, quantity or procurement workflow exists and how Bildwell should be applied to it.

**QUALIFICATION**

Preferred: M.Tech / M.E. in Civil Engineering or M.Arch, with a specialisation in Construction Engineering & Management, Construction Technology & Management, Quantity Surveying, Contracts & Cost Management, Building Engineering & Management / Building Technology, Infrastructure Management, Construction Project Management, Construction Economics, Project Planning & Controls, Estimation & Cost Engineering, Materials & Procurement Management, or Architectural Project Management.

B.Tech / B.E. (Civil) or B.Arch candidates with strong experience in Quantity Surveying, Estimation, Contracts, Procurement, Cost Control, Construction Project Management, Design Coordination, Tender Documentation or PMC may also be considered. Technical grounding matters: you must hold credible discussions with construction professionals, not operate as a generic SaaS salesperson.

**DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE EXPECTED (several of the following)**

- Reading architectural, structural and MEP drawings; quantity take-off from drawings

- BOQ preparation, interpretation, measurement and quantity reconciliation

- Estimation, costing, rate analysis, budget vs actual quantities

- Specifications and finishing schedules; how design revisions change quantities, materials and cost

- BOQ-to-BOM, material planning, consumption and reconciliation

- Procurement: requisitions, RFQs, quotations, technical and commercial comparison, POs, GRN, inspection, vendor management

- Contracts, tendering, project planning, site execution, progress measurement and contractor bill certification

- Contractor / subcontractor management and project cost control

You need not have worked in every area, but you must learn quickly and stay credible with construction professionals.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Understand how customers currently manage BOQs, quantities, materials, procurement, execution, subcontractors, progress and cost control, and where the operational or commercial pain sits.

- Work through the chain BOQ → Quantity → Material Requirement → Procurement → Consumption → Progress → Cost, and where it breaks for each customer.

- Build customer-specific use cases and solution narratives from real construction and business requirements.

- Run customised demos and simulations using realistic projects, drawings, BOQs, materials and procurement scenarios that mirror the customer's environment, not generic feature tours.

- Use drawings and specifications to show where quantity leakage and rework begin, from design change through to procurement.

- Translate product capabilities into operational, financial and commercial value: better margins and less leakage.

- Engage founders, CXOs, project heads, architects, QSs, estimators, procurement, commercial and site teams.

- Work with Sales to qualify opportunities, find the real business problem before proposing a solution, and support solution design, proposals and commercial discussions.

- Prepare solution decks, use cases, demo flows, process diagrams and sales collateral.

- Capture customer requirements and gaps in a structured way, including design-to-BOQ and revision-handling needs, and convert them into functional requirements for Product and Engineering.

- Decide whether a requirement is met through configuration, workflow change, existing functionality or future development.

- Build reusable demo scenarios for civil contracting, interiors, fit-outs, MEP, design & build, turnkey, EPC and other project-based segments.

**IDEAL PROFILE**

- 3–6 years in SaaS pre-sales, solution consulting, business analysis, product consulting, construction technology, architecture, quantity surveying, estimation, procurement or project management.

- Experience in ConstructionTech, PropTech, Construction ERP, project management software or B2B SaaS is highly valuable.

- Can open a customer's drawing set and BOQ in a discovery call and identify the commercial risk without being walked through it.

- Understands construction terminology, quantity logic and procurement workflows without relying on the customer to explain them.

- Strong analytical, structured problem-solving ability. Converts a business problem into Problem → Use Case → Workflow → Solution → Demo → Business Value.

- Strong presentation and storytelling skills; can take a design-led or site-led workflow to a mixed room of founders, architects, QSs and procurement and turn it into a business case. Design-presentation experience is an advantage.

- Communicates well with technical and non-technical stakeholders; commercially aware, curious and hands-on.

- Comfortable in a growing product company where solution consulting also feeds product discovery and market intelligence.

**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**

Not a role where you walk customers through screens. You are expected to understand: the customer's current process; where the operational or commercial problem is; what design, quantity or procurement logic is involved; how Bildwell addresses it; how to demonstrate it; and what measurable value the customer gets.

**SUCCESS IN THE ROLE**

Moving the conversation from "Here is what the product does" to "Here is how your current construction, quantity, material or procurement problem can be solved, how the workflow would run in your business, and what value it creates." Over time, you should be able to design a relevant Bildwell solution for a customer's business without the Product team explaining every workflow.

**WHY JOIN BILDWELL**

Work at the intersection of Construction Domain Expertise + SaaS + Business Consulting + Product Strategy. You will work directly with customers, Sales and Product, and help shape Bildwell's solution-selling methodology, industry use cases and product evolution. Help build the solution-selling engine for a growing ConstructionTech SaaS business.

This data architect will have a broad range of skills and experience ranging from data architecture to ETL/ELT, data science, security, performance analysis, analytics, etc. He/she will have the insight to make the connection between a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solution, the customer-facing skills to communicate that connection and vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences, and the technical skills to be able to not only build demos and execute proof-of-concepts but also to provide consultative assistance on architecture and implementation.
  
  
***This is a hands-on, individual contributor role with high visibility across the organisation.***
The Solution Engineer has the willingness to jump in and do what it takes to make Snowflake and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever-evolving technologies for data and analytics in order to be an authoritative resource for both Snowflake and customers. They should work collaboratively with a broad range of people, both inside and outside the company.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers
* Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation
* Maintain a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing
* Be an advocate and develop mutual trust with the technical audience on the customer side
* Run training sessions, workshops, webinars to help customers become proficient in Snowflake
* Keeping customers up to date on key Snowflake product updates and future roadmaps to help them represent Snowflake to their clients about latest technology solutions and benefits
* Run technical enablement programs to provide best practices, and solution design workshops to help customers create effective solutions
* Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive Snowflake adoption
* Represent Snowflake at customer or industry events
* Forward Strategic thinking - quickly grasp the essence of new concepts and business value messaging. Sharing customer success stories & case studies to showcase the impact of Snowflake

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum 8+ years of experience working in customer facing solution engineering (tech sales) role, preferably with large Global accounts
* University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience
* Strong competency on modern data stacks, ETL/ELT, data warehouse/lake, data science and data apps
* Outstanding skills presenting to both technical and executive audiences, in small groups or at public events, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.
* Hands-on expertise with SQL and Python
* Experience working with large global accounts, GSIs and/or Global Capability Centers
* Experience with large-scale database technology (e.g. Netezza, Exadata, Teradata, Greenplum, Hadoop etc.)
* Pre-sales experience in data related tech products
* Sound understanding and experience in the enterprise market and technology ecosystem
* Prior industry domain experience with a focus on BFSI is highly desirable.

**ADDED BONUS FOR:**

* Data Science/AI/ML experience across a variety of platforms
* Familiarity and experience with common BI and data exploration tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Metabase etc).
* Cloud Provider Experience - Amazon AWS/Microsoft Azure/Google Cloud
* Data modeling and data architecture experience
* Experience selling enterprise SaaS software to Global Accounts

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
  
  
How do you want to make your impact?
  
  
For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

* Experience in studying tender documents and technical specifications.
* Knowledge of government/private tendering will be an advantage.

ac526772.title: Technical Architect - Salesforce Field Service
ac526772.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

9ff2fe58.title: Solution Architect - Senior
9ff2fe58.description:
The Solution Architect – Senior is responsible for defining and developing solution architectures that align with enterprise architecture strategies, principles, policies, standards, and business requirements. This role evaluates and applies solution designs for specific systems in collaboration with project and product teams and ensures solutions meet business, technical, security, governance, compliance, scalability, and performance requirements. The role involves translating complex business and technical requirements into scalable solution designs, evaluating multiple architectural options, conducting cost-benefit analysis, and recommending optimized solutions. The Solution Architect – Senior also stays current with emerging technologies and supports pilots and proof-of-concept initiatives to validate new technology capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define solution and system architectures in alignment with enterprise architecture strategies, standards, reference architectures, and technology principles.
* Decompose systems into components, perform functional allocation, and establish interfaces between systems and system components.
* Develop and evaluate multiple solution options, conduct cost-benefit analysis, and recommend optimized solutions based on business and technical requirements.
* Design scalable architecture solutions for cloud-based platforms, enterprise applications, data and analytics platforms, and integrated systems.
* Develop and maintain architecture deliverables, including conceptual and logical models, solution diagrams, architecture patterns, and technical documentation.
* Apply enterprise architecture standards, frameworks, technology stacks, architecture patterns, and reference models to solution designs.
* Architect and integrate enterprise applications, data platforms, APIs, and other technology systems to deliver end-to-end solutions.
* Translate complex business requirements, industry requirements, and governance considerations into practical and scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure solution designs address security, governance, compliance, performance, scalability, buildability, and operational requirements.
* Collaborate with project, product, engineering, data, security, and business teams to drive successful solution development and delivery.
* Provide technical leadership and influence architecture decisions across cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Facilitate and support pilots, proof-of-concept activities, and technology evaluations to validate emerging technologies and architectural approaches.
* Analyze infrastructure and technology capacity and provide recommendations to support current and future business needs.
* Maintain awareness of emerging technologies, software trends, tools, and industry practices and assess their applicability to business solutions.
* Support the adoption of Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automation, and modern software delivery practices.
* Identify, assess, and manage technical risks and issues and drive appropriate mitigation actions.
* Build strong relationships with customers, business stakeholders, technology teams, and peers to promote effective solution development and delivery.
* Apply effective Business Relationship Management practices to ensure technology solutions deliver measurable business value.
* Drive changes in technical architecture and standards into solution designs when business or technology needs evolve.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Enterprise Architecture and Solution Design
* Cloud Architecture – AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Solution and System Architecture
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
* Data Architecture, Data Modeling, Data Warehousing, ETL, and Data Pipeline Design
* System Integration and API Architecture
* Enterprise Application Architecture
* Analytics and AI/ML Platform Architecture
* Machine Learning Lifecycle Management / MLOps
* CI/CD, Build Automation, and Version Control
* Security, Governance, and Compliance in Architecture Design
* Architecture Documentation, Design Patterns, and Reference Architectures
* Stakeholder Management and Technical Leadership
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and influencing skills

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Experience with IoT technologies and connected systems.
* Experience with Agile software development methodologies.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and automation frameworks.
* Experience with cost optimization and performance engineering.
* Experience architecting and integrating complex enterprise systems and data platforms.
* Experience designing AI/ML-enabled solutions and modern analytics platforms.
* Experience with agentic lifecycle management / AIOps.
* Familiarity with architecture frameworks, enterprise technology reference models, and architecture governance.
* Experience working with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or Neo4j.
* Experience designing Azure-native solutions.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch.
* Knowledge of advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and AI-driven decision systems.
* Experience with IoT and connected product ecosystems.
* Experience with modern cloud-native application and data platform architectures.

**Experience**

* Intermediate to advanced experience in solution architecture, enterprise systems, cloud architecture, or a related technical discipline.
* Demonstrated experience designing architectures for cloud-based platforms and enterprise applications.
* Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and sustainable technical solutions.
* Experience designing enterprise data, analytics, AI/ML, and integration solutions.
* Experience architecting integrations across enterprise applications, APIs, and data platforms.
* Experience developing solution designs, architecture models, technical documentation, and reference patterns.
* Experience evaluating technology options and recommending solutions based on technical feasibility, business value, cost, performance, and scalability.
* Experience leading or influencing cross-functional technical teams and architecture decisions.
* Experience managing technical risks, issues, dependencies, and architectural trade-offs.
* Experience working in Agile and/or DevSecOps environments is preferred.

**Key Competencies**

* Balances Stakeholders
* Collaborates Effectively
* Communicates Effectively
* Decision Quality
* Persuades and Influences
* Strategic Mindset
* Change Management
* Values Differences
* Architecture System Design
* Solution Design
* Solution Functional Fit Analysis
* System Solution Architecture
* Project Issue and Risk Management
* Technical Leadership
* Business Relationship Management

**Qualifications**

* College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline.
* Relevant equivalent experience may be considered in place of a formal degree.
* Strong understanding of enterprise and solution architecture principles, methodologies, and frameworks.
* Strong understanding of cloud-based platforms and enterprise application architecture.
* Ability to analyze complex business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable solution architectures.
* Strong understanding of data, analytics, AI/ML, integration, security, governance, and enterprise technology concepts.
* This position may require licensing or compliance with applicable export controls or sanctions regulations.

beca08de.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
#S&SArchitect
  
  
**Customer**
The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level**
: Lead Business Transformation Architect
  
  
As a Lead Business Transformation Architect/ Specialist Master at Deloitte Consulting, you will drive the design, implementation, and delivery of cutting-edge artificial intelligence solutions for our clients. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities and exceptional client management skills. You will serve as a bridge between complex technical implementations and business objectives, leading development teams while effectively communicating with stakeholders at all levels.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**

* Technical Leadership & Architecture
* Client Engagement & Solution Design
* Team Management & Development
* Service Delivery Excellence

**The team:**
Our Sales & Service team focuses on delivering marketing and growth objectives aligned with our clients’ brand values for measurable business growth. We help clients turn business values into measurable growth through creatively driven, personalized content, communications, and experiences that engage and inspire people to act. We implement and operate the technology platforms that enable personalized content, commerce and marketing user-centric experiences. In doing so, we transform our clients’ marketing and engagement operations into modern, data-driven, creatively focused organizations. Our team brings deep experience in creative and digital marketing capabilities by a combination of key focus areas i.e, Brand, Advertising, Experiences, Content, Marketing, Commerce, Products, Data and measurement/analysis.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 9+ years of overall Salesforce platform experience
* 5+ years of experience focused on Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud Advance, or Lead-to-Cash / Quote-to-Cash architecture
* Proven experience leading enterprise-scale Salesforce Revenue Cloud or CPQ implementations
* Hands on experience on Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA) architecture and core capabilities, including Product Catalog Management, Salesforce Pricing, Pricing Procedures, Product Configurator, Approval Orchestration, Dynamic Revenue Orchestrator, Document Builder, Context Service, Business Rules Engine, and OmniStudio
* Hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, Salesforce APIs and integration frameworks
* Experience designing integrations with ERP, billing, eCommerce, provisioning, and middleware platforms
* Ability to create architecture artifacts and communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience leading cross-functional delivery teams in complex enterprise environments
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field or equivalent practical experience

**Good To Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications**

* Experience with Salesforce AI capabilities, including Agentforce, or related GenAI-enabled solutions
* Exposure to Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Billing, Experience Cloud, or Salesforce Industries solutions
* Experience in high-tech, SaaS, manufacturing, telecom, or subscription-based business models
* Salesforce certifications such as:

+ Salesforce Certified Application Architect
+ Salesforce Revenue Cloud certification(s)
+ Salesforce Certified System Architect

**Education**
:
  
  

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Location**
:
  
  

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**

The Solution Architect – Senior also stays current with emerging technologies and supports pilots and proof-of-concept initiatives to validate new technology capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define solution and system architectures in alignment with enterprise architecture strategies, standards, reference architectures, and technology principles.
* Decompose systems into components, perform functional allocation, and establish interfaces between systems and system components.
* Develop and evaluate multiple solution options, conduct cost-benefit analysis, and recommend optimized solutions based on business and technical requirements.
* Design scalable architecture solutions for cloud-based platforms, enterprise applications, data and analytics platforms, and integrated systems.

* Apply enterprise architecture standards, frameworks, technology stacks, architecture patterns, and reference models to solution designs.

* Ensure solution designs address security, governance, compliance, performance, scalability, buildability, and operational requirements.

066bac16.title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
066bac16.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics – Senior Manager - Databricks Architect**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Senior Data & AI Architect with 13+ years of experience in data engineering and data architecture, strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
  
  
This role combines deep technical ownership of enterprise Lakehouse and data platform architecture with hands-on experience building Agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions on Databricks. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing large-scale, production-grade data pipelines, architecting modern AI-driven solutions, and engaging directly with clients on strategic proposals and solution design.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, design, and deliver scalable Data & AI solutions on the Databricks Lakehouse platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, governance, and consumption layers.
* Design and optimize large-scale distributed data processing pipelines using Hadoop, Apache Spark, and PySpark.
* Build reusable, production-grade Python frameworks and pipelines for batch and streaming data engineering workloads.
* Define and implement cloud data architecture on AWS and/or Azure, covering storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring, with native Databricks integration.
* Own end-to-end ETL/ELT design, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality frameworks across the platform.
* Design dimensional data models (star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension tables, SCD) to support analytical and reporting use cases.
* Design and build Agentic AI solutions on Databricks, including LLM integration, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.
* Architect and implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions using Databricks — document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.
* Establish and enforce engineering best practices for Git-based version control, code reviews, and CI/CD across development, test, and production environments.
* Lead performance optimization and production deployment of Databricks jobs, workflows, and pipelines at scale.
* Participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, solution shaping, effort estimation, and architecture presentations.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor in customer workshops, translating business requirements into robust technical architectures.
* Mentor engineering teams on Databricks, Spark, cloud architecture, and modern AI/RAG engineering practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
13+ years of experience in Data Engineering / Data Architecture, with strong hands-on experience across Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
  
  

* Databricks

+ Strong expertise in Databricks Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, and Unity Catalog.
+ Hands-on experience with Jobs/Workflows, performance optimization, and production deployments.

* Hadoop & Spark

+ Strong knowledge of the Hadoop ecosystem, HDFS, and Hive.
+ Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark and PySpark for large-scale distributed data processi

* Python

+ Strong proficiency in Python for building scalable, reusable, production-grade data pipelines and frameworks.
+ Cloud
+ Strong experience with AWS and/or Azure, including cloud storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring.
+ Experience integrating Databricks with cloud-native services.

* Data Engineering

+ Expertise in ETL/ELT, batch and streaming processing, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality.
+ Proven ability to design scalable, production-ready pipeline architectures.

* SQL & Data Modelling

+ Strong SQL skills, with experience in dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension models, SCD, and analytical data models.

* Agentic AI

+ Hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI solutions with Databricks, including LLMs, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.

* RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

+ Strong experience building RAG solutions using Databricks, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.

* Git & CI/CD

+ Strong knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews.
+ Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment across multiple environments.
+ Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles and/or Terraform is a plus.

* Strategic RFPs & Solutioning

+ Ability to participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, solution shaping, technical proposals, and effort estimations.
+ Experience delivering architecture presentations and leading customer workshops.

* Client Communication
* Strong client-facing and communication skills, with the ability to understand business requirements, translate them into scalable technical solutions, and clearly communicate architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Prior experience in a consulting, systems integrator, or client-facing delivery role.
* Relevant cloud or Databricks certifications (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer / Solutions Architect, AWS/Azure certifications).
* Exposure to enterprise data governance, MLOps, or LLMOps practices.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Salesforce Solution Architect / Senior Salesforce Solution Architect**
**Key Responsibilities**
As an Industry Success Architect, you will specialize in multiple Industry Clouds with primary, secondary, and tertiary areas of expertise. You will:
  
  

* Drive Customer Impact - Partner with our most strategic and high-priority customers, assessing their Industry Cloud implementations and delivering expert recommendations on technical architecture, solution design, application lifecycle management, reliability, and feature adoption.
* Lifesciences Expertise - Serve as a trusted Subject Matter Expert (SME) in your Lifesciences Industry Clouds, providing both proactive and reactive guidance on architecture, technology strategy, thought leadership, and product best practices.
* Communicate with Clarity - Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor in key business and technology discussions.
* Innovate & Solve Problems - Identify capability gaps and design inefficiencies, recommending product enhancements or creative custom solutions that drive customer success and long-term adoption.
* Execute Proven Strategies - Leverage and tailor Success Architect playbooks to meet the unique challenges and opportunities of your Industry Cloud customers.
* Build Strong Relationships - Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement, and overall business growth.

**Basic Requirements**

* Solution Design & Architecture
* 10+ years of experience in developing technology solutions.
* 5+ years of experience in software, system, or enterprise architecture with experience in Lifesciences domain.
* Expertise in Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance, and best practices.
* Experience with large-scale, complex implementations, including SaaS, PaaS, multi-tenancy, and multi-tiered infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics, and security best practices.
* Communication & Leadership
* Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options, and drive stakeholder alignment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and executive audiences.
* Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead discussions, influence decision-making, and advocate for best practices.
* Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving
* Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations, and drive customer transformation.
* Provide data-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.

**Desired Technical Skills**

* Secure & Scalable Architecture: Expertise in role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets, and security configurations. Proven ability to design scalable, high-performance architectures aligned with Salesforce best practices, including Large Data Volume (LDV) considerations.
* Salesforce Development: Hands-on experience with APEX programming, JavaScript, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC). Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.
* Data Management & Integration: Proficient in designing and managing data models, validation rules, and data governance best practices. Experience with data import/export, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft).
* System Integration & Extensibility: Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware, and event-driven architectures. Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects, and tools like Salesforce Connect.
* OmniStudio Knowledge: Experience with OmniStudio components is required.
* DevOps (Core + Industry): Strong understanding of software development and delivery process, assessing architecture environments and requirements in order to implement management solutions.

**Certifications**

* Required: Salesforce Admin, Platform Developer 1 and JavaScript Developer
* Highly Desired: Certified Architect Credentials (Application and System Architect), Platform App Builder, Salesforce Advanced Admin and an Accredited Professional credential in at least one Industry Cloud specialization (e.g., Financial Services Cloud, Health Cloud, or Public Sector Solutions).

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey.
