ee210d64.title: Salesforce Architect
ee210d64.description:
**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture for Salesforce Field Service programs - application intent, target-state design, integration landscape, and governing artifacts including context diagrams, data models, and architecture decision records
* Design scalable, secure solutions across the platform, defending build-vs-configure and AppExchange decisions on total cost of ownership, and defining the org-wide data model, sharing and security architecture, and large-data-volume strategy covering skew mitigation, selective indexing, and archiving
* Establish technical governance: design review gates, Apex and LWC coding standards, DevOps and release architecture, sandbox and environment strategy, and technical debt remediation roadmaps
* Architect Field Service implementations across the work order lifecycle, service appointments, service resources, crews, operating hours, and territory design for [X] technicians in [X] territories
* Design the scheduling and optimization model - scheduling policies, work rules, service objectives, Enhanced Scheduling and Optimization, emergency dispatch, and appointment booking - tuned against SLA attainment, travel time, and technician utilization
* Define mobile and dispatcher architecture: Field Service Mobile offline priming and briefcase rules, mobile flows, service report templates, and Dispatcher Console Gantt configuration and territory visibility
* Architect asset, maintenance, and inventory models - asset hierarchies, maintenance plans and work rules, product items, product requests, part transfers, van stock replenishment - along with entitlement, milestone, and escalation models that enforce contractual SLAs
* Set Lightning Web Component architecture: component library and design system standards, Lightning Data Service vs imperative Apex patterns,Lightning Message Service for cross-component communication, Jest coverage thresholds, and the Aura and Visualforce migration roadmap
* Architect integrations using REST and SOAP APIs, Apex REST, Named Credentials, External Services, and event-driven patterns with Platform Events and Change Data Capture, defining API contracts, canonical data models, idempotency, and retry and dead-letter handling
* Define middleware architecture on [MuleSoft/Boomi], connecting field service to [SAP/Oracle] for parts, invoicing, and warranty, and to [Twilio/Google Maps/DocuSign] for notifications, geocoding, and signed service reports, while governing high-volume data movement and platform limits through Bulk and Composite APIs, asynchronous Apex, Platform Cache, and OAuth 2.0 JWT authentication
* Define the AI architecture for service operations, selecting between Einstein predictive models, Data Cloud, Agentforce, and Prompt Builder based on data readiness and business value
* Design and deploy Agentforce agents and Prompt Builder templates grounded in CRM and Data Cloud data, applying retrieval-augmented generation, the Einstein Trust Layer, prompt versioning, and evaluation practices, with responsible-AI guardrails for data masking, grounding checks, human-in-the-loop review, and audit trails
* Architect predictive use cases such as [first-time fix rate, SLA breach risk, appointment no-show, skill matching], defining the underlying data quality, feature, and monitoring requirements
* Lead and mentor a Salesforce engineering team of [X] across onshore and offshore locations, owning hiring, onboarding, goal setting, performance reviews, career development, and capacity planning across [X] concurrent programs
* Run delivery operations in both Agile and Waterfall models - estimation, sprint and release planning, risk and dependency management, and partner coordination - and define and report metrics on velocity, defect leakage, code coverage, SLA attainment, and release success
* Plan and facilitate requirements elicitation workshops to capture functional and non-functional requirements, involving developers in requirements-stage analysis, and author requirements management plans, BRDs, FRDs, and process and data flow diagrams to best-practice standards
* Serve as escalation point and offshore representative to clients and executive stakeholders, presenting architecture, roadmaps, and status to senior audiences, and build practice capability through certification paths, reusable assets, and capability decks
* Stay hands-on as needed, prototyping complex components and integrations to de-risk designs before handover to the team
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Qualifications - External**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate degree or equivalent experience
* 11+ years in software development, including 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience in an architect, technical lead, or engineering management capacity
* 5+ years leading engineering and Agile teams, with 4+ years in Scrum or SAFe and demonstrated people management including hiring, performance management, mentoring, and capability building
* 3+ years architecting and delivering Salesforce Field Service - scheduling policies and optimization, Dispatcher Console, mobile offline configuration, and the work order, asset, and inventory data model
* Deep platform development expertise in Apex, asynchronous Apex, triggers, SOQL and SOSL optimization, Flow, and Lightning Web Components, with Visualforce and Aura for legacy maintenance and migration
* Proven integration architecture experience across REST and SOAP APIs, Apex REST, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Bulk and Composite APIs, OAuth 2.0 flows, Named Credentials, and middleware such as MuleSoft or Boomi
* Experience defining the data model, large-data-volume strategy, and technical governance standards for an enterprise org
* Salesforce DevOps and release management experience using SFDX, CI/CD pipelines, and version control
* Working knowledge of AI and generative AI on the platform - Einstein prediction and scoring, Agentforce, Prompt Builder, Data Cloud, Einstein Trust Layer - plus core concepts including RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, and model evaluation and guardrails
* Practical understanding of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, with the ability to model standard and custom objects and relationships for the right solution fit
* Proven solid command of the Salesforce sharing and security model: OWD, role hierarchy, sharing rules, Apex sharing, field-level security, and record and platform encryption
* Proven track record on large-scale implementations - multi-quarter, multi-team programs with enterprise integration footprints and concurrent project delivery
* Proven solid requirements elicitation skills and excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication with both business and technical audiences

6377edb2.title: Delivery Manager I
6377edb2.description:
**Role Description**
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
**Transformation Delivery Manager**
to lead strategic technology transformation initiatives and manage the successful delivery of large-scale fixed bid programs for a specific customer, account, or industry vertical.
  
  
This role serves as the single point of accountability for delivery excellence, commercial performance, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes across a portfolio of transformation initiatives. The Transformation Delivery Manager will be responsible for driving complex digital transformation programs from strategy through execution while ensuring predictable delivery, contractual compliance, margin achievement, and customer success.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in program delivery, fixed bid project management, transformation leadership, customer engagement, financial governance, and operational excellence. This role requires extensive experience managing multi-million-dollar fixed bid engagements, distributed global teams, and large-scale product/platform implementations.
  
  
The Transformation Delivery Manager will work closely with customer executives, business stakeholders, architects, engineering leaders, product teams, project managers, and delivery organizations to ensure transformation objectives are achieved within agreed scope, schedule, quality, and financial commitments.
  
  
**Preferred Domain Expertise**

* Telecom Operations / AIOps / Network Operations
* Healthcare & HealthTech Platforms
* Banking, Financial Services & Insurance (BFSI)

**Key Responsibilities**
**Transformation & Delivery Leadership**

* Own end-to-end delivery accountability for transformation programs, product implementations, platform modernization initiatives, and large-scale fixed bid engagements.
* Lead strategic transformation roadmaps focused on digital modernization, cloud adoption, AI-enabled operations, automation, process transformation, and platform engineering.
* Translate customer business objectives into executable delivery plans, measurable outcomes, and transformation milestones.
* Ensure successful realization of transformation goals while maintaining delivery predictability and customer confidence.
* Act as the primary delivery executive responsible for program success, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes.

**Large-Scale Fixed Bid Program Delivery**

* Lead delivery of complex fixed bid projects and programs with full accountability for scope, schedule, quality, cost, and contractual commitments.
* Establish robust delivery governance frameworks to ensure projects are delivered within approved budgets and timelines.
* Manage multi-workstream programs involving cross-functional teams, third-party vendors, and geographically distributed delivery organizations.
* Drive proactive scope management and prevent scope creep through disciplined change control processes.
* Ensure contractual obligations, service commitments, milestones, and acceptance criteria are achieved.
* Identify delivery risks early and implement mitigation plans to protect schedule, quality, and financial targets.
* Manage customer expectations while balancing delivery commitments and commercial objectives.
* Drive successful execution of product implementation, migration, modernization, and transformation programs.

**Financial & Commercial Management**

* Own P&L responsibility for assigned programs and portfolios.
* Ensure achievement of revenue, margin, utilization, profitability, and cost management targets.
* Monitor project financial health through forecasting, budget tracking, earned value analysis, and variance management.
* Lead estimation reviews, solution validation, effort planning, and pricing governance for fixed bid engagements.
* Drive financial discipline through effective resource utilization, productivity improvements, and operational efficiencies.
* Manage contractual changes, commercial negotiations, and scope governance to protect project profitability.
* Provide accurate forecasting and financial reporting to leadership and customer stakeholders.

**Customer Engagement & Executive Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the trusted delivery advisor and strategic partner to customer leadership teams.
* Build strong executive relationships across business, technology, operations, and transformation functions.
* Lead executive governance meetings, steering committees, operational reviews, and transformation status reviews.
* Communicate program health, risks, dependencies, financial performance, and business outcomes effectively.
* Proactively manage escalations and drive timely resolution of critical customer issues.
* Identify opportunities for account expansion, additional transformation initiatives, and value creation.
* Ensure customer expectations are aligned with contractual commitments and delivery realities.

**Delivery Governance & Operational Excellence**

* Establish and enforce delivery governance standards across all programs and projects.
* Drive rigorous program management through dashboards, KPI tracking, RAID management, milestone reviews, and executive reporting.
* Monitor delivery performance across scope, schedule, quality, cost, resource utilization, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Ensure compliance with organizational delivery frameworks, quality processes, security requirements, and governance standards.
* Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, continuous improvement, and execution excellence.
* Implement standardized delivery practices that improve predictability and reduce execution risks.

**Program & Portfolio Management**

* Manage multiple concurrent transformation initiatives within the assigned account or industry vertical.
* Ensure alignment between strategic objectives, business priorities, and delivery execution.
* Balance competing priorities, resource constraints, and customer expectations across programs.
* Drive dependency management and cross-functional coordination to achieve portfolio objectives.
* Establish portfolio-level reporting, governance, and performance measurement mechanisms.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Lead and influence diverse teams including architects, engineering managers, project managers, QA leaders, DevOps teams, product owners, business analysts, and customer stakeholders.
* Drive collaboration across onsite, offshore, and nearshore delivery teams.
* Remove execution bottlenecks and facilitate timely decision-making.
* Champion engineering best practices, automation, AI-enabled delivery models, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Mentor delivery managers and project leaders to build a high-performance delivery organization.

* Network operations transformation
* Service assurance and observability platforms
* AI-driven operations and automation
* Event management and operational analytics

**Healthcare**

* Digital health and healthcare platform modernization
* Claims, payer, provider, and member solutions
* Regulatory compliance and healthcare operations
* Patient engagement and experience transformation

* Digital banking and financial services platforms
* Lending, payments, insurance, and wealth management solutions
* Regulatory and compliance-driven transformation initiatives
* Customer experience modernization programs

**Experience**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 12+ years of overall IT industry experience.
* 7+ years of progressive experience in Delivery Management, Program Management, Transformation Leadership, or Portfolio Management roles.
* Proven track record of successfully delivering large-scale fixed bid programs and enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing programs with multi-million-dollar budgets and distributed global delivery teams.
* Strong experience delivering enterprise software implementations, platform modernization, cloud transformation, and digital initiatives.
* Demonstrated success in managing customer relationships at executive and senior leadership levels.
* Experience managing contractual commitments, commercial governance, and delivery profitability.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Hybrid, and traditional program delivery methodologies.

**Operational Excellence**

**Join our India Tech Hub – Be among the first hires!**
Kobie, a 35-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world’s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty.
  
  
**About The Team And What We’ll Build Together**
Kobie is seeking a dynamic and highly organized Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the successful execution of our product portfolio and optimize delivery across Data Science teams supporting our AI Product Set. The TPM plays a critical part in ensuring our Product and our Data Science teams operate efficiently, meet delivery goals, and align work with broader business objectives. The TPM is not a developer, but a process leader who is focused on driving innovation, improving operations, managing workflows, and enabling delivery through visibility, structure, and collaboration.
  
  
**About Kobie**
Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture.
  
  
As a trusted partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.  We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level.As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award-winning culture to a new region - creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special.
  
  
We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard.
  
  
Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities.
  
  
To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work - recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work-life balance.
  
  
As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection.
  
  
Now is the perfect time to join Kobie. Be part of something big and help shape the future of our global capabilities center, the Kobie India Tech Hub.

dd1d979a.title: Principal Program Manager, Enterprise AI Strategy & Governance
dd1d979a.description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You are a highly skilled program manager with strong understanding of Artificial intelligence technology and its transformative potential. With deep expertise in leading complex, cross-functional programs, you thrive in fast-paced environments where strategic thinking and execution go hand in hand. You are comfortable collaborating with diverse stakeholders, from engineers to executive leadership, and excel at aligning program objectives with organizational strategy.
  
  
You bring a proven track record of managing enterprise-scale AI initiatives, including the evaluation and integration of new models, tools, and third-party solutions. Your leadership style fosters a culture of continuous improvement, and you are adept at change management, ensuring smooth adoption of Gen/Agentic AI technologies across corporate functions. If you are energized by the challenge of shaping the future of AI at scale, Synopsys offers you the platform to make a lasting impact.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Lead and scale Synopsys' enterprise AI Governance operating model across GenAI, LLMs, Agentic AI, third-party AI solutions, and internal AI applications, establishing processes for intake, evaluation, approval, monitoring, risk management, and lifecycle oversight
* Partner with Legal, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Compliance, Procurement, Engineering, Product, IT, and business stakeholders to evaluate AI technologies and use cases, ensuring alignment across risk, regulatory compliance, IP protection, privacy, and security requirements
* Operationalize governance frameworks including NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), ISO/IEC 42001, and Responsible AI principles, translating them into practical workflows that balance innovation velocity with enterprise risk
* Define governance patterns for Agentic AI systems, including access controls, monitoring, auditability, and lifecycle management, partnering with R&D teams to ensure safe and responsible deployment
* Drive AI Academy initiatives in partnership with People and business leaders to build AI literacy, responsible AI awareness, and role-specific AI skills across the organization, developing adoption playbooks and enablement programs
* Develop governance metrics, executive dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to drive transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement across AI adoption and risk management
* Support strategic AI ecosystem partnerships, platform evaluations, and technology provider assessments, contributing to enterprise AI strategy, adoption roadmaps, and executive communications

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Shape how Synopsys governs, deploys, and scales AI technologies across 30,000 employees, establishing the foundation for responsible and secure AI adoption company-wide
* Enable business units and corporate functions to adopt GenAI and Agentic AI safely and effectively, reducing risk exposure while accelerating innovation velocity
* Build governance processes that protect Synopsys' intellectual property, customer data, and regulatory compliance posture as AI becomes embedded across products and operations
* Drive workforce readiness and AI literacy across the organization, ensuring employees have the skills and awareness to integrate AI into their daily work responsibly
* Establish Synopsys as a leader in enterprise AI governance, operationalizing best practices that set the standard for responsible AI adoption in the semiconductor and high-tech industry
* Provide executive leadership with visibility into AI adoption, risk posture, and business impact through metrics, dashboards, and reporting that inform strategic decision-making
* Create governance mechanisms that adapt to evolving AI technologies, regulatory requirements, and business needs, ensuring Synopsys stays ahead of the curve as AI capabilities advance

What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline
* 12+ years of experience leading complex enterprise-scale technical programs within software, semiconductor, cloud, AI, or high-tech environments
* Experience building or operating AI Governance, Responsible AI, technology risk, compliance, cybersecurity, or enterprise transformation programs
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, AI platforms, and AI adoption challenges within large organizations
* Experience coordinating cross-functional reviews involving Legal, Privacy, Cybersecurity, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders
* Familiarity with governance and risk frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and emerging AI regulatory requirements is a plus,
* Experience with portfolio management and workflow tools such as Jira, SharePoint, Confluence etc.
* Experience driving enterprise adoption, change management, workforce enablement, or AI upskilling initiatives is a plus

Who You Are
  
  

* You can translate complex AI governance and risk topics into clear, actionable guidance for executives, engineers, and business leaders without losing the technical nuance
* You influence across organizations and executive levels without direct authority, building trust and alignment through credibility, clarity, and follow-through
* You operate comfortably in ambiguity, building governance structures and processes in environments where technology, policy, and business objectives are evolving in real time
* You connect the dots between AI technology capabilities, governance requirements, risk management, and business value, ensuring that governance enables rather than blocks progress
* You manage multiple high-stakes initiatives simultaneously, keeping stakeholders aligned, timelines on track, and deliverables moving without dropping details
* You have a point of view on what good AI governance looks like and you are not afraid to push back when a policy is too vague, a process is too slow, or a risk assessment misses the actual exposure

The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
You will be part of the Strategic Missions & Technologies (SMT) organization, helping drive Synopsys' enterprise AI journey. The team partners closely with Engineering, Product, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, IT, People, IP group along with executive leadership to enable the responsible, secure, and scalable adoption of AI across the company. This role reports to the Head of AI Governance, Program Management and Chief of Staff for Strategic Missions & Technologies (SMT). This onsite role is based in Bangalore and requires regular collaboration with US-based teams, including overlap with Pacific Time hours.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Data modelling & stores: Designing data schemas, tables and partitioning strategies across SQL and NoSQL databases such as Cosmos DB and Redis

Pipelines & orchestration: Building batch and streaming ETL/ELT processes over pub/sub platforms (Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, Google Cloud Pub/Sub), orchestrated with Airflow on Kubernetes, in containerized, scalable and serverless architectures

Infrastructure as Code: Terraform or equivalent

Performance & cost optimization: Spark tuning, shuffle optimization, caching, cluster sizing, query optimization, debugging long-running jobs and cloud cost control

Data quality & lineage: Defining data quality rules and data lineage definitions, and creating monitoring alerts out of them

Testing for data pipelines: Data validation, regression tests, reconciliation and end-to-end pipeline testing

Observability & reliability: Centralized logging, metrics, tracing, job monitoring, SLAs/SLOs and incident troubleshooting

ML engineering: Feature store, feature and training pipelines, model deployment and serving, model monitoring with drift detection and retraining (MLflow / MLOps)

AI-assisted development: Hands-on experience using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or equivalent for code generation, debugging, testing and developer productivity

Nice to have: Past exposure to web analytics solutions (Adobe Analytics & Google Analytics)

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

26cf38f0.title: Solution Architect – Data & AI Solutions
26cf38f0.description:
**Key Responsibilities**
Presales & Client Engagement
  
  

* Partner with sales and industry teams to design client-ready demos, proof-of-concepts, and technical solution blueprints.
* Present complex architectures in a clear, business-outcome-driven manner to both executive and technical stakeholders.
* Contribute to RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, and deal shaping.

Solution Architecture & Demo Environments
  
  

* Architect distributed, scalable, and resilient data and AI platforms for presales demonstrations.

Observability, Security & Compliance
  
  

* Define and enforce observability standards for demo and enterprise environments (logging, tracing, telemetry, real-time alerting).

* Work with Product, Data Science, Engineering, and Governance teams to align demos with business/regulatory needs.
* Collaborate with IMUs (verticals) to build domain-specific demo templates (e.g., Insurance claims, Healthcare payment integrity, Banking KYC/fraud, Retail personalization).
* Provide hands-on support to engineering teams during delivery, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.

Innovation & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Stay ahead of hyperscaler advancements, AI/ML frameworks, and orchestration patterns.
* Drive technical due diligence, PoCs, and vendor/platform evaluations.
* Create technical artifacts (architecture diagrams, design patterns, runbooks).
* Mentor presales engineers and junior architects in solution design and client presentation skills.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Certifications preferred: - Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Kubernetes / CNCF ecosystem.
* Architecture frameworks (TOGAF, SAFe).

Must-Have Skills & Experience
  
  

* 15+ years in software architecture, presales engineering, or enterprise data/AI platform design.
* Hands-on expertise in at least two hyperscaler platforms: - Azure (Fabric, Synapse, Data Factory, Azure ML, Power BI).
* AWS (Redshift, Glue, S3, SageMaker, Lake Formation).
* GCP (BigQuery, Dataplex, Vertex AI, Pub/Sub).
* Proven experience architecting distributed systems, microservices, and scalable AI/ML platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata, Lineage, and DataOps.
* Expertise in event-driven systems and asynchronous workflows.
* Hands-on with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK).
* Advanced programming with Python (async), TypeScript/JavaScript, or Go.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, service mesh (Istio), serverless design patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD automation, GitOps, Terraform, Helm.

* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms and usage-based billing.
* Familiarity with data mesh, knowledge graphs, and semantic interoperability.
* Knowledge of frontend architecture patterns (micro-frontends, data visualizations).

Exposure to agentic AI concepts and LLM-based orchestration.

26f901c2.title: Solution Architect / Functional Architect - Cloud
26f901c2.description:
**Job Title:**
Solution Architect / Functional Architect - Cloud
  
  
**Department**
: IT
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
Wealth Management (WM) - Strategy and Architecture
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
As a member of the IS Architecture team, you will be in charge of helping projects define their Solution Architecture while migrating the Information System of Wealth Management into BNPP group Cloud platform. You will review their proposals with Enterprise Architects as well as Engineering/Production teams and Security teams to ensure that solutions proposed are aligned and compliant with BNPP policies and BNPP Cloud offering.
  
  
You will be assigned to a fixed set of IT Divisions/Departments (2 or 3) for which you will manage the solutioning for Cloud migration and BAU evolutions of the applications under their management. In addition, you may be assigned to specific transversal projects for which you will do the solutioning end-to-end.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Maintain the Division/Department architecture reference documentation all along the changes brought by projects:
* IT system diagrams (Division level, or per sub-block)
* Application referential (with the help of Application Owners)
* Division level principles and related non-conformities and remediation plans
* Obsolescence KPIs
* Lead the Cloud solution architecture on the projects they are assigned to:
* Supporting the Project Manager/Business Analysts during solution ideation, design, and implementation
* Collaborating with application teams and Business Analysts/Tech leads of impacted applications to design solutions consistent from a functional and technical point of view
* Ensuring the alignment of projects with our architecture principles and IT standards
* Ensuring the solution is optimized for running on our IBM Private Cloud
* Support project managers, Business analysts and technical leads along the architecture validation process by:
* Leading the build of a consistent architecture documentation
* Presenting their projects in architecture validation committee
* Being the reference point on a set of applications for support/evolution activities
* Supporting the architecture process till the go-live
* Bringing Cloud and architecture awareness to application teams
* Being the reference architect on a set of applications for support/evolution activities (having low architecture impacts), before and after they are migrated into the Cloud platform.
* Collaborate with following roles:
* Project managers/Business analyst of major transversal projects they are assigned to
* Tech leads/Developers, to understand the architecture of the applications/screens and analyze potential issues
* Application owner, to update the referential information on applications
* Engineering and Production team, to check the availability/compatibility with infrastructure/Cloud services
* Enterprise Architects, to facilitate the review and validation process.
* Division heads to align domain objectives and roadmaps
* Business analysts to understand the business needs and design solution that are functionally consistent
* Ensure the reference documentation is updated all along the changes brought by projects:
* Application referential
* IT architecture diagrams and documents
* Application non-conformities and remediation plans
* Architecture principles, checklist, guidelines

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide and share specific expertise on our Cloud capabilities and in selected technical areas
* Participate to studies and proof-of-concepts with the business before a project is launched

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**
**Mandatory**

* Experience on designing and developing Cloud-native solutions
* Experience on Cloud migration, integration patterns, high availability patterns, etc. (e.g. REST APIs, Container platforms, Event-driven architecture, etc)
* Broad technical knowledge and experience across application, development frameworks and technologies
* Experience with Java/Spring/Angular, Oracle/PostgreSQL DB, Linux, API, Kafka etc.
* Functional/Business knowledge (current/past companies), ideally on core banking or portfolio management systems. Interest in Financial & Banking industry
* Experience working on a project or in an architecture team covering a large ecosystem of applications (30+)
* Experience in modeling activities (application maps, software design models, data modeling, infrastructure diagrams, etc.)
* Strong analysis skills with problem solving attitude
* Ability to communicate effectively in written documents and oral presentations, explaining concepts clearly to audiences at various levels of technical knowledge
* Effective leadership, planning and organization skills

**Plus**

* Experience of Enterprise Architecture discipline, processes, concepts, and best practices
* Experience in Wealth Management, or Financial and Banking Industry
* Knowledge of a Wealth Management Core Banking System such as Temenos Transact, ERI Olympic or Avaloq
* SCRUM/Agile experience
* Experience running Request for Proposal and assessing solutions

**Specific Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Engineering
* 3+ years of experience architecting or developing solutions in a Cloud environment
* 5+ years of experience in IT either as an Enterprise Architect or Solution Architect
* Architecture certification (TOGAF) or Cloud Architect certification (AWS, IBM Cloud)

**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential**
**(Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**




+ Software Architecture / Cloud Architecture - architecting or designing solutions in a Cloud environment (AWS, IBM Cloud)
+ Architecture patterns / Design principles / Problem solving / Solutioning
+ Architecture certification (TOGAF) or Cloud Architect certification (AWS, IBM Cloud)

**Behavioral Skills**

* Ability to collaborate / Teamwork


+ Communication skills - oral & written

* Ability to synthetize / simplify


+ Organizational skills

**Education Level:**
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Engineering
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.

6cd12c3e.title: Solution Architect - Teamcenter (BOM/Structures)
6cd12c3e.description:
**Hello Visionary!**
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent handled company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. The Information Technology (IT) department has the global responsibility for the internal IT of Siemens Mobility. Its goal is to provide a robust and efficient IT landscape derived from business and market demands. Your personality and individuality make the difference. In our team, we increase business performance and point the way into the digital age. Is that exactly your thing? Then live your passion in a cross-location team in which you can actively craft the future of our company. You open up new possibilities for our customers with your competence. Connected with this is an exciting career path that leads you to ever new projects and solutions in the field of IT for Siemens Mobility.
  
  
**We are looking for a Solution Architect - Teamcenter (BOM/Structures)**
Digitization poses major challenges for many companies and will change processes immensely in the coming years. This is also the case at Siemens Mobility GmbH – as an IT Solution Architect (f/m/d), you will actively help shape and accompany a Siemens Teamcenter transformation project. The project works according to the SAFe methodology and strives to replace the current SAP PLM system with a modern Teamcenter system (based on Teamcenter 14.3 and Active Workspace 6.3) for approximately 15 000 users.
  
  
**You’ll make a difference by:**

* You are a Solution Architect in the Siemens Teamcenter transformation project for one or more topics of for following list

+ “Coordinated Material Management” (IMM)) and "Substance Compliance"
+ Collaboration and data exchange with external partners (module “Supplier Connect”)
+ Product structures (module “Multi Structure Foundation” and related Engineering topics)

* Your responsibility is the complete and consistent replacement of the existing SAP solution with the new Teamcenter solution in this area of expertise.
* You will analyze the business requirements, but also the existing IT landscape (SAP and other systems) and translate this into a solution design for Teamcenter to ensure efficient integration.
* You will analyze, design and optimize the sophisticated Teamcenter solution and suitable architectures in detail to make Teamcenter user-friendly and optimized for the Siemens Mobility Business
* You will be responsible for Manufacturing Integration in Mobility IT and for the topic beyond the project period.
* As a member of an agile, international team (SAFe methodology), you will work closely with the product owner, the supplier's implementation authorities and other authorities in the team as well as across teams.

**You’ll win us over by:**

* You have a degree (Master's/Diploma) in computer science or a similar field of study.
* In addition, you have several years of in-depth experience in the field of Teamcenter design & development, as well as configuration/customizing, with a distributed system environment and integration of major software tools – ideally with a focus on product structures
* A good knowledge of the product development processes in the manufacturing industry is desirable.
* SAP PLM knowledge is desirable
* In depth knowledge of Teamcenter Bill of Materials and Bill of Processes is must
* Knowledge and working experience in product structure is must
* Knowledge of MES (Manufacturing Execution System) is desirable
* Time Management while creating BOP for shopfloor is desirable
* Ideally, you also have experience in working in agile project teams
* You have a structured, independent, and solution-oriented way of working, communication and partnership skills.
* Very good English skills are required due to the global orientation of the role, with German language skills being an additional advantage.

**Join us and be yourself!**
We value your outstanding identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and build a better tomorrow with us.
  
  
**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.**
This role is based in Pune and is an Individual contributor role. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting - and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and encouragement and help us shape tomorrow.
  
  
Find out more about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers & more about mobility at https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html

91f47a93.title: Solution Architect Product & Technology
91f47a93.description:
**Department:**
Product Development
  
  
**Location:**
India - Resident (0008)
  
  
**Compensation:**
Rs3,825,000 - Rs5,175,000 / year
  
  
**Description**
**This role will be working out of our office 5 days a week.**
Vena Solutions is seeking a Solution Architect, Product & Technology to drive the evolution of the features and capabilities of Vena’s SaaS cloud platform. Armed with a core set of architecture skills on cloud based apps, you will own the architecture of existing and emerging features and capabilities.With a keen eye on non-functional requirements, you will translate business requirements into a resilient solution within the Vena platform. This role is a match for you if you are looking to apply your architecture strengths in applications & technology as a key contributor to the delivery of an incredible experience for our customers. At Vena we continuously evolve through innovation with a keen eye on a customer experience that is second to none. Ensuring that we maintain our customers' trust as we enhance our products will be a core goal to the work you perform. Delivering in close collaboration with our Engineering teams you will help ensure the quality product our customers have grown to expect. Our environment and culture both foster and encourage individuals who are self-directed and self-motivated, empowering employees to take ownership of our collective success. Here at Vena, we value transparency, inclusion, continuous learning and passionate people who want to make their mark on our rapidly growing product and business.The successful candidate will have the opportunity to collaborate with a broad range of stakeholders, including Product, Engineering, SaaS Technology & Ops, and Security/InfoSec, as you provide thought leadership and hands-on support in meeting functional and non-functional requirements aligned with our standards and roadmaps. To be successful, this role requires you to thrive in a workplace that is fun, engaging, technically challenging and filled with opportunities to be individually impactful.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Solution Architecture + Strategy/Roadmap:

+ Working with Product Management and domain experts, define and own the architecture and roadmap for a set of product features/capabilities in a cloud-based application environment
+ Collaborate closely with Engineers in the definition of solutions and design
+ Review and validate alignment of Engineer designs and implementations against your Solution Architecture, with full compliance and standards adherence
+ Support Scrum teams during development lifecycle in troubleshooting, innovating and refactoring

* R&D:

+ Keep informed on current industry trends and evaluate opportunities to evolve our patterns, blueprints, processes and tactics

* Communications:

+ Maintain Architecture artifacts and proactively communicate/manage change to support your stakeholders while mentoring and training Engineers

* Governance:

+ Actively participate as a member of the architecture governance board in both process definition and execution, including development of internal standards, policies, principles, and best practices.

* Innovation:

+ Work with stakeholders in PoC activities to promote business cases for future features and enhancements, while supporting our culture of innovation

**We'd Love to See**

* 3+ years’ experience in applied Solution Architecture
* 5+ years’ experience in software development with 3+ years’ experience in Java / Fullstack
* Working knowledge of React/Redux and experience developing in NodeJS (or equivalent)
* Good understanding of algorithms and computational complexity
* Experience or deep understanding of data structures, management and OLTP an asset
* Experience in designing distributed and concurrent systems and microservices and APIs (REST, GraphQL)
* Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or equivalent cloud environments
* Knowledge of and experience with development of cloud-based SaaS applications
* Proven collaboration, communication and influencing skills across diverse stakeholders
* Prior experience in scrum/lean/agile environment, preferably while working on a cloud-based solution
* You are self-motivated, and self-directed
* You enjoy tackling new problems and pushing technology forward
* A history of demonstrating empathy for customers

59956e38.title: Platform Solution Architect
59956e38.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
  
  
*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
**Job Description**
We are looking for a hands-on Solution Architect to own the end-to-end architecture of our platform and drive its evolution as we scale. You will design, build, and maintain a multi-service application spanning backend, frontend, AI/ML services, and cloud infrastructure, while ensuring the platform is secure, scalable, and maintainable. As we move deeper into client conversations, this role also requires you to represent engineering in client discussions and lead the design of integrations between our platform and external HRMS (Human Resource Management System) or ATS (Applicant Tracking System) products.
  
  
**Role Details**

* Own the technical architecture of the platform end-to-end, including backend services, frontend applications, data stores, and cloud infrastructure.
* Design and evolve a scalable, secure, and maintainable microservices architecture using Java and Spring Boot, deployed on AWS (with a growing footprint on GCP and Azure).
* Guide and review the development of Python FastAPI-based AI services, including integration with OpenAI and Vapi for conversational/voice AI use cases.
* Define data architecture and access patterns across MongoDB and Redis, ensuring performance, consistency, and cost efficiency at scale.
* Architect and oversee real-time communication features using WebSockets, and asynchronous messaging workflows via MSG91 (email/SMS) and WhatsApp.
* Set technical direction for the Angular, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS frontend, and the Electron-based desktop application, ensuring consistency, performance, and code quality.
* Establish and enforce standards for observability and monitoring using Grafana (backend/infra) and Sentry (frontend), including alerting and incident response practices.
* Own authentication and identity architecture across Microsoft SSO and related identity providers, ensuring secure access management for enterprise clients.
* Guide secure use of Microsoft Graph API for email-based workflows in staffing scenarios, and Judge0 for code-execution/assessment use cases.
* Drive build vs. buy and tooling decisions, manage technical debt, and maintain architecture documentation (system diagrams, ADRs, data flow diagrams).
* Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines and build processes (Maven and related tooling) to support reliable, frequent releases.
* Participate in client discussions and solutioning calls, translating client requirements into technical designs and realistic delivery estimates.
* Lead the design and delivery of integrations between our platform and third-party HRMS/ATS systems (e.g., data sync, SSO, webhooks, candidate/employee data exchange, API-based or file-based integrations).
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for prospective and existing clients on integration feasibility, data security, and architecture questions during pre-sales and onboarding.
* Mentor engineers across backend, frontend, and AI teams, and conduct architecture/design reviews for major features.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**
**Backend & Cloud**

* Java and Spring Boot for building production-grade microservices
* AWS: strong hands-on experience across compute, storage, networking, and managed services; working knowledge of GCP and Azure is a plus (platform is moving toward a broader multi/all-AWS setup)
* MongoDB and Redis: schema/data modeling, indexing, caching strategies, and performance tuning
* Python and FastAPI for AI-service development
* WebSocket-based real-time systems
* Maven-based build and dependency management
* Grafana for metrics, dashboards, and alerting

**Frontend**

* Angular and TypeScript for enterprise web applications
* Tailwind CSS for scalable, consistent UI styling
* Electron for cross-platform desktop application development
* Sentry for frontend error monitoring and performance tracking

**Integrations, Messaging & AI**

* MSG91 (email and SMS) and WhatsApp Business API for transactional/notification workflows
* Vapi for voice bot/conversational AI integrations
* OpenAI APIs for AI-assisted product features
* Judge0 for code execution/assessment workflows
* Microsoft Graph API for email-specific staffing workflows
* Microsoft SSO and enterprise identity/authentication protocols (OAuth2, SAML, OIDC)
* Jupyter for prototyping and validating AI/data workflows

**Mandatory Non-Technical Skills**

* Experience with additional cloud platforms (GCP, Azure) beyond AWS.
* Familiarity with conversational AI/voice bot platforms and prompt engineering for LLM-based features.
* Exposure to DevOps practices: containerization, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipeline design.
* Relevant certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure/GCP equivalents) are a plus.

**Education Qualification and Certifications**
required, If any
  
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8-14 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years designing and owning system architecture for production applications at scale.
* Demonstrated experience architecting systems that combine backend services, frontend applications, cloud infrastructure, and third-party integrations.
* Prior experience in HR-tech, staffing, recruitment, or workforce-management platforms is strongly preferred.
* Experience presenting technical solutions directly to clients or in pre-sales/solutioning contexts.
* Strong understanding of security, data privacy, and compliance considerations relevant to HR/candidate data.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
  
  
Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking
*Introduce Yourself*
in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience in software engineering, enterprise cloud architecture, or technical consulting
* 3 years of experience in advanced AI/ML architecture, deploying generative AI applications, intelligent agents, or LLM-powered solutions globally.
* Experience in Python including implementation and deployment of tiered microservices applications.
* Experience deploying production-grade cloud infrastructure or architecting and building cloud-based data solutions (e.g., enterprise data warehouses, data lakes, data pipelines, and associated technologies).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree, Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* Experience pioneering multimodal AI solutions (text, image, video, and voice) to solve novel, previously unsolved enterprise workflow challenges.
* Deep understanding and applied experience with AI security, Large Language Model (LLM) governance, enterprise guardrails, and global compliance requirements (e.g., data privacy regulations, data sovereignty).
* Excellence in architecting highly resilient, globally distributed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and securely connecting LLMs with disparate legacy enterprise databases.
* Recognized industry thought leadership (e.g., patents, published research, keynotes) in Generative AI, agentic workflows, or large-scale cloud data infrastructure.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Cloud AI Engineer, you'll play a key leadership role in ensuring that strategic customers have the best experience adopting Gemini Enterprise alongside the broader Google Cloud Agentic AI suite of products. You will design and implement robust, production-ready application architectures to support customer use cases, leveraging Gemini Enterprise and core Google AI products. You'll work with customers to identify opportunities to transform their workflows with autonomous agents, actively removing technical barriers to ensure successful deployment and high adoption rates of Gemini Enterprise. You will have access to Google’s technology to monitor application performance, debug and troubleshoot complex agent behaviors, and address customer and partner needs. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end and timely execution of adopting Google Cloud Platform solutions to the customer.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and oversee the global delivery and implementation of Gemini Enterprise solutions, utilizing Agent Development Kits (ADKs) to solve highly complex, enterprise-scale technical challenges.
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor to C-suite executives at Google’s most strategic global accounts, shaping their overarching AI strategy and accelerating the adoption of Gemini Enterprise.
* Influence the core product roadmap by translating complex architectural challenges into actionable requirements for Google's engineering teams.
* Deliver leading practice recommendations and high-stakes technical presentations to executive boards and key business stakeholders to secure massive-scale technical wins.
* Act as a thought leader and mentor across the Google Cloud organization, elevating the technical acumen of engineers and shaping best practices for agentic AI architectures.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. You'll work alongside people who genuinely know their craft: data engineers who understand what fails in production, ML engineers who care about evaluation, ontology architects who've built at scale. You'll learn faster here in a year than you will in three at a Big-4 practice.

This role owns delivery health across data and AI engagements. You'll partner with a Senior Engagement Architect as a two-in-a-box on each account. One owns the engagement contract and commercial health. You own execution and delivery health. Your partner will bring you into steering committees, client difficult conversations, and commercial negotiations until you can run them yourself. We coach.

You'll also stay close to the actual work. Close enough to open a notebook when a pipeline is behind, walk a Spark job log, spot a DAX measure that's silently wrong, look at an LLM eval report and know if it's telling you the truth. Not to do the engineers' jobs. To know when something's off before they tell you.

Why this is a great next move

* **You'll ship things that matter.**
  Our clients are Fortune 500 chemicals, life sciences, financial services, and manufacturing firms. What you deliver runs in their actual operations
* **You'll own real scope from day one.**
  Small firm, high trust. No waiting three years for a promotion to touch a real client
* **You'll be around people who care about craft.**
  Design system enforced. Standards enforced. Retros that actually change how we work
* **You'll be coached, not micromanaged.**
  Two-in-a-box partners bring you into hard conversations early so you learn by being in the room
* **You'll grow into a Senior Delivery Leader role.**
  With mentorship, portfolio experience, and delivery contributions on your record

What you'll do

* Own delivery quality across one or more data and AI engagements as capacity builds
* Run the delivery cadence: sprint planning, standups, reviews, retros, milestone tracking, dependency management, escalation
* Stay close to the work: read pipeline logs, open the notebook, look at the model card, review the eval report, poke at the dashboard yourself. Show up to squad standups where it matters
* Enforce Networth Corp's delivery process. Quality gates (DoR, DoD, data quality gates, model release readiness), artifacts that get used (RAID logs, decision logs, ADRs, data contracts), governance rhythms
* Enforce design standards on every client-facing artifact. Ugly slides and cluttered dashboards do not leave the building
* Contribute to the knowledge management loop: retros, playbook updates, template refinements, prompt libraries, evaluation harnesses, ontology patterns
* Partner with the Senior Engagement Architect on client health, escalations, and steering committee prep. Grow into leading these yourself
* Coordinate fractional leads and IC teams across data engineering, ML, LLM/GenAI, ontology, BI, integration, and platform workstreams
* Show up in client working groups and squad syncs. Learn to hold steering committee conversations with CIO, CDO, and CTO stakeholders. Your Engagement Architect partner brings you into these until you're ready to run them
* Watch for risk proactively: model risk, data quality risk, dependency risk. Flag drift the week it starts
* Track commercial hygiene: burn versus forecast, utilisation, invoice cleanness, change requests before scope creeps

How we work

* **Process is a product.**
  We treat our delivery methodology like software we ship. Versioned, tested, improved every release
* **Design is not decoration.**
  Every deliverable follows a house design system
* **Knowledge compounds.**
  Every engagement ends with a documented handover, and every playbook cites the engagement that hardened it
* **Culture over process, when they conflict.**
  We hold each other to high standards and to kindness in the same sentence. Direct feedback, no politics, no BS
* **We coach.**
  You'll pair with senior delivery people on the harder stuff. Nobody expects you to walk in knowing how to run a bad-quarter steering committee. We expect you to want to learn

What you'll work with

* **Client stacks**
  : Databricks · Snowflake · Microsoft Fabric · Azure ML · Bedrock · Azure OpenAI · SAP · Salesforce · dbt · Airflow · Kafka
* **Data and AI delivery patterns**
  : data contracts · data product thinking · MLOps release cadence · LLMOps evaluation gates · Unity Catalog governance · lineage-first delivery
* **Delivery frameworks**
  : Scrum, Kanban. SAFe patterns if you've seen them
* **Tools you'll use daily**
  : Jira · Confluence · Notion · Miro · Loom · Slack · Teams
* **Tools you'll open when the team is stuck**
  : Databricks notebooks · dbt Cloud · Airflow UI · MLflow · LangSmith or Langfuse for LLM traces · Power BI Desktop · DAX Studio

What we're looking for

* 2 to 6 years in delivery leadership, project management, tech lead, or an engineering role you're moving out of into delivery
* This opportunity is ideal for up-and-coming managers who are ready to take the next step in their leadership journey and grow into a Delivery Manager role
* You've shipped data or AI to production. Even if you were part of the team, not leading it. You know what it takes because you've done it
* You still open the tools yourself: read a Spark plan, walk a notebook, look at a dbt run, spot a bad DAX measure, review an LLM eval report. You don't have to write the fix. You have to see the problem
* Comfortable in modern data and AI stacks: Databricks, Snowflake, Fabric, Azure, or similar. You've used them, not just heard of them
* Comfortable running Scrum or Kanban cadence: standups, planning, retros, tracking
* Client-comfortable: you can hold a working group conversation with data product owners and tech leads. You want to grow toward CIO and CDO conversations
* Process orientation: you like standards and playbooks. You don't resent them
* Design taste: opinions about what a good deck looks like, and you're willing to enforce them
* Knowledge management instinct: first thing you do after a milestone is write up what happened, and put it somewhere findable
* Comfort with the ambiguity of a scaling firm. This is not a Big-4 role with a 30-page methodology to hide behind

Bonus

* Started as a data engineer, ML engineer, analytics engineer, or BI developer before moving into delivery. Huge plus
* Contributed to a GenAI or agent platform in production
* Delivery experience in regulated industries (chemicals, pharma, financial services, life sciences)
* Familiar with modern engagement models (T&M, outcomes-based, staff-plus-IP bundles)
* Contributed to a team's playbook, methodology, or design system as a named author
* Certifications welcome, never required: Databricks, Azure, PMI-ACP, PSM, SAFe

Skills tags

Data and AI Delivery · Delivery Management · Project Management · Databricks Delivery · MLOps Delivery · Agile Delivery · Scrum · Kanban · Data Engineering · Machine Learning · GenAI · Power BI · dbt · Client Relationship Management · Team Coordination · Risk Management · Knowledge Management

d45061a7.title: Customer Engagement Manager
d45061a7.description:
**About Ema**
Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.
  
  
We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
  
  
**The Role**
The Customer Engagement Manager owns a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts end-to-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship, every expansion opportunity. Think of this as the McKinsey Associate Partner model applied to enterprise AI delivery.
  
  
You are the single point of accountability for your accounts. The customer calls you — not your manager — when they have a problem. You staff delivery teams, oversee solution quality, run executive readouts, measure ROI, drive adoption, rebuild trust when things break, and grow the book through proven production value.
  
  
**This is not a project management role.**
This is an account ownership role that combines delivery orchestration, outcome ownership, customer leadership, and commercial growth.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Account Ownership
* Own your accounts end-to-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship. Everything good or bad stops with you.
* Be the single point of contact the customer calls for any problem — delivery, quality, adoption, escalation, or expansion.
* Maintain a holistic view of each account: engagement status, risk exposure, opportunity pipeline, and the customer’s strategic priorities for the quarter.
* Run account planning: engagement roadmaps, resource forecasting, risk assessment, and growth strategy.
* Delivery Orchestration
* Staff and direct delivery teams (Engineering Leads, Product Managers) across your accounts.
* Oversee delivery quality across all engagements: review solution architectures, attend go-live rehearsals, ensure evaluation rigor.
* Manage cross-engagement dependencies within an account (e.g., shared integration infrastructure between parallel deployments).
* Serve as the delivery escalation point: join war rooms, coordinate fixes across Engineering and Product, and communicate resolution to the customer.
* You don’t write code — but you review architectures, challenge unrealistic scope, and ensure go-live readiness. Your leverage is orchestration and judgment.
* Outcome Ownership & Continuous Improvement
* Own post-go-live outcomes: adoption, ROI, accuracy, and user trust. This role absorbs the Outcomes Manager function for your accounts.
* Run regular usage readouts: AI deflection rates, false positive/negative trends, HITL escalation patterns, user bypass rates, and trust signals.
* Separate product gaps from process, training, or expectation gaps. Not everything that looks broken is an engineering problem.
* Drive continuous improvement cycles: readout → diagnose → prioritize → fix → re-measure.
* Communicate outcomes in business language: efficiency gains, cost savings, error reduction — not just dashboards, but diagnosis and action plans.
* Executive Stakeholder Leadership
* Run QBRs with VP/C-level stakeholders: present outcomes, risks, improvement plans, and the strategic roadmap.
* Navigate internal customer politics: when the VP of IT and VP of Business disagree on priorities, facilitate alignment around shared success metrics.
* Communicate bad news credibly: present the data, the diagnosis, and the recovery plan — without losing trust.
* Handle C-level escalations. When the CTO threatens to terminate or the CFO questions ROI, you are the person in the room.
* Commercial Growth
* Grow your book through outcome-driven expansion: deliver the first SOW excellently, measure ROI rigorously, present evidence to the C-suite, then propose the next SOW grounded in proven value.
* Identify new use cases by deeply understanding customer business processes and pain points — not by pushing a product catalog.
* Know when to push for expansion vs. when to stabilize. Premature expansion erodes trust. You earn the right to grow by delivering first.
* Co-sell with Sales: provide the delivery credibility and outcome evidence that makes expansion proposals close.
* Product & Platform Partnership
* Act as the voice of your customers to Product and Core Engineering. Translate field patterns into structured, actionable feedback — not one-off requests.
* Identify cross-customer patterns that signal platform gaps or opportunities.
* Partner with Product on customer-facing roadmap discussions: what’s coming, what’s not, and how to manage expectations.
* Team Development
* Coach Engineering Leads and Implementation Managers on architecture quality, customer communication, delivery discipline, and outcome thinking.
* Promote shared standards and best practices across engagements.
* Build reusable account-level assets: engagement playbooks, QBR templates, outcome tracking frameworks, and expansion qualification criteria.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 15+ years in enterprise technology delivery, consulting, account management, or customer leadership.
* 5+ years owning enterprise accounts end-to-end: delivery, outcomes, relationship, and growth — not individual projects within someone else’s account.
* Track record managing or directing delivery teams (Engineering Leads, TPMs, consultants) assigned to their accounts.
* Post-go-live outcome ownership: measured ROI, tracked adoption, driven continuous improvement, and rebuilt trust after production issues.
* Commercial accountability: grown account revenue through outcome-driven expansion, not just retention.
* Enterprise stakeholder management at VP/C-level across multiple concurrent accounts.
* Production track record — beyond POCs. Scale and accountability required.

**Preferred**

* Experience with AI, automation, or agentic workflow platforms in production.
* Background at a consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte) or enterprise SaaS PS org (ServiceNow, Salesforce, UiPath) in a delivery-heavy account leadership role.
* Experience with partner-mediated delivery (delivering through consulting partners to end clients).
* Familiarity with enterprise integrations (APIs, auth, CRM/HRIS/ITSM platforms) at a judgment level, not implementation level.
* Experience in a scaling startup ($5M–$50M ARR) where account management practices were being built, not inherited.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
  
  
Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Operations teams to identify opportunities, build scalable solutions, drive automation adoption, and deliver measurable business impact. You will lead high-visibility initiatives, investigate complex operational challenges, influence technical roadmaps, and ensure automation systems continue to operate effectively as the business scales. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, technical aptitude, ownership, and the ability to deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Partner with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Application Engineers, and Risk teams to define requirements and deliver scalable solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and operational scalability through automation and AI-enabled solutions.
* Use data and metrics to identify trends, evaluate business performance, and prioritize investments.
* Lead deep dives into operational issues, quality defects, and high-severity escalations, driving root cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Monitor automation performance, adoption, accuracy, and business impact through scalable reporting mechanisms.

* Translate business requirements into actionable technical requirements and work closely with engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.
* Drive end-to-end execution of automation and process improvement programs supporting Books Risk Management workflows.
* Communicate program updates, risks, and recommendations to senior leaders and stakeholders across multiple organizations.
* Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and automation opportunities to improve risk detection, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.

A day in the life
  
  
You may start your day reviewing operational metrics and automation performance, investigating a production issue impacting a critical workflow, partnering with engineers on a new automation launch, conducting a deep dive into quality trends, or presenting program updates to senior leaders. You will regularly work across business, product, and technical teams to solve complex problems, prioritize opportunities, and deliver scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.
  
  
**About The Team**
The BRM Automation team is responsible for driving automation, AI adoption, and process transformation across Books Risk Management. Our mission is to improve operational efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and protect customer trust by building scalable solutions that reduce manual effort, improve decision quality, and enable the organization to scale effectively. We operate at the intersection of business, risk, and technology, partnering closely with engineering and product teams to solve some of the most complex challenges in the Books ecosystem.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
