As an ideal candidate, you will have:
  
  

* Ideally, 12+ years of related experience in a customer facing role, minimum 7 years of pre-sales experience while navigating complex enterprise software sales cycles with multiple stakeholders
* Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity
* Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem
* Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
* Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership
* Presented at industry conferences, published articles, papers or blog posts sharing expertise and showing thought leadership
* Demonstrated ability to drive effective collaboration with Sales Leadership at the Regional Director level to proactively identify strategies driving growth across multiple Sales Reps / Accounts or Industry Verticals
* Demonstrated strong understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message
* The ability to travel up to 25%
* A Master’s degree or equivalent work experience

You may also have:

* Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
* Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks
* Experience in SRE practices
* Proven ability to up-level the broader organization - for example by sharing best practices or creating reusable assets

73f699ef.title: Solution Architect
73f699ef.description:
**About Us:**
Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.
  
  
Seismic is the global leader in AI-powered enablement, empowering go-to-market leaders to drive strategic growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences at scale. The Seismic Enablement Cloud™ is the only unified AI-powered platform that prepares customer-facing teams with the skills, content, tools, and insights needed to maximize every buyer interaction and strengthen client relationships. Trusted by more than 2,000 organizations worldwide, Seismic helps businesses achieve measurable outcomes and accelerate revenue growth. Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
**Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.**
**Overview:**
We are looking for a talented and driven Solution Architect to join our Professional Services team. In this role, you will design and implement integration solutions, collaborating closely with product and engineering teams to scope and deliver tailored solutions for our enterprise clients. You will serve as the subject matter expert on Seismic’s platform components, working alongside customers, project managers, solution consultants, and teams across different geographies to deliver seamless automations, custom solutions, and integrations.
  
  
**Who you are:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Four or more years of experience in Enterprise Content Professional Services.
* Three or more years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and testing API integrations and solutions, with above average knowledge of RESTful APIs.
* Strong knowledge of SQL, Web Service Consumption, SOQL, and Salesforce Reporting.
* Expert knowledge of Excel Model, SSO, SMTP, and Salesforce Setup.
* Expert knowledge of LiveDoc & LiveForm is preferred.
* Ability to lead projects with teams located in different geographies.
* Demonstrated experience leading requirements gathering efforts on large-scale projects.
* Strong written and oral communication skills with a proven ability to initiate and manage relationships with customers at all levels.
* Self-starter with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Demonstrates strong self-learning capabilities with the aptitude to quickly grasp new product features, technologies, and concepts.
* Critical thinking, analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capability.
* Advanced proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
* Understanding of New Product Development Methodologies and Emerging Technologies (Mobile, Security, Internet, etc.).
* Strong facilitation, project management, and organisational skills.
* Strong relationship development and people management skills.
* Experience collaborating with and providing business recommendations to management.
* Comfortable writing and troubleshooting Python code snippets.
* Experience utilising AI tools and building agents to drive efficiency and quality improvement.
* Experience in the Business Requirements Creation Process for a technical product or similar experience.
* Experience with Seismic or another Sales Enablement platform is a plus.
* Experience in Product Management on a Technical Product is a plus.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Collaborate with business development, product management, and engineering teams to define, design, and create integration solutions for complex client needs.
* Lead requirement gathering sessions with enterprise customers to understand business goals, technical requirements, and integration objectives; craft Statements of Work (SOWs) for large-scale projects.
* Translate business and technical requirements into detailed solution designs, architecture diagrams, and data flow documentation.
* Serve as subject matter expert on Seismic’s platform capabilities, APIs, out-of-the-box offerings, and custom integrations.
* Provide strategic and hands-on technical guidance to clients throughout the evaluation, implementation, and post-deployment phases.
* Communicate and present solutions effectively to client executives and technical teams, including participation in sales calls to address customer integration questions.
* Serve as technical lead across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality outcomes in collaboration with cross-functional teams across different geographies.
* Identify and mitigate risks in technical workstreams, escalating critical issues as needed.
* Develop creative, robust, scalable, and reusable strategies to support evolving business needs.
* Deliver ongoing support and services for existing customers in alignment with SLAs; manage customer escalations while seeking technical resolution.
* Conduct virtual and on-site training sessions to enable customer success.
* Mentor and support junior team members, fostering knowledge sharing and skill development.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to advocate for customer-driven enhancements and feature requests; promote and implement a minimum of one product enhancement per year.
* Seek out new industry and technology trends and apply this knowledge to solve business problems.

**What we have for you:**
At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.
  
  
Headquartered in San Diego and with employees across the globe, Seismic is the global leader in sales
**enablement**
, backed by firms such as Permira, Ameriprise Financial, EDBI, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and T. Rowe Price. Seismic also expanded its team and product portfolio with the strategic acquisitions of SAVO, Percolate, Grapevine6, and Lessonly. Our board of directors is composed of several industry luminaries including John Thompson, former Chairman of the Board for Microsoft.
  
  
Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.

da35f5d6.title: Architect, Apps & AI
da35f5d6.description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions - Global Center Innovation and Delivery Center (GCID) delivers end-to-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 1000+ exceptional people, GCID presents a great opportunity for highly skilled services professionals to make a foray into consulting, solution development and delivery roles.
  
  
The Architect is a senior leader responsible for the successful technical execution and delivery of complex client projects across diverse domains. This role acts as a strategic anchor between clients, senior leadership, delivery managers, project managers, and delivery teams. In the AI-first GCID organization, Architect(s) are expected to embed AI-native thinking into delivery models, ensuring solutions are intelligent, scalable, and aligned with business outcomes. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, demonstrates breadth of expertise, and advocates for solutions that deliver true client value.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**AI-First Delivery Leadership**

* Embed AI-first principles into delivery workflows, leveraging automation and intelligent orchestration where applicable.
* Own the Architecture and drive end-to-end delivery of complex projects, ensuring solutions are scalable, robust, and aligned with client business outcomes.
* Drive engineering excellence through reusable components, accelerators, and scalable architecture.
* Oversee technical execution across multiple projects, ensuring adherence to best practices, quality standards, and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to define strategies, delivery plans, milestones, and risk mitigation approaches.
* Act as a technical point of contact for clients, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure delivery models are optimized for modern, AI-native execution, including integration of automation and intelligent processes.
* Ability to step into at‑risk projects, quickly assess issues, and establish a credible path to recovery or exit.

**Engineering Excellence**
Promote high-quality engineering throughout all projects. Enforce coding standards, architectural integrity, and performance goals. Establish secure coding, TDD, and observability practices. Support ongoing learning and certifications. Advance modern methodologies like Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD for scalable solutions. Build a team culture of technical rigor, innovation, and accountability.
  
  
**Innovation & Thought Leadership**
Track new technologies to guide strategy. Drive innovation in delivery, assets, and tools for better efficiency. Promote best practices and continuous improvement across teams.
  
  
**Client Engagement & Solutioning**
Apply design thinking to develop user-centric solutions that also support business objectives, architecture, and project delivery. Collaborate with clients to identify their needs and provide guidance throughout each stage of the project. Participate in pre-sales and solutioning activities by preparing estimates, proofs-of-concept, and technical proposals. Additionally, maintain strong client relationships to ensure satisfaction and ongoing value.
  
  
**Team Management & Mentorship**
Lead cross-functional teams, promote learning and collaboration, and uphold technical standards. Review work, offer feedback, and support team growth.
  
  
**Quality & Compliance**
Ensure secure, compliant, and reliable solution delivery through secure coding, test‑driven development, observability, design reviews, and quality gates across all engagements.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 16+ years of experience in software/solution engineering, with at least 8-12 years as Architect and delivery leadership roles.
* Proven experience in leading delivery of complex, multi-disciplinary projects.
* Strong understanding of modern delivery methodologies (Agile, Scrum, DevOps, etc.).
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and team leadership skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Relevant certifications are a plus.

**Areas of Expertise**
**Full Stack Application Engineering**




+ End-to-end design and development of modern web and mobile applications using React, Angular, Next.js, Blazor, or equivalent frameworks
+ Strong backend expertise using .NET / Java / Node.js / Python, with clean architecture, domain-driven design, and API-first principles
+ Experience building microservices and distributed systems using REST, gRPC, event-driven patterns, and asynchronous processing
+ Hands-on expertise with relational and NoSQL databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB) and performance tuning
+ Strong understanding of state management, scalability, resiliency, and application security

**AI Driven Application Development**

* Proven expertise in AI‑driven application development, embedding intelligence directly into modern, cloud‑native applications.
* Extensive hands‑on experience using GitHub Copilot as a core engineering capability to accelerate solution design, coding, refactoring, testing, and documentation across delivery teams.
* Demonstrated ability to foster a Copilot‑assisted engineering culture (“vibe”) - enabling rapid iteration, AI pair‑programming, explain‑as‑you‑build workflows, and high‑velocity delivery without compromising engineering quality.
* Strong experience modernizing application landscapes using GitHub Copilot‑assisted approaches, including rapid codebase comprehension, dependency analysis, large‑scale refactoring, and migration to cloud‑native and AI‑enabled architectures.
* Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the entire SDLC, from solutioning and scaffolding through CI/CD automation, test generation, production readiness, and operational excellence.
* Ability to coach and enable teams and customers on effective Copilot usage patterns, prompt strategies, and safe AI‑assisted engineering practices in enterprise environments.
* Apply Responsible AI principles across design and delivery, incorporating security, privacy, governance, and compliance controls into production‑grade engineering workflows.

**AI-Enabled Application Development**

* Ability to translate business scenarios into production‑grade AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Azure AI Foundry, and custom ML models, with hands‑on delivery of RAG architectures leveraging Azure AI Search, vector databases, enterprise data grounding, and integration patterns.
* Strong expertise in prompt engineering, context management, grounding strategies, and LLM integration for copilots, conversational interfaces, intelligent workflows, and decision‑support applications.
* Proven experience designing and implementing single‑agent and multi‑agent AI systems, including task boundaries, tool invocation, memory management, collaboration, delegation, and coordination, using frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, and LangGraph.
* Deep understanding of agentic workflows, combining LLM reasoning with external tools, APIs, and enterprise data sources, alongside agent lifecycle management - planning, execution, retries, failure handling, and human‑in‑the‑loop patterns.
* Designs enterprise‑ready AI solutions with built‑in observability and operational excellence, including telemetry, prompt tracing, agent behavior logging, model metrics, experimentation, drift monitoring, and cost/performance optimization, while applying Responsible AI principles across security, privacy, governance, and compliance - balancing speed, quality, and enterprise constraints at scale.

**Cloud-Native Architecture (Azure)**




+ Deep experience designing cloud‑native, PaaS‑first solutions on Azure, prioritizing managed services over IaaS to improve scalability, resilience, security, and operational efficiency.
+ Proven expertise in architecting and delivering solutions using Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, AKS, Azure Functions, and API Management, selecting the right compute model based on workload characteristics and business needs.
+ Strong working knowledge of identity, security, and networking architectures, including Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Managed Identity, Key Vault integration, private endpoints, and VNET‑integrated application deployments.
+ Design and implementation of architectures that support high availability, horizontal scalability, disaster recovery, and fault tolerance, including multi‑region deployment patterns and resiliency strategies.
+ Experience in cost‑aware architecture design, applying cost optimization strategies such as right‑sizing, autoscaling, consumption‑based services, and proactive cost governance.
+ Apply Microsoft Well‑Architected Framework principles across reliability, security, performance efficiency, operational excellence, and cost optimization, incorporating architecture reviews and continuous improvement into delivery.
+ Hands‑on experience building cloud‑ready landing patterns, integrating application architectures with enterprise networking, security baselines, and platform standards.

**DevOps, Platform & Developer Productivity**




+ Strong expertise in designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions, enabling automated build, test, security scanning, and deployment workflows across environments.
+ Proven hands‑on experience with Infrastructure‑as‑Code (IaC) using Bicep, ARM, and Terraform, leveraging GitHub Copilot to scaffold modules, generate templates, and propose secure configurations aligned with enterprise standards.
+ Deep understanding of observability and reliability engineering, including centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, SLOs, and proactive alerting for production systems.
+ Demonstrated ability to enhance developer productivity and delivery velocity through inner‑source practices, reusable components, reference implementations, accelerators, and automation.
+ Experience embedding DevSecOps practices into delivery pipelines, including secure coding checks, dependency scanning, secrets management, policy enforcement, and compliance validation.
+ Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the DevOps lifecycle, including authoring pipeline definitions, generating runbooks and release notes, assisting with PR summaries, and accelerating troubleshooting and incident response.
+ Strong grasp of platform engineering principles, building paved‑road solutions and self‑service capabilities that balance speed, governance, and operational excellence.
+ Ability to continuously improve engineering throughput, quality, and system reliability, while maintaining enterprise security and compliance expectations.

**Solutioning, Pre-Sales & Technical Leadership**




+ Lead technical solutioning, estimations, and support architecture design during pre-sales and delivery shaping
+ Translate business outcomes into clear architecture, execution plans, and risk mitigation strategies
+ Influence technical direction across multiple teams and engagements
+ Act as a trusted advisor to clients and internal leadership

**Frontier Engineering & Customer Enablement Skills**




+ Lead rapid prototyping, pilots, and early-stage deployments for enterprise customers
+ Ability to go from whiteboard to production with minimal friction
+ Strong troubleshooting and production support expertise, including performance, reliability, and security issues
+ Side‑by‑side coding with customer engineering teams to unblock deployments and accelerate time to value
+ Outcome‑driven engineering focused on business impact, not activity
+ Building reusable assets, accelerators, and reference implementations
+ Comfortable operating in ambiguous, high-pressure environments with C-Level customer stakeholders

730e3fd6.title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Now Assist-HRSD
730e3fd6.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Now Assist & HRSD)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The role of Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of ServiceNow solutions focusing on HR Service Delivery as well as Now Assist capabilities (including AI agents, agentic workflows and now assist skills). In addition, this role would lead implementations to make ServiceNow as an orchestrator to call multiple AI agents within and outside of ServiceNow using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent-to-Agent protocol (A2A) to allow ServiceNow agents to invoke external data sets and APIs.
  
  
The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Implementation expertise of Now Assist capabilities (out of box and custom skills), agentic workflow and AI agents
* Experience in configuring out of box agentic workflows and implementing custom AI agents
* Understanding of A2A and MCP protocols
* Deep functional knowledge of LLMs, agentic patterns and API integration paths (REST)
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of HRSD and ITSM applications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

a5f54e78.title: Associate Program Manager
a5f54e78.description:
**Job Description**
eClerx is looking to hire an experienced professional with over 12 years of experience. As part of the Voice process team, your role will specifically focus on troubleshooting related processes. The ideal candidate will serve customers by planning and implementing strategies and operations; improving systems and processes; managing staff. Candidate will determine call center operational strategies by conducting needs assessments, performance reviews, capacity planning, and cost/benefit analyses; identifying and evaluating state-of-the-art technologies; defining user requirements; establishing technical specifications, and production, productivity, quality, and customer-service standards; contributing information and analysis to organizational strategic plans and reviews.
  
  
The leader must demonstrate an ability to anticipate, understand, and act on evolving customer needs, both stated and unstated. Through this, candidate must create a customer-centric organization and use innovative thinking frameworks to foster value-added relations. With the right balance of bold initiatives, continuous improvement and governance, the leader must adhere to the delivery standards set by the client and eClerx by leveraging the knowledge of market drivers and competition to effectively anticipate trends and opportunities. In addition, the leader must demonstrate a capacity to transform, align, and energize organization resources, and take appropriate risks to lead the organization in a new direction. As a leader, the candidate must build engaged and high-impact direct, virtual and cross-functional teams, and take the lead towards raising the performance bar, build capability and bring out the best in their teams. By collaborating and forging partnerships both within and outside the functional area, the leader must work towards a shared vision and achieve positive business outcomes.
  
  
Candidate must also possess an understanding of the repair process in Telecom and Cable industry, with an ability to analyze information and evaluate results to choose best solutions and solve problems.
  
  
Customer Operations Associate Program Manager Responsibilities
  
  

* Maintains and improves operations by monitoring system performance; identifying and resolving problems; preparing and completing action plans; completing system audits and analyses; managing system and process improvement and quality assurance programs; installing upgrades
* Accomplish human resource objectives by recruiting, selecting, orienting, training, assigning, coaching, counselling, and disciplining employees; administering scheduling systems; communicating job expectations; planning, monitoring, appraising, and reviewing job contributions; planning and reviewing compensation actions; enforcing policies and procedures
* Prepares performance reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends
* Meets financial objectives by estimating requirements; preparing an annual budget; scheduling expenditures; analyzing variances; initiating corrective actions.
* Maintains professional and technical knowledge by tracking emerging trends in BPO operations management; attending educational workshops; reviewing professional publications; establishing personal networks; benchmarking state-of-the-art practices; participating in professional societies.
* Accomplishes organization goals by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests; exploring opportunities to add value to job accomplishments.
* Ensure Critical Performance Metrics are met consistently
* Lead client/vendor reviews/calibrations
* Revert to client/vendor queries on routine issues
* Provide innovative ideas to optimize internal metrics & ensure critical matrices are met timely
* Manage multiple teams
* Perform audits and quality checks on Team Leads & Floor Supports
* Provide feedback to the Team Leads & Floor Supports periodically on their performance
* Ensure cross skilling and periodic process re-verification to ensure resource pool
* Perform Training Need Identification for teams
* Perform Bottom Quartile Management
* Ensure directives from senior leadership are percolated and acted upon
* Hold periodic meetings, discuss task delegation and review issues
* Conduct team huddles and meetings to discuss operational updates
* Build team spirit through group sessions, activities, and projects
* Focus on retention of staff through career mapping & guiding team members
* Advocate and follow organizational policies and procedures
* Adhere to the information security requirements
* Ensure all client deliverables met within timelines
* Ensure productivity/quality enhancement and process meet all metrics
* Remediation of any major incident
* Manage client MBR/QBR deck, client calls and reviews

**Minimum Qualifications**
Overall experience of 10+ years and should be a graduate or post graduate in any specialization
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Graduation in Computer Science, Computer Applications or related subjects

**About The Team**
eClerx is a global leader in productized services, bringing together people, technology and domain expertise to amplify business results. Our mission is to set the benchmark for client service and success in our industry. Our vision is to be the innovation partner of choice for technology, data analytics and process management services. Since our inception in 2000, we've partnered with top companies across various industries, including financial services, telecommunications, retail, and high-tech. Our innovative solutions and domain expertise help businesses optimize operations, improve efficiency, and drive growth. With over 18,000 employees worldwide, eClerx is dedicated to delivering excellence through smart automation and data-driven insights. At eClerx, we believe in nurturing talent and providing hands-on experience.
  
  
eClerx is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, per applicable law.

890e6ee9.title: Program Manager – Data Governance, LMAQ
890e6ee9.description:
**Description**
Amazon.com’s success is built on a foundation of customer obsession. Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like a clock work? To make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decision get made by machines and humans. Last Mile Technology team make this happen. The Last Mile Analytics and Quality team (LMAQ) works within Last Mile Tech to bridge the automation gaps on problems where no technology exists or the tech solution is in the works. The team has an eco-system of quality specialists, program managers and BI Engineers working together to improve geo-spatial data quality and support the driver lifecycle & experience programs.
  
  
As the team expands, we need a Data Governance Framework to identify and eliminate data and information security risks (current and future). The program manager will define the framework working with the program and tech teams, benchmarking and adopting the best practices from different teams across Amazon. Individual will own the framework and conduct the audits at regular cadence.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Will**

* Be a custodian of the data usage risks when liaising with internal teams to help drive tools and process improvements that affect secure management workflows
* Proactively identify pain points and opportunities for continual secure process simplification and improvement to create program efficiencies
* Monitor existing metrics, analyze data, and partner with other internal teams (e.g., engineering, finance, Business Operations, technical operations, Business Intelligence, Product management, Partnership, legal & public policy) to identify process and system improvement opportunities.
* Create compliance frameworks for use of AI technologies enabling stakeholders to understand and implement compliance requirements.
* Conduct AI reviews and audits to identify risks and implement risk mitigation measures. Collaborate with stakeholders to implement risk mitigation measures and monitor risks.
* Monitor AI and Data privacy regulations and advise business leaders and tech teams on emerging regulatory challenges.
* Create and publish Data Privacy risk review reports for leaders detailing the risks, root causes, impacts, risk mitigation measures, action owners and risk closure timelines. Monitor all the identified risks.
* Work towards improving the data privacy risk review process, improving the quality of the risk register, and identifying opportunities for automation and tools improvements.
* Drive the "Data Governance Training and Awareness Program," in collaboration with LMAQ Learning & Development Team, providing data handling training and data security Do's and Don'ts to the employees.
* Provide privacy-by-design and AI use guidance to business teams creating new use cases for analyzing customer data.
* Maintain comprehensive, high quality & up-to-date program & policy documentation that clearly outlines risks mitigations, standards, controls & policies.
* Periodically conduct internal audits & reviews on controls & processes to identify gaps & strengthen controls.
* Collaborate with internal information security, fraud and abuse teams to identify & mitigate risks.
* Act as single-threaded owner ensuring compliance requirements are implemented by establishing project plans, defining owners and milestones, reporting status to senior management and driving towards launch approval
* Work with product management and engineering teams to prioritize scalable technology solutions to enable business growth within compliance standards.
* Create clear compliance requirements for tech and product teams to translate into engineering requirements

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience in program or project management
* 7+ years of data governance, data privacy, risk management, use case/tool audits and reviews
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience with data privacy laws including GDPR, DPDPA, etc.
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with risk management, information security or compliance framework management
* Experience with stakeholder management including tech teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience of working in an product engineering organization
* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Software development experience, or experience of working closely with the tech, BI and DE teams

82f884d5.title: Technical Program Manager
82f884d5.description:
You own real programs across our enterprise tech landscape and drive them from ambiguity to Go-Live. Global stakeholders, hard dependencies, real budgets, no script. We hand you the outcome and get out of your way.

We're a small, senior team that takes craft seriously:

* Clean architecture
* Documentation people actually read
* Process that speeds work up, not down
* People we don't have to manage, and then don't

**What you'll own**

* Delivery across multiple concurrent programs: scope, timeline, budget
* Cross-project dependencies, risks, and the bottlenecks nobody flagged
* Scope and change control: assess change request impact, re-baseline cleanly, stop scope drift
* Stakeholders across Cloud, Security, Compliance, Infrastructure, Architecture, Application, and Business teams (global and zonal)
* Third-party and vendor coordination where programs depend on external partners
* Governance through SIT, UAT, Cutover, Go-Live, and Hypercare, including release and production change control
* RAID and decision logs that stay current
* Resource and effort coordination across your programs
* Delivery quality against governance, audit, and compliance requirements
* Exec and steering committee reporting that drives decisions, not just informs
* Financials: Budget vs. LE, forecasts, variance
* Delivery templates and playbooks so the next program starts ahead

**What you bring**

* 3 to 8 years delivering technology programs in large, complex enterprise environments
* Track record running several programs at once and landing them
* Range across Cloud, Infra, Security, Architecture, Applications, Compliance
* Command of governance, dependency, risk, issue, and scope-change management
* Delivery through SIT, UAT, cutover, go-live, and hypercare
* Vendor and third-party delivery coordination
* Financial fluency: budgeting, forecasting, variance, plus Excel and Power BI
* PPM/PM tooling (e.g. Planview, Clarity, ServiceNow, Jira Align, MS Project)
* Technical depth to challenge a bad assumption in the room (not a hands-on engineering role)
* Comfort when the path isn't drawn for you yet

**A plus, not a filter**

* MBA
* PMP / PRINCE2 / SAFe
* Global org experience
* Supply chain, manufacturing, or logistics background

**How we actually work**

* We don't wait to be told
* We own outcomes and challenge assumptions
* We escalate early and close issues, not just report them open
* We write things down
* We build for the next person, not the hero moment

If you want narrow tasks and a manager checking your work, you'll hate it here.

If you've been the one quietly holding a messy program together and wishing someone would let you run it, this is that seat.

940b8fc2.title: Consultant - CMC Program Manager
940b8fc2.description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**
**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.**
**At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**
**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**
**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**
CMC Program Manager, Technical Development
  
  
Role Description
  
  
The CMC Program Manager will oversee CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) timelines and workstreams across projects within the Technical Development (TD) Functional Excellence framework. This role is pivotal for extracting information critical for resourcing, strategic decisions, and the annual Business Plan. The incumbent ensures that CMC timelines are consistent and integrated, and that resource/vendor allocation is clearly understood to meet budgetary targets.
  
  
Acting as the operational data "engine" that informs broader TD Functional Excellence scorecards and platforms, this role interfaces between TPLs, the Project Management (PM) group, and TD Functional Leaders. The incumbent leverages project management expertise and TD knowledge to drive accountability, increase transparency, and improve spending accuracy across the portfolio.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
CMC Timeline & Milestone Integrity
  
  

* Integrated Timeline Management: Harmonize comprehensive CMC project timelines to extract critical data on siting, resource requirements, and potential constraints, enabling data-driven strategic decisions.
* Critical Path & Clash Analysis: Identify dependencies and resourcing "clashes" in CMC development paths to facilitate proactive risk mitigation and siting prioritization.
* TD Functional Excellence Support: Collaborate across the TD Leadership (TPLs, Functional Leaders) to integrate CMC operational frameworks (e.g., milestone definitions, suitable KPIs, leading/lagging indicators) into broader TD standards and support initiatives as needed.

Resource Tracking
  
  

* Specific Resource Tracking: Define robust mechanisms to track resource utilization (FTEs/Capacity) at the project and functional levels to flag constraints or availability.
* Business Plan Support: Directly support the yearly Business Plan process by providing accurate resource forecasts and conducting "what-if" scenario modeling based on portfolio priorities or potential project accelerations.

Financial Stewardship & Budgetary Oversight
  
  

* Budget Alignment & Forecasting: Partner closely with TPLs and the PM group to improve the management of project-specific CMC budgets, ensuring accuracy in forecasting and strict adherence to financial targets.
* Audit & Variance Management: Proactively audit project-specific CMC spending against the Business Plan to flag variances, and improve future forecasting accuracy.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor or Master level degree in a scientific field (Chemistry, Biology, Pharmacy, or similar).
* Several years of Project Management experience specifically within an R&D environment, with a strong focus on CMC workstreams.
* Demonstrated understanding of the Technical Development (TD) space, including regulatory requirements and manufacturing interfaces.
* Proven exposure to resource planning and budget management for complex programs.
* Ability to work effectively and influence global, cross-functional teams with or without direct authority.

**Additional Skills / Preferences**

* Strong experience with portfolio-level metadata and resource tracking tools.
* Deep understanding of the Innovation Cycle, MR process, and Business Plan process.

cd38b6c8.title: ORACLE - Solution Architect
cd38b6c8.description:
**About The Role**
As an Oracle Solution Architect, you will make an impact by solutioning Oracle and Oracle AI opportunities and leading pre-sales for the EMEA region, shaping AI-enabled transformation propositions and translating business priorities into secure, scalable and value-led solution roadmaps. You will be a valued member of the Oracle Centre of Excellence for Global Growth Markets team and work collaboratively with Oracle SLS teams, market CP/CRMs, and clients.
  
  
In this role, you will
  
  

* Lead initial customer conversations for Oracle modernization and AI-enabled transformation, identifying priority business outcomes, high-value use cases and adoption considerations.
* Lead Oracle and AI readiness assessments to build a phased modernization roadmap covering applications, data, integration, cloud platform, security, governance and change adoption.
* Design differentiated Oracle solutions that embed AI into business workflows across ERP, HCM, SCM and CX, with clear value realization, architecture and delivery plans.
* Lead multi-disciplinary teams across Testing, Legacy Integrations, Cloud Enablement and Change Management as solution lead for RFPs, bringing Oracle AI capabilities and Cognizant accelerators to customer opportunities.
* Establish responsible AI and security-by-design guardrails covering identity and access, data privacy, model risk, prompt and output controls, auditability and regulatory requirements.

Work model
  
  
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role's business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Pan India.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
What you must have to be considered
  
  

* Experience leading mid to large-size Oracle programs as a Solution Architect in transformation programs, with a deep understanding of the customer journey to Oracle and the various options available.
* Experience in pre-sales activities, including leading RFP/RFI responses as Solution Lead, and managing multiple streams within a program such as functional, integration, data migration and change management.
* Breadth of understanding of the overall Oracle landscape, interdependencies between modules and cross-functional integration, with strong awareness of the Oracle product roadmap and market trends across Fusion Cloud Applications, OCI, data platforms, generative AI and agentic AI.
* Hands-on understanding of Oracle Fusion Cloud embedded AI capabilities and Oracle AI Agent Studio, including agent design, orchestration, tools, security and lifecycle management.
* Working knowledge of OCI AI services and enterprise AI architecture patterns, including generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, APIs and integration services.

These will help you succeed
  
  

* Ability to act as a trusted advisor to customer program teams, represent Cognizant during Steering Committee meetings and engage with CXOs and department heads.
* Ability to assess AI use-case feasibility, data readiness, risk, operating model and total cost, and convert findings into a prioritized roadmap and business case.
* Experience defining responsible AI, security, privacy, compliance, observability and human-in-the-loop controls for enterprise solutions.
* Ability to create and present AI-enabled solution demonstrations, reference architectures and executive-level value propositions for business and technology stakeholders.
* Strong industry domain and process leadership skills, building trust in customer conversations.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

cce2ab2e.title: Assistant Manager – IT Infrastructure Solutions Sales
cce2ab2e.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Assistant Manager – IT Infrastructure Solutions Sales**

**Company:**
Vishant Solutions Private Limited

**Location:**
Bhubaneswar, Odisha

**Department:**
Sales & Business Development

**Position:**
Assistant Manager – IT Infrastructure Solutions Sales

**Experience:**
Minimum 3 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**About the Role**

Vishant Solutions Private Limited is looking for a dynamic and technically conversant Assistant Manager – IT Infrastructure Solutions Sales to drive business development and sales of integrated IT infrastructure solutions.

The ideal candidate should have prior experience with an IT System Integrator, IT Infrastructure Solutions Provider, Networking Company or similar technology organization and possess a strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying business opportunities, developing customer relationships, understanding technical requirements, coordinating with OEMs and internal technical teams, preparing techno-commercial proposals and driving opportunities from lead generation through order closure and execution coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Development & Sales**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities across corporates, PSUs, government organisations, educational institutions, healthcare, hospitality and other enterprises.
* Generate leads through direct customer engagement, references, networking, market visits, enquiries and tenders.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with IT Heads, CIOs, CTOs, Facility/Administration Heads, Purchase Departments, Consultants and key decision makers.
* Achieve assigned sales and revenue targets.

**2. IT Infrastructure Solution Selling**

* Understand customer requirements and propose appropriate IT infrastructure solutions.
* Be conversant with solutions such as:
* Enterprise Networking & Switching
* Wi-Fi & Wireless Infrastructure
* Structured Cabling
* Data Centre & Server Room Solutions
* Servers & Storage
* CCTV & Video Surveillance
* Access Control & Security Systems
* IP/Analog PA Systems
* Intercom & IP Communication
* Video Walls & Display Solutions
* UPS & Power Backup
* Fire Detection & Fire Protection Systems
* AV, Conference Room & Collaboration Solutions
* Cybersecurity Solutions
* Other integrated ELV and IT infrastructure solutions
* Understand solution architecture at a practical level and communicate the technical benefits and commercial value to customers.

**3. Corporate, PSU & Government Liaisoning**

* Establish and maintain professional relationships with corporates, PSUs, government departments, educational institutions and other institutional customers.
* Regularly visit prospective and existing customers and identify upcoming requirements, projects and tenders.
* Track customer requirements, budget cycles, upcoming projects, tenders and procurement processes.
* Coordinate with consultants, architects, project managers and other influencers involved in IT infrastructure projects.

**4. Techno-Commercial Proposal Management**

* Understand BOQs, specifications, drawings and customer requirements.
* Coordinate with the technical team and OEMs for solution design and product selection.
* Obtain and negotiate OEM/distributor pricing.
* Prepare and submit quotations, commercial proposals, compliance statements and technical submissions.
* Participate in commercial negotiations and follow up until purchase order closure.

**5. OEM & Partner Coordination**

* Develop working relationships with OEMs, distributors and technology partners.
* Obtain product information, pricing, technical compliance, authorization letters, project registrations and special pricing wherever required.
* Coordinate with OEMs for customer presentations, demonstrations, site visits and technical discussions.

**6. Opportunity & Sales Pipeline Management**

* Maintain an updated sales pipeline with accurate opportunity stages, estimated values, probability and expected closure dates.
* Regularly follow up on quotations, proposals and pending commercial discussions.
* Prepare periodic sales reports and business forecasts for management.
* Ensure systematic follow-up from lead generation to order closure.

**7. Project & Execution Coordination**

* Coordinate with the project/technical team after order confirmation to ensure smooth handover of project requirements.
* Maintain communication with customers during execution and address commercial/coordination requirements.
* Identify opportunities for additional business, AMC, upgrades and repeat orders.

**Candidate Profile**

**The ideal candidate should have:**

* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure sales/business development.
* Prior experience working with an IT System Integrator, IT Infrastructure Company, Networking Solution Provider, ELV/ICT Solution Provider or similar organisation.
* Good practical understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and integrated technology solutions.
* Strong techno-commercial sales capability.
* Experience dealing with corporates, PSUs, government organisations, educational institutions or large enterprises will be highly preferred.
* Good understanding of customer procurement processes and institutional sales.
* Ability to understand BOQs, technical specifications and tender requirements.
* Ability to interact confidently with technical as well as non-technical decision makers.
* Strong negotiation, presentation and communication skills.
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings and business development.
* Good working knowledge of MS Office, Excel, PowerPoint and CRM/ERP systems.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.

**Preferred Experience**

**Preference will be given to candidates who have:**

* Existing professional relationships with corporates, PSUs, government departments or institutional customers.
* Experience in selling multi-OEM IT infrastructure solutions.
* Experience handling RFQs, tenders, GeM, EOI/RFP/RFQ processes and institutional procurement.
* Experience in preparing technical and commercial proposals.
* Experience in solution-based selling rather than only product-based selling.
* Exposure to OEMs such as Cisco, HPE, Dell, Lenovo, Fortinet, Sophos, Aruba, Extreme Networks, Hikvision, CP Plus, Axis, Schneider, APC, etc. or equivalent technology brands.
* Experience in achieving sales targets in the range of ₹50 Lakhs–₹5 Crores+ annually, depending on previous role and market exposure.

**Key Competencies**

**IT Infrastructure Knowledge:    Strong**

**Solution Selling:            Strong**

**Business Development              :Strong**

**Corporate/PSU Liaisoning:       Strong**

**Customer Relationship Management: Strong**

**Technical Proposal Understanding:      Good**

**Negotiation Skills:         Strong**

**Communication & Presentation:           Strong**

**OEM/Distributor Coordination:              Good**

**Tender/RFQ Understanding:     Good**

**Sales Pipeline Management:    Strong**

**Commercial Acumen: Strong**

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Performance will primarily be evaluated on:**

* New business generated
* Achievement of monthly/quarterly/annual sales targets
* Number and quality of new customer accounts developed
* Qualified sales pipeline generated
* Conversion of enquiries into orders
* Gross margin achieved
* Corporate/PSU/institutional relationships developed
* Number of new projects identified and converted
* Repeat business and account growth
* Timeliness and quality of proposals and follow-ups
* Customer relationship and retention

**Education**

**Minimum Qualification:**
Graduate in any discipline. Minimum 3-5 Years of Experience.

**Preferred:**
B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA / MBA (Sales & Marketing) or equivalent qualification with relevant IT infrastructure sales experience.

**Compensation**

**Salary:**
Competitive and commensurate with experience, market exposure and demonstrated sales capability.

**Incentives:**
Performance-linked incentives based on achievement of defined business targets.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is not merely a salesperson. He/she should be a techno-commercial IT infrastructure professional who understands customer requirements, can discuss technology solutions confidently, develop relationships with decision makers, coordinate with OEMs and technical teams, prepare proposals and ultimately convert opportunities into profitable business. Candidates who have previously worked with System Integrators, IT Infrastructure Solution Providers, Networking Companies, ELV Integrators or Technology Solution Companies will be strongly preferred.

50d97362.title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
50d97362.description:
Location: Pune

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 3, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1745792

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics – Senior Manager - Databricks Architect**

  

EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.

  

**The opportunity**

  

Senior Data & AI Architect with 13+ years of experience in data engineering and data architecture, strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.

This role combines deep technical ownership of enterprise Lakehouse and data platform architecture with hands-on experience building Agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions on Databricks. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing large-scale, production-grade data pipelines, architecting modern AI-driven solutions, and engaging directly with clients on strategic proposals and solution design.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

  

* Architect, design, and deliver scalable Data & AI solutions on the Databricks Lakehouse platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, governance, and consumption layers.
* Design and optimize large-scale distributed data processing pipelines using Hadoop, Apache Spark, and PySpark.
* Build reusable, production-grade Python frameworks and pipelines for batch and streaming data engineering workloads.
* Define and implement cloud data architecture on AWS and/or Azure, covering storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring, with native Databricks integration.
* Own end-to-end ETL/ELT design, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality frameworks across the platform.
* Design dimensional data models (star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension tables, SCD) to support analytical and reporting use cases.
* Design and build Agentic AI solutions on Databricks, including LLM integration, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.
* Architect and implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions using Databricks — document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.
* Establish and enforce engineering best practices for Git-based version control, code reviews, and CI/CD across development, test, and production environments.
* Lead performance optimization and production deployment of Databricks jobs, workflows, and pipelines at scale.
* Participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, solution shaping, effort estimation, and architecture presentations.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor in customer workshops, translating business requirements into robust technical architectures.
* Mentor engineering teams on Databricks, Spark, cloud architecture, and modern AI/RAG engineering practices.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

13+ years of experience in Data Engineering / Data Architecture, with strong hands-on experience across Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.

* **Databricks**
  + Strong expertise in Databricks Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, and Unity Catalog.
  + Hands-on experience with Jobs/Workflows, performance optimization, and production deployments.
* **Hadoop & Spark**
  + Strong knowledge of the Hadoop ecosystem, HDFS, and Hive.
  + Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark and PySpark for large-scale distributed data processi
* **Python**
  + Strong proficiency in Python for building scalable, reusable, production-grade data pipelines and frameworks.
  + Cloud
  + Strong experience with AWS and/or Azure, including cloud storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring.
  + Experience integrating Databricks with cloud-native services.
* **Data Engineering**
  + Expertise in ETL/ELT, batch and streaming processing, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality.
  + Proven ability to design scalable, production-ready pipeline architectures.
* **SQL & Data Modelling**
  + Strong SQL skills, with experience in dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension models, SCD, and analytical data models.
* **Agentic AI**
  + Hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI solutions with Databricks, including LLMs, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.
* **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)**
  + Strong experience building RAG solutions using Databricks, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.
* **Git & CI/CD**
  + Strong knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews.
  + Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment across multiple environments.
  + Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles and/or Terraform is a plus.
* **Strategic RFPs & Solutioning**
  + Ability to participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, solution shaping, technical proposals, and effort estimations.
  + Experience delivering architecture presentations and leading customer workshops.
* **Client Communication**
* Strong client-facing and communication skills, with the ability to understand business requirements, translate them into scalable technical solutions, and clearly communicate architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

  

* Prior experience in a consulting, systems integrator, or client-facing delivery role.
* Relevant cloud or Databricks certifications (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer / Solutions Architect, AWS/Azure certifications).
* Exposure to enterprise data governance, MLOps, or LLMOps practices.

**What working at EY offers**

  

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

d31319b1.title: Lead Infrastructure Architect (Network Design, LAN/WAN, RFP )
d31319b1.description:
**Overview**
***WELCOME TO SITA***
SITA is the leading specialist in air transport communications and information technology. We don’t just connect the global aviation industry, we apply decades of experience and expertise to address almost every core business, operational, baggage, and passenger process in air transport. As an organization, we cover 95% of all international air travel destinations and work with over 2,800 air transport and government customers in every corner of the globe. Immerse yourself in the dynamic world of technology while embracing our collaborative, and inclusive culture.
  
  
**Ready to redefine air travel? The journey starts here, with you at SITA.**
**About The Role & Team**
Architect and design the solution to meet the business requirements of SITA customers predominantly in the pre-sales phase (RFPs or unsolicited opportunities) with focus on deployment, infrastructure, network architecture, and cloud architecture.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Manage technical solution in response to an RFP or unsolicited case that can consist of multiple SITA products (and portfolios), which includes new or evolving technologies and SITA solution portfolios.
* Design the deployment architecture and infrastructure specifications- servers and networking(LAN and WAN) for a solution to the customer’s requirements.
* Design deployment architecture for SITA products, including runtime environment in various flavours – on premise servers, virtualized server environment, containerized application environment through Kubernetes, public cloud, etc., to meet functional and non-functional system requirements.
* Design the network solution – both LAN/WLAN (in the airport) and WAN.
* Develop the conceptual design, and high-level design, and provide suitable inputs for the low-level design.
* Develop Bill of Materials:
* Compute & Storage and Networking.
* Specifications for - Servers, Virtual Machines, Containers (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes), etc. based on guidance from SITA's product toolkits.
* Storage - including backup solution
* Networking – LAN/WLAN components including switches, firewalls, etc. and WAN components including telco circuits, and also SD-WAN.
* Software Licensing requirements – Operating System, Database, Virtualization, etc.
* Other Infrastructure – Power (UPS), Racks, Cabling, etc.
* Guides and contributes to the design coordination and development solutions working with multiple parties both internally and externally.
* Contributes to the transfer of projects for implementation.
* Interact with colleagues to gain knowledge and to share ideas.

**Qualifications**
***EXPERIENCE***

* Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Technology and/or Engineering.
* 7- 10 years of experience in Information Technology, Air Transport, Telecom, or any other relevant industry in a technical Pre-Sales role
* Proven track record in producing communicating and documenting successful technical customer solutions
* Proven track record in managing solution proposals, costing, and customer presentation with great level of details.
* Expert in Network design WAN/Campus LAN, Cisco SDA, WLC, ISE, ACI, Nexus or similar technologies
* Solid experience in designing compute, storage, and networking solutions in all possible deployment scenarios – on premise, virtualized environment, private cloud, public cloud, or a mix.
* Solid experience in Security: IPSEC, Access-lists, NAT, understanding of Firewall functions
* Understanding of Cloud Connectivity such as Azure Express Route, AWS Direct Connect, is a great plus
* Understanding of Cloud Security such as Zscaler, Cisco umbrella is a great plus
* Understanding of Systems Monitoring – Network Monitoring, Security Monitoring (SIEM), etc.
* Understanding of Versa (or Cisco) SDWAN architecture, Salesforce and Service Now is a great plus
* Adept at drawing technical diagrams - good knowledge of Visio, competence in Excel and PowerPoint.
* Network design and standard vendor products
* Server sizing (virtualized environment and cloud) and software licensing
* Commercial Acumen

**What We Offer**
SITA’s workplace is all about diversity, many different countries and cultures are represented in our workforce. We collaborate in our impressive offices, embracing a hybrid work format. As part of our global benefits, we offer:
  
  
🏡
**Flex-week:**
Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your Team's needs).
  
  
⌚
**Flex-day:**
You may wish to flex your arrival time at the office, to beat the rush hours or you may want to leave the office earlier to pick up your kids from school or to go to your favorite game: We support you in being open about your needs and routine with you manager.
  
  
🌎
**Flex-location:**
Benefit for 30 working days from anywhere around the world each year!
  
  
🙌🏽
**Competitive benefits**
according to the local market
  
  
*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and self-identify in the application process*

46696e0b.title: ServiceNow Architect
46696e0b.description:
ServiceNow Architect

**Location:**
Pune

**Experience:**
8–12+ years (minimum 4–5 years as an Architect)

**Reports to:**
Head of ServiceNow Practice

About the Role

We are building a ServiceNow platform practice and its flagship solution.

As Architect, you will own the technical design of this offering end-to-end and set the architectural standards for the broader ServiceNow practice as we scale delivery.

What You'll Do

* Own solution architecture across ITSM, ITOM (Event Management, Discovery, CMDB), and Integration Hub for the AuditIQ platform and future offerings.
* Design the integration architecture connecting log/monitoring sources (application logs, infra telemetry) into ServiceNow via REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, and Integration Hub spokes.
* Define the pattern-matching and incident-correlation design — how known error signatures, anomaly detection, and duplicate-incident checks translate into ServiceNow workflows and data models.
* Establish CMDB and data model standards to support incident-to-CI linkage and historical incident referencing (root cause, resolution).
* Lead technical design reviews, environment/instance strategy, security architecture, and performance/scalability planning.
* Define coding standards, integration patterns, and reusable components for the delivery team to build against.
* Act as the technical anchor in client/pre-sales conversations — solutioning, effort estimation, and technical proposals.
* Mentor Lead Developers and Developers; run architecture governance and code/design reviews.

* Experience designing integrations with external monitoring/log tools (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, ELK, Datadog).
* Solid understanding of CMDB data modeling and the Common Service Data Model (CSDM).
* Experience with ServiceNow's AI/ML capabilities — Predictive Intelligence, Performance Analytics, or Now Assist — is a strong plus.
* Track record of solutioning and presenting to client/leadership stakeholders.

* Experience building a practice or offering from scratch (not just project delivery).

* CIS-Event Management

**Preferred**

**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly experienced and motivated
**Public Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME)**
specializing in
**Cloud Networking, IAM, and Database Technologies**
to join our DBaaS Platform Engineering team. In this role, you will serve as the technical authority driving the automation, security, and architecture of our database infrastructure across
**AWS**
and
**GCP**
environments.
  
  
You will design and implement secure VPC architectures, establish robust IAM frameworks, and automate the lifecycle of critical database platforms—including

—using
**Terraform**
as your primary tool. While this role is infrastructure-focused, you will collaborate with portal developers to integrate these automated cloud capabilities into our self-service DBaaS platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Architect, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade Terraform configurations to automate the provisioning, scaling, and management of cloud resources across AWS and GCP.
* Cloud Networking & Security: Design and implement secure, high-performance VPC architectures, routing, firewalls, transit gateways, and hybrid connectivity solutions. Serve as the SME for public cloud network design.
* Identity & Access Management (IAM): Define and enforce robust cloud security postures by designing fine-grained IAM policies, roles, service accounts, and least-privilege access controls across AWS and GCP.

+ MongoDB Atlas (multi-cloud deployments and integrations)
+ SQL Server on AWS (EC2-based deployments, clustering, and licensing optimization)
+ AWS RDS & Aurora (PostgreSQL/MySQL engines, high availability, and performance tuning)

* Operational Excellence: Provide tier-3 engineering support for complex cloud networking, IAM, and database infrastructure issues.

* Experience: 7+ years of relevant experience in Cloud Engineering, DevOps, or Database Infrastructure Engineering within a large-scale enterprise environment.
* Cloud Platforms: Deep, hands-on SME-level expertise in both AWS and GCP.
* Infrastructure as Code: Expert-level proficiency with Terraform, including modular design, state management, and CI/CD integration.
* Networking & Security: Advanced knowledge of VPC design, subnetting, routing, security groups, network ACLs, and cloud security best practices.
* IAM Expertise: Proven experience designing and managing complex IAM policies, cross-account access, and identity federation.
* Database Technologies: Hands-on experience deploying, managing, and automating:

+ MongoDB Atlas
+ SQL Server on AWS
+ AWS RDS and Aurora

* Scripting: Strong proficiency in Python or Bash for cloud automation and API integration.
* Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

* Containerization: Experience with Docker and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) or OpenShift.
