**Job Title: Solution Architect - SAP Supply Chain Planning & Digital Manufacturing**
The
**Solution Architect - SAP Supply Chain Planning & Digital Manufacturing**
is responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving SAP-enabled digital manufacturing solutions. The role covers SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud (DMC), SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (MII), SAP Manufacturing Execution (ME), and related SAP PP, EWM, QM, MM-IM, and PM capabilities.
  
  
Working closely with Manufacturing, Operations, and Plant IT, the role delivers reliable, scalable, and maintainable solutions that provide real-time operational visibility, enable intelligent production planning, and connect shop-floor activities with enterprise processes. The position plays a key role in improving productivity, quality, traceability, and regulatory compliance.
  
  
**Your Role**

* Lead end-to-end SAP digital manufacturing initiatives from discovery through design, build, test, deployment, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement solutions across SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud, SAP MII, SAP ME, SAP PP/EWM/QM/MM-IM/PM, and SAP ECC/S4HANA/EWM integration points.
* Collaborate with production, quality, maintenance, and logistics teams to map business processes to SAP capabilities (e.g., production planning, order execution, batch management, quality inspection, asset management, stock transfer).
* Design and configure real-time shop-floor dashboards, KPIs, alerts, and analytics to enable data-driven decision making.
* Integrate SAP digital manufacturing solutions with MES, ERP, IoT platforms, and third-party systems (e.g., PLCs, historians, SCADA, and OT data sources).
* Lead data modelling efforts for master data, bill of materials, routings, work centres, and production orders to support manufacturing operations.
* Define and execute testing strategies (functional, integration, regression) and support user acceptance testing.
* Establish governance for change management, version control, security, access controls, and data quality within SAP solutions.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to project teams, business analysts, and end-users.
* Prepare and manage project plans, budgets, risk registers, and status communications to stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, SOPs, and training materials for end users.
* Stay current with SAP product roadmaps, industry best practices, and regulatory requirements (e.g., GMP, ISO) impacting manufacturing operations.

**Who You Are**
Required Qualifications

d7dadcb1.description:
**Description**
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
  
  
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
  
  
You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web & mobile applications with data store technologies.
  
  
AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.
  
  
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
  
  
Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.
  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. You will be the domain expert guiding architectural design decisions, while demonstrating customer obsession to ensure high availability and performance of the customers applications. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and be curious while evangelizing the latest innovations and best practices in infrastructure, engineering and application design. You will mentor peers and customers while growing your knowledge.
  
  
As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.
  
  
**About The Team**
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 10+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of software development tools and methodologies
* Knowledge of AWS services, market segments, customer base and industry verticals
* 7+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or AWS Professional level certification
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* 10+ years' experience in designing and implementing large distributed systems, with deep expertise in core infrastructure, solution architecture, and distributed computing patterns.
* Professional experience in pre-sales consulting with proven presentation skills, executive engagement capabilities, and track record of effectively communicating with stakeholders at all levels while managing ambiguous requirements.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. 505c067c.title: Software Solutions Architect
505c067c.description:
**Summary**    

The Software Solutions Architect role is to lead customer-facing software development teams using C#, .NET, WPF, and C++. Beyond individual project ownership, youll guide multiple engineering leads, drive AI adoption, and deliver scalable, long-term software solutions while working directly with customers and stakeholders.

  
   
  **Position Overview**    

We are hiring a Solutions Architect to lead large, customer-facing software programs built on C#, .NET, WPF, C++, and Windows desktop technologies. This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who has grown beyond individual project ownership and can now guide multiple leads and engineering teams across complex workstreams. The role requires strong architecture depth, hands-on engineering credibility, delivery ownership, and the confidence to work directly with customers and stakeholders. You will drive AI adoption across the team, make sound technical decisions, challenge weak requirements, resolve ambiguity, and deliver software solutions that are scalable, maintainable, reliable, and built for long-term use.

  
   
  **Key Responsibilities**    

* Lead architecture, technical direction, and delivery execution across workstreams, owning design reviews, key decisions, and release sign-off.
* Define and drive engineering standards, design patterns, coding practices, clean architecture, SOLID principles, and reusable approaches.
* Review system designs, interface contracts, data flows, integration points, and technical risks across complex, multi-module environments.
* Provide technical leadership for WPF/XAML (MVVM, data binding, threading, performance) and C#/C++ development including native components, legacy modules, hardware integration, low-level interfaces, and performance-sensitive logic.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across multi-process, multi-threaded environments using logs, dumps, traces, profilers, and memory analysis tools.
* Own technical delivery planning, estimation, dependency management, risk tracking, and delivery readiness.
* Partner with customers, product, QA, DevOps, hardware, and business stakeholders to translate needs into practical, sustainable software solutions.
* Challenge requirements or approaches that introduce technical debt, delivery risk, or poor customer outcomes.
* Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, raising the bar on architecture thinking, debugging depth, ownership, and delivery discipline.
* Build alignment across local and global teams, supporting customer and cross-site engagements as needed.

  
   
  **Qualifications**    

* Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 12+ years of software engineering experience with proven delivery of complex software systems, including 4+ years in technical leadership, architecture, or large-scale delivery ownership.
* Experience leading large engineering teams, multiple workstreams, or Senior Technical Leads.
* Strong hands-on background in C#, .NET / .NET Core / .NET Framework, WPF, XAML, C++, and Windows desktop application development, with deep knowledge of MVVM, object-oriented design, SOLID principles, design patterns, clean code, and modular architecture.
* Strong understanding of multi-threading, asynchronous programming, memory management, inter-process communication, native-managed code interaction, and application performance in Windows environments.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across complex, multi-module, multi-process Windows-based software environments.
* Working knowledge of SDLC, Agile delivery, release planning, estimation, CI/CD pipelines, version control, code reviews, and software configuration management.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and customer-facing skills, with the ability to influence architecture and solution direction while balancing delivery commitments and long-term product quality.

  
   
  **Good to have**    

* Experience modernizing legacy C#/.NET/WPF/C++ applications or large Windows desktop platforms.
* Experience with performance profiling, memory analysis, UI responsiveness improvements, and reliability engineering.
* Exposure to backend services, APIs, databases, distributed systems, Windows services, Win32, native integrations, automated testing frameworks, DevOps, Linux, HPC, or high-performance computing environments.
* Experience with software connected to hardware, instruments, automation systems, manufacturing systems, inspection systems, or other complex engineering platforms.
* Experience working with customers, field teams, service teams, application teams, and globally distributed engineering teams.

  
   
  **What Sets You Apart**    

* You identify customer pain points and take ownership without waiting to be asked.
* You can lead senior engineers, influence architecture across teams, and make balanced decisions that protect both customer value and long-term product quality - even in ambiguous, high-dependency situations.
* You are equally comfortable in architecture discussions, delivery conversations, and direct customer engagement.

9bac961c.description:

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

**NTT DATA Job Description**
**Senior Azure Platform Engineer**
**Practice**
Platform Engineering, Cloud Platform team (Azure squad)
  
  
**Location**
India, offshore delivery centre
  
  
**Start date**
November 2026
  
  
**Positions**
x3
  
  
**Seniority**
Grade 9-10
  
  
**Reports to**
Engineering Lead
  
  
**Role Purpose**
You will be a member of a new Azure squad, building an enterprise Azure platform as reusable, versioned products: landing zones, Terraform modules, policy baselines, standard images and CI/CD pipelines, all consumed through a self-service developer portal. As a senior engineer you will own significant components end to end and help set the squad's standards from day one.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Platform engineering: Design and build Azure landing zone components — subscription vending, networking, identity integration, policy baselines and guardrails — as reusable Terraform modules.
* Component ownership: Own significant platform products end-to-end: design, build, test, documentation and release management.
* CI/CD pipelines: Build and maintain GitHub Actions pipelines for infrastructure delivery, with security scanning, policy checks, testing and cost controls embedded as quality gates.
* Azure Local and hybrid: Contribute to the engineering of Azure Local capability and hybrid automation, extending the platform model into the client's private cloud estate.
* Standard images: Build and maintain pipelines for hardened compute standard images (build, test, publication).
* Self-service products: Package platform capabilities for consumption as self-service golden paths through the Port.io developer portal catalogue.
* Engineering standards: Help establish squad conventions — code review discipline, module structure, testing standards and documentation — and uphold them through peer review.
* Mentoring: Support and coach the squad's mid-level engineers; contribute to design discussions with the Engineering Lead and Platform Architect.

**Essential**

* 10+ years: in infrastructure, cloud or DevOps engineering, of which 8+ years hands-on Azure engineering.
* Azure platform depth: Strong experience with enterprise Azure — management groups, subscription design, Azure Policy, networking (hub-spoke or vWAN), Entra ID and security baselines.
* Terraform: Advanced, production Terraform experience: writing reusable modules, managing state, versioning and testing infrastructure code.
* Secure platform engineering: Building secure-by-default infrastructure as a standard part of module design: identity and least-privilege design, guardrails and policy enforcement, and secrets management.
* Testing infrastructure code: Validating infrastructure code properly, through module testing, plan review discipline and pre-merge automated checks.
* Engineering discipline: Strong Git workflow, code review and documentation habits; experience working in sprint-based agile teams.
* Collaboration: Comfortable working in a distributed team with UK-based technical leadership and client stakeholders; clear written and spoken English.

**Nice to Have**

* CI/CD platform: GitHub Actions preferred. Azure DevOps or GitLab CI transfer directly.
* Hybrid: Azure Local, Azure Stack HCI or Azure Arc.
* Security tooling: Policy-as-code (OPA, Sentinel), IaC scanning (Checkov, Wiz, tfsec), and Terratest or similar module testing frameworks.
* Scripting in Python, PowerShell or Bash for automation tooling.
* Experience in financial services or similarly regulated environments.
* Microsoft certifications (AZ-104 Azure Administrator, AZ-305 Azure Solutions Architect, AZ-400 DevOps Engineer).

**Technologies & Tools**
The squad's toolchain:
  
  

* Core: Azure, Azure Local (Azure Stack HCI), Azure Arc, Terraform, GitHub and GitHub Actions.
* Policy and security: Azure Policy, Wiz and Checkov for IaC scanning, and OPA for policy-as-code.
* Pipeline quality: tflint, terraform-docs, Infracost and Terratest.
* Consumption: The Port.io internal developer portal, which is how teams consume platform products.
* Standard images: Image pipelines for hardened compute images.

With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

9a024ccd.description:
**About the Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced Azure Architect with strong expertise in Azure Cloud, Infrastructure Automation, Cloud Migration, Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, and DevOps practices. The candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and governing enterprise-scale Azure environments, leading cloud transformation programs, and driving infrastructure automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and security.

  

**What youll be doing**

  

**1.** **Azure Cloud Architecture**

* Design scalable, secure, and highly available Azure solutions aligned with business requirements.
* Define Azure Landing Zones, governance frameworks, and cloud operating models.
* Architect hybrid and multi-subscription Azure environments.
* Design backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and resiliency solutions.
* Establish cloud security, compliance, and cost optimization strategies.

2. **Cloud Migration & Modernization**

* Lead end-to-end cloud migration initiatives from on-premises and legacy platforms to Microsoft Azure.
* Assess current-state infrastructure and develop migration roadmaps.
* Plan and execute server, application, database, and workload migrations.
* Design migration strategies including Rehost, Refactor, Re-platform, and Modernization approaches.
* Manage migration risks, dependencies, cutover planning, and post-migration optimization.
* Utilize Azure Migrate and related tools for discovery, assessment, and migration execution.

3. **Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**

* Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) frameworks.
* Automate Azure resource provisioning using:
* Terraform
* Bicep
* ARM Templates
* Develop configuration management and orchestration solutions using:
* Ansible
* PowerShell
* Azure Automation
* Logic Apps
* Implement automated patching, compliance remediation, and operational workflows.
* Promote self-service provisioning and automated deployment standards.

4. **DevOps & CI/CD**

* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub.
* Integrate infrastructure deployments into automated release pipelines.
* Implement DevSecOps controls and automated compliance validation.
* Standardize deployment, testing, and release management processes.

5. **Infrastructure Services**

* Architect and manage enterprise infrastructure services including:
* Windows Server
* Active Directory
* DNS
* DHCP
* Group Policy
* IIS
* File Services
* Design secure hybrid identity solutions using Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory.
* Implement monitoring, performance optimization, and operational governance.

6. **Security & Governance**

* Implement Zero Trust and Security-by-Design principles.
* Design identity and access management solutions using Microsoft Entra ID.
* Establish governance, policy management, and compliance controls.
* Lead security reviews, risk assessments, and remediation activities.
* Ensure adherence to organizational and regulatory requirements.

7. **Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Provide technical leadership to engineering and operations teams.
* Conduct architecture reviews and technical governance forums.
* Interface with customers, business stakeholders, and leadership teams.
* Support solutioning, presales discussions, and cloud transformation engagements.
* Mentor engineers and promote automation-first culture.

**What you’ll bring to the team**

**1.** **Cloud Technologies**

* Microsoft Azure
* Azure Landing Zones
* Azure Networking
* Azure Compute & Storage
* Azure Backup & Disaster Recovery
* Azure Migrate
* Hybrid Cloud Architecture

**2.** **Automation & IaC**

* Terraform (Mandatory)

* Azure Automation
* Logic Apps
* Bicep
* ARM Templates

**3.** **DevOps**

**4.** **Infrastructure Services**

* Active Directory
* DNS

**5.** **Security & Governance**

* Microsoft Entra ID

* Microsoft Sentinel
* RBAC
* Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management (PIM)

  

**Preferred Qualification & Certifications**

3927f3d4.description:
**Job Description Cloud Engineer**

**Position Details & Role Overview**

**Position Title** :Cloud Engineer (Level 3 / Senior)

**Department** : Cloud Engineering & Technology

**Experience** : 10+years

**Employment Type** : Full-Time

***Location : Hyderabad WFO (Preferred candidates must from Hyderabad)***

  

The Cloud Engineer designs, builds, secures and supports the company's cloud and hybrid infrastructure, with Microsoft Azure as the primary platform. The role is the final technical escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents and owns them through to a permanent fix.

Security is part of the job, not a separate function: the engineer builds identity, network and workload controls into every deployment, monitors for threats, and supports audits. Strong hands-on skills in cloud networking, automation (Infrastructure as Code) and troubleshooting are essential.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

The work falls into eight areas: running cloud infrastructure, networking, identity, security monitoring, automation, recovery, incident ownership, and compliance.

  

**1. Cloud Infrastructure & Operations**

* Design, deploy and maintain cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure (VMs, storage, compute); AWS or GCP exposure is a plus.
* Act as Level 3 escalation for complex cloud incidents passed on by L1/L2, using logs and metrics to find root causes.
* Manage the lifecycle of cloud servers (Windows and Linux): provisioning, configuration, patching, upgrades and decommissioning.
* Support hybrid on-premises/cloud environments, including migrations and modernization projects.
* Monitor resource health, capacity and performance, and act before issues cause business impact.

  

**2. Cloud Networking & Hybrid Connectivity**

* Configure and maintain VNet/VPC, subnets, NSGs/security groups, route tables, firewalls, load balancers and DNS.
* Build and troubleshoot Site-to-Site VPN connectivity between on-premises sites and the cloud.
* Validate routing, firewall rules and network paths when diagnosing connectivity issues, working with network teams as needed.

  

**3. Identity, Access & Data Protection**

* Manage IAM, RBAC, MFA and Conditional Access, applying least-privilege access across cloud resources.
* Implement encryption, key management, and secrets management.
* Apply server and workload hardening baselines.

  

**4. Security Monitoring, Vulnerability & Incident Response**

* Set up security monitoring, logging and alerting; watch for threats and suspicious activity (for example in Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Entra ID).
* Run vulnerability assessments and drive patching and remediation to closure.
* Investigate and respond to cloud security incidents, and support security teams with evidence and analysis.
* Secure cloud workloads, containers, APIs and databases where they are in scope.

  

**5. Automation, IaC & DevSecOps**

* Build and manage infrastructure with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep/ARM or CloudFormation).
* Automate operations and security tasks with PowerShell, Python or Bash.
* Work with development teams to integrate security checks into CI/CD pipelines.

  

**6. Backup, Recovery & Disaster Recovery**

* Monitor and validate cloud backups (Azure Backup, plus Veeam or Backblaze where in use) and fix failed or incomplete jobs.
* Perform file, VM and server restores when needed.
* Take part in disaster recovery planning, testing and validation.

**8. Compliance, Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain cloud security standards, SOPs, KB articles, build documents, recovery procedures and architecture/network diagrams.
* Work with cloud providers, vendors and internal teams, and recommend improvements, including emerging cloud and security technologies.

  

**Required Technical Skills**

Candidates need hands-on production experience in Azure, cloud networking, identity and access management, and automation.

**Networking**

TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, routing, firewalls, load balancing, SSL/TLS and certificate management

Terraform, Bicep/ARM or CloudFormation; scripting in PowerShell, Python or Bash

**DevSecOps**

CI/CD tools and pipeline security integration

**Backup & DR**

Azure Backup and Site Recovery; backup monitoring, VM/server restoration, disaster recovery testing

**Hybrid infrastructure**

On premises to cloud connectivity, migration and coexistence

**Preferred Skills & Certifications**

**Preferred skills**

* Docker, Kubernetes and container security.

* Experience supporting 24x7 production environments, with monitoring and ticketing platforms.
* Familiarity with on-premises virtualization (VMware, Hyper-V or Proxmox) in hybrid setups.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Performance Expectations & Working Model**

The engineer is measured on keeping cloud environments secure, available and compliant, and on how quickly and permanently incidents are resolved.

**Job Information**
-------------------

* Date Opened 10/05/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Technology
* City Bangalore North
* State/Province Karnataka

* Zip/Postal Code 560077

**Job Description**
-------------------

About Flatworld Solutions

Flatworld Solutions is a leading IT and business services company delivering end-to-end technology solutions

across software development, data management, AI/ML, and digital transformation. Our AI Solutioning team is the

engine behind intelligent products and platform-driven engagements — translating enterprise challenges into

scalable, AI-powered outcomes for clients worldwide.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Lead – AI Solutions to own the end-to-end AI solution lifecycle: from early-stage enterprise

discovery and opportunity shaping, through solution architecture and product roadmapping, to client delivery,

enablement, and post-engagement knowledge transfer. This is a cross-functional leadership role that sits at the

intersection of AI product thinking, client consulting, and delivery orchestration.

The ideal candidate has built or managed AI/ML platforms (conversational AI, NLP, analytics), run enterprise

discovery with large clients, and translated ambiguous requirements into shipped product capability — not

bespoke services. You are a 0-to-1 thinker who can also operate at scale.

Key Responsibilities

A. Enterprise Discovery & AI Solution Design

* Lead discovery workshops with enterprise clients to understand business processes, pain points, and

automation opportunities across diverse industry verticals.

* Design AI solution architectures mapping client needs to platform capabilities — conversational AI, NLP

pipelines, analytics dashboards, process automation, and intelligent workflows.

* Create As-Is / To-Be process maps, solution blueprints, and conceptual prototypes that articulate the AI

value proposition clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

* Evaluate client technology landscapes (tools, data maturity, integration points) and recommend fit-for purpose AI approaches.

B. Product Roadmapping & Requirements Engineering

* Own the AI solution roadmap for assigned engagements — define scope, prioritize features, and sequence

releases aligned with client outcomes and internal platform capabilities.

* Translate enterprise requirements into productized features rather than one-off customizations; build

reusable, scalable solution components.

* Author and maintain solution documentation:
* Solution Design Documents (SDD) and Technical Architecture Specifications
* Business Requirements Documents (BRD) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRD)
* Scope documents, effort estimations, and Statements of Work (SOW)
* Wireframes, UI/UX flows, and interactive prototypes
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and acceptance criteria definition in Agile delivery

environments.

C. Client Delivery & Cross-Functional Orchestration

* Act as the primary solution owner across the engagement lifecycle — ensuring continuity from pre-sales

through delivery to handover.

* Lead cross-functional squads (data engineering, ML, design, QA) to ship AI solutions on time and at quality.
* Manage client communication cadence: status updates, risk escalations, demo reviews, and steering

committee presentations.

* Drive productization of repeating client patterns into reusable platform modules, reducing delivery effort

for subsequent engagements.

D. Client Enablement & Knowledge Transfer

* Conduct solution demonstrations, UAT walkthroughs, and executive showcases to client stakeholders.
* Design and deliver client training programmes: user guides, walkthrough videos, and FAQ documentation.
* Prepare comprehensive handover packages:
* System architecture and integration documentation
* Operational runbooks and support transition guides
* Closure reports, lessons learned, and recommendations for Phase 2 / expansion opportunities
* Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities during engagements; support pre-sales with client-informed

solution proposals.

E. AI Practice Building & Thought Leadership

* Contribute to building Flatworld’s reusable AI solution accelerators, reference architectures, and proposal

templates.

* Mentor junior business analysts and solution consultants on discovery techniques, documentation

standards, and client communication.

* Stay current with AI/ML trends (LLMs, Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG architectures) and evaluate

applicability to client engagements.

* Represent the AI Solutioning team in pre-sales pursuits, RFP responses, and industry events.

### **Requirements**

Required Skills & Competencies

* Proven experience managing or owning an AI/ML product or platform — conversational AI, NLP, analytics,

or intelligent automation.

* Strong enterprise discovery and consulting skills: ability to run workshops, extract requirements from

ambiguous briefs, and translate them into structured solution designs.  

* Hands-on experience with solution documentation — BRD, FRD, SOW, wireframes, and architecture

specifications.

* Deep understanding of AI/ML concepts: NLP, knowledge graphs, intent models, sentiment analytics, and

process automation pipelines.

* Experience converting enterprise requirements into productized capabilities (not just bespoke project

delivery).

* Cross-functional team leadership: track record of leading squads of 10+ across engineering, data, design,

and operations.

* Proficiency in roadmapping and prioritization frameworks; experience with Agile (Scrum/Kanban) delivery.
* Excellent client-facing communication — comfortable presenting to C-suite and technical audiences alike.
* Strong commercial awareness: pricing models, effort estimation, unit economics, and SOW negotiation.

  
Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related

field.

* 12 – 15 years of progressive experience spanning product management, AI/ML solutioning, and enterprise

delivery.

* Prior experience at an AI product company, analytics firm, or IT services organization with an AI practice is

strongly preferred.

* Certifications in AI/ML, Product Management (e.g., AIPMM, Pragmatic Institute), or Agile (CSM, SAFe) are

a plus.

Nice to Have

* Hands-on familiarity with LLM-based solutions, Generative AI platforms, or Agentic AI frameworks.
* Experience building analytics dashboards and data visualization layers for enterprise clients.
* Background in process automation (RPA tools like KAPOW/Kofax, UiPath, or Automation Anywhere).
* Startup or founding experience demonstrating 0-to-1 platform building capability.
* Exposure to phygital, content-tech, or media-tech product domains.

### **Benefits**

What We Offer

* Leadership role in a growing AI Solutioning practice with direct client and platform ownership.
* Opportunity to shape Flatworld’s AI product and solution strategy from the ground up.
* Work with enterprise clients across diverse verticals — no two engagements are the same.
* Collaborative culture with access to engineering, data science, and design talent.
* Competitive compensation, learning budgets, and fast-track leadership pathways.

42037fca.title: Marketing Channel Delivery Manager, EM MISP Cluster Markets
42037fca.description:
**Role Purpose:**

* The Global Operations Services Center (GOSC) is seeking a highly motivated Marketing Channel Delivery Manager to lead marketing channel and samples services for Pfizers International Markets in Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore and the Philippines. In this role, you will partner directly with local brand and marketing teams, BOPs, Digital and Commercial Excellence Innovation teams to develop digital and samples strategies that meet the needs of HCPs and patients, in adherence with global standards, compliance, legal and business requirements, on time and to budget.
* You will serve as a trusted advisor to your markets and work closely with the GOSC Delivery team to ensure the successful implementation of these services. Beyond your assigned markets, you will contribute to broader GOSC initiatives, driving innovation, continuous improvement and best practices.

  

In particular, the Marketing Channel Delivery Manager will focus on:

* **Samples Management**  for a high-volume, multi-market samples operation: annual sample plans, monitoring plans and work instructions, warehouse and logistics provider oversight, audit readiness and deviation management, ensuring compliance and efficiency.
* **Campaign Management**  capabilities through the planning and oversight of outbound (email) marketing programs, from brief to performance review.
* **HCP Portal**  (PfizerPro) to engage customers with promotional messaging and access to Pfizer products and services. Advise marketing teams on portal strategy to enhance the customer experience, including portal governance and above-brand oversight.
* **Social 2-way Communications**  rollout, oversight and scale, ensuring process execution, compliance and efficiency.
* **ePermission**  governance to support the customer acquisition strategy (collection, management, data quality and reporting).
* **Omnichannel reporting**  management and oversight to measure omnichannel performance and guarantee KPI consistency across global standard dashboards.

  

**Main Role responsibilities** :

* Develop strong relationships with local brand, marketing and customer-facing teams, gaining a deep understanding of each markets priorities, customers and channel needs.
* Build and maintain a clear plan per market, agreed with local business leaders, defining where Marketing Channel Delivery services add most value and how success will be measured.
* Translate global standards, platform changes and new capabilities into clear, actionable plans for your markets, driving adoption, compliance and consistent ways of working.
* Partner with the GOSC Delivery team to ensure timely, accurate and effective execution of channel and samples services: define requirements and quality expectations, monitor service levels and manage escalations to resolution.
* Collaborate effectively across Marketing, Medical, Legal, Compliance, Digital, Centers of Excellence and other partner functions, ensuring approvals and compliance standards are met on time and to budget.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to omnichannel teams, recommending how to structure campaigns, portals and customer journeys that maximise value across touch points.
* Lead training and capability building for marketing and customer-facing colleagues on channel and samples platforms, processes and best practices.
* Use data, dashboards and KPIs to evaluate channel and samples performance, generate insights and oversee channel adoption
* Maintain audit readiness through accurate documentation and ensure adherence to all relevant policies, procedures and Legal and Compliance standards.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives across GOSC, identifying opportunities for automation, simplification and AI-enabled ways of working, and driving best practices across international markets.

  

**Qualifications**

* **BA required; MBA or equivalent Masters-level education preferred.**
* **5 -12 years of experience in Digital or Omnichannel marketing, Marketing operations or Commercial operations, ideally in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or healthcare sector.**
* **Experience in medical samples management and its compliance requirements (sample plans, monitoring, audit readiness) is a strong advantage.**
* Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills across multiple markets and functions, with the ability to build credibility and drive decisions without direct authority.
* Experience partnering with delivery teams or service providers to define requirements, manage quality and resolve escalations.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work with metrics and KPIs and translate insights into action.
* Passion for digital innovation and AI, with a track record of simplifying or improving processes.
* High degree of ownership and agility, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and independently drive programs to completion.
* Fluent English required; additional regional languages are an advantage. Ability to work across Asia-Pacific time zones.

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on   Pfizer Careers  .

3a1d1ba5.title: Product Program Manager RAD and Change Management
3a1d1ba5.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

Lead Product Program Management for RAD subsystem products X-Ray Tubes and X-Ray Generators for mobile and fixed radiography systems. Drive Engineering design changes and Product Life Cycle Management for X-Ray Tubes and X-Ray Generators at GEBEL.
  
Own installed-base product performance and drive improvements in quality, reliability, regulatory compliance, lifecycle, cost and delivery, while leveraging installed-base data to establish reliability targets and Design for Reliability for new product introductions.  
  
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own field and factory performance of RAD Tubes and Generators, with focus on quality, reliability, compliance, cost and delivery.
* Monitor field performance and Early Life Failure (ELF) trends using FoA, IPFR90 and IPFR180 metrics and represent product performance in global reviews.
* Analyze field and reliability data using statistical methods, including Weibull analysis and B10/B50 life estimation, to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Lead customer complaint and field failure investigations, including field-return autopsy, failure analysis, RCA, corrective actions and product fixes.
* Partner with System Engineering, Field Engineering and Service teams for technical troubleshooting, product training and resolution of field issues.
* Support NPIs with reliability target setting, leveraging installed-base performance, failure trends and reliability insights.
* Support Risk Management activities, including DFMEA/PFMEA, design reviews, Verification & Validation and risk assessments.
* Maintain Technical Files, Risk Management and Design Control documentation, ensuring QMS compliance and audit readiness.
* Lead product lifecycle initiatives covering obsolescence, product improvements, regulatory compliance and Variable Cost Productivity (VCP).
* Chair Engineering Change Control Board (ECCB) reviews and drive timely, technically rigorous and QMS-compliant engineering changes for X-Ray Tubes and Generators.
* Serve as Engineering BPOC for Supplier Change Requests (SCRs), including initial impact assessment, cross-functional coordination and assignment of change owners.
* Represent Engineering during QMS, regulatory, certification and customer audits, and support Quality Management Reviews.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Service, Supplier Quality and Sourcing to improve product quality, manufacturing yield, reliability and cost.
* Apply statistical methodologies to drive structured problem solving, RCA and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s / Master’s / Phd in Electrical and Electronics/Mechanical Engineering discipline.
* 8+ years of engineering experience, preferably in medical devices, medical imaging, X-Ray products or other highly regulated industries.
* Experience in Installed Base Engineering, Engineering Change Management, Design Controls, Risk Management and Product Lifecycle Management.
* Strong experience in field performance monitoring, failure analysis, RCA, reliability engineering and statistical data analysis.
* Working knowledge of Weibull analysis, B10/B50 life estimation, reliability target setting and Design for Reliability .
* Working knowledge of medical-device and X-Ray Tube/Generator product safety standards, QMS requirements and regulatory compliance, including applicable IEC 60601, ISO 13485 and ISO 14971 requirements.
* Working knowledge of QMS and Design Control tools, including DFMEA/PFMEA, Risk Management, Design Reviews, Verification & Validation, ECR/ECO, CAPA and configuration/change management.
* Experience with Supplier Change Management, obsolescence, product quality improvement and manufacturing/yield improvement.
* Familiarity with structured problem-solving tools such as 5-Why, Fishbone, Pareto analysis and statistical analysis.
* Six Sigma Green Belt certification preferred.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong technical leadership, systems thinking and structured problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate field and reliability data into product improvements and NPI reliability targets.
* Strong analytical, statistical and risk-based decision-making capability.
* Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across global cross-functional teams.
* Strong execution focus across quality, reliability, compliance, cost and delivery.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and technical documentation skills.
* Self-driven and results-oriented, with a strong focus on continuous improvement and execution excellence.

**Inclusion and Diversity**

GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Our **total rewards** are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

Never send money to anyone suggesting they can provide employment with GE HealthCare. If you suspect you have received a fraudulent call , please fill out the form below:* https://www.ge.com/careers/fraud

* Demonstrate expertise in creating concise briefs and presentations tailored to stakeholder needs, enabling effective decision-making at all level

* Build strategic partnerships with key stakeholder groups across the organization

* Experienced with 3+ years of IT and/or engineering background

* Capable of participating in product reviews and design discussions, effectively articulating trade-offs, decisions, outcomes, and next steps
* Adept in use of AI in Program management for reporting, task tracking and day to day operations
* Skilled at communicating across a diverse set of engineers and stakeholders
* Capable of deep user empathy and adept at balancing product goals and engineering constraints to deliver impactful experiences
* Hyper-organized and capable of coordinating across multiple independent work streams and organizations
* A role model for effective execution practices, driven by an attuned sense of priority and urgency
* Able to leverage their experience in program delivery to influence improvements to our tools, operations, architecture

**About MongoDB**

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

35049a77.title: Principal, Technical Program Manager
35049a77.description:
About TeamGDF sits at the core of Walmart's AI & Data organization, building the foundational data platforms that make it possible for every team at Walmart — technical or non-technical — to build with trustworthy, well-governed, discoverable data. Our platforms serve billions of transactions and interactions across 19 countries, powering everything from supply chain intelligence to customer-facing personalization to enterprise AI agents. This particular team is newly formed to solve one of GDF's next big platform bets — which means you'll be shaping charter, operating model, and delivery cadence essentially from a blank page, not inheriting someone else's playbook.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Serve as the founding TPM for a newly created platform team — standing up program structure, delivery cadence, and governance where none previously existed.
  
  
Manage large, cross-cutting software/platform development programs end-to-end, partnering closely with architects and engineering leaders on architectural decision-making.
  
  
Define goals, stage gates, critical delivery paths, and key deliverables for programs spanning multiple workstreams, dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints.
  
  
Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships across GDF, AI & Data, and downstream consuming teams — driving alignment on roles, responsibilities, and delivery cadences.
  
  
Establish a resource capacity allocation process and tooling to bring planning rigor to a fast-moving, newly formed org.
  
  
Drive efficient engineering resource utilization; simplify and clarify priorities into plans with milestones suitable for advance planning and executive buy-in.
  
  
Identify and champion AI-augmented program management practices — e.g., using AI to auto-summarize status updates, flag at-risk milestones from ticket/PR signal, or generate stakeholder-ready reporting — and work with tooling/eng leads to actually implement them.
  
  
Navigate setbacks and ambiguity with strong problem-solving and decision-making skills — this is a 0→1 team, so comfort operating without a fully paved path is essential.
  
  
Represent the platform team in leadership/executive reviews, translating technical delivery status into business-relevant narrative.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent; 15+ years of overall technical experience, including 10+ years in a Technical Program Management leadership role delivering software programs with aggressive schedules and significant business impact.
  
  
Proven experience standing up new programs/teams from scratch — comfortable defining process, cadence, and governance rather than just operating within an existing one.
  
  
Strong leadership skills, with the ability to effectively manage and motivate a team of technical program managers and engineers.
  
  
Experience supporting and executing a large software/platform portfolio while collaborating with multiple business stakeholders.
  
  
Solid grounding in system/platform design concepts, architecture, technical design, services, APIs, and data platform technologies (data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, governance frameworks).
  
  
AI-forward program management skillset:Practical experience using GenAI tools (e.g., Copilot-style assistants, internal LLM platforms) to accelerate program artifacts — status reports, risk summaries, requirement drafts, meeting-notes-to-action-items.
  
  
Familiarity with AI-assisted meeting intelligence (e.g., auto-transcription/summarization of Teams/Zoom calls) and using it to close the loop on decisions and action items faster.
  
  
Working understanding of how AI/ML and agentic systems get built and deployed (MLOps basics, model lifecycle, data quality dependencies) — enough to program-manage platform work that directly enables AI use cases.
  
  
Curiosity and judgment to identify where AI genuinely helps a program (signal, not noise) versus where it's a distraction.
  
  
Ability to build positive relationships with product managers, translating target personas and business needs into features/user stories engineers can act on.
  
  
Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a love for data and solving complex, ambiguous problems.
  
  
Expertise in change & risk management methodologies, project tracking tools, dashboards, and executive reporting.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communicator — equally adept communicating upward, outward, and downward.
  
  
Deep hands-on familiarity with JIRA, JIRA Align, Big Picture, Airtable, or equivalent program tooling.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

386313b9.description:

2db7859a.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
2db7859a.description:
**About The Team**
Zillow's People Technology organization builds and operates the platforms that power how Zillow employees work: Workday, ServiceNow, and the agentic AI layer connecting these systems to the surfaces employees use every day - Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, and AI tools. The India engineering team owns this platform stack end to end: production access, change ownership, on-call rotation, and direct relationships with the business teams we support.
  
  
Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
  
  
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.**
Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Sr. Technical Program Manager, you are the connective tissue of the PeopleTech delivery model. You own the sprint cadence, the handoff quality gate between Product and Engineering, and the cross-team coordination that keeps India-based engineering and US-based product and business partners in sync. You are a single, senior individual contributor - not a team of TPMs - which means you need to be decisive, organized, and confident operating across time zones without a lot of structural backup.
  
  
You will work directly with the Product Managers (US-based) and the India Engineering team, and will be a key voice in how the model matures over time. This is a high-visibility role in a new operating model that is still being built; you will help define how it works, not just execute inside it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own sprint execution end to end: create and close sprints in Jira, run grooming and planning, lead standup, track capacity and velocity, and ensure all stories are estimated and complete before each sprint closes.
* Serve as the handoff quality gate between Product and Engineering: review stories for build readiness before sprint commitment, flag ambiguity or missing technical context, and resolve open requirements questions in partnership with PM and Engineering before work begins.
* Own the US-India coordination bridge: run a daily touchpoint with the PM to carry blocker and handoff status, facilitate the overlap-window ceremonies (grooming, sprint planning, sprint demo) where PM and Engineering both need to be present, and maintain async-first practices that keep live meeting load low.
* Manage cross-team dependencies and risks: identify sequencing issues and resource constraints early, route blockers to the right owner (Engineering or PM), and escalate to leadership when something threatens delivery.
* Coordinate Unit Test logistics: manage test resources, defect tracking, and the communication between Engineering and the PM during unit testing cycles.
* Document the team's operational model: post-launch on-call and support structure, escalation paths, and the handoff from project delivery into business-as-usual operations.
* Drive continuous improvement: use retrospective findings to sharpen handoff processes, story quality, and sprint predictability over time; build and share repeatable practices that improve how the team works.
* Apply AI tools to program work: status synthesis, risk and dependency tracking, meeting notes and follow-ups, draft communications - and help the broader team build that fluency.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
  
  
Who you are
  
  

* 5-8 years of technical program or project/scrum team management experience delivering complex, cross-functional programs in enterprise SaaS or platform environments.
* Demonstrated ownership of programs spanning multiple teams end to end, including programs where you defined scope and goals yourself in ambiguous conditions.
* Strong technical fluency: you can understand and explain how Workday, ServiceNow, or comparable enterprise platforms fit together, reason about integration dependencies, and assess whether a user story is ready to build - without needing to write the code yourself.
* Demonstrated working knowledge of Workday HCM or ServiceNow (module configuration, integrations, annual HR cycles, security model basics).
* Experience operating in a distributed or offshore/nearshore engineering model, with US-based product and business partners - you understand how to design for async-first collaboration and how to use overlap hours well.
* Best-in-class Jira and sprint management skills: you run ceremonies cleanly, keep the board accurate, and produce sprint summaries that give leadership a clear picture without requiring a meeting.
* Strong communication across technical and non-technical audiences, including senior executives - you know what altitude is right for each conversation.
* Track record of influencing without authority, resolving blockers, and driving cross-org alignment on decisions.
* Fluent with AI tools for program management and able to help others build that fluency.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Get to know us
  
  
At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
  
  
Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
  
  
No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
  
  
*Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.*
*If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.*
*Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.*

**Description**
Are you passionate about cloud computing? Do you have a unique combination of deep technical knowledge, business acumen and strong interpersonal skills? Are you passionate about building the world's best technology teams?
  
  
Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
  
  
This job opening is for a Senior Leader, Solution Architecture role focused on building solutions for customers around AWS platform services and industry solutions. It sits within the Public Sector team of Amazon Web Services India Private Limited.
  
  
We work with central government ministries, state and local governments, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), education institutions, EdTech startups (including India-based unicorns), non-profits, and healthcare organizations. Our vision is to be part of India's growth journey helping institutions make a significant impact on the lives of citizens by taking a technology-generation leap through AWS cloud services.
  
  
In this role, you will need to be technically capable and credible in your own right. You will partner with business leaders to lead thought-leadership conversations with customers on AWS services and platforms. You will interact, communicate, and partner across AWS including service teams, marketing, and business development and represent AWS to executive management.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Work with business leaders and fellow Solutions Architects to convey cloud computing best practices and build reference architectures across compute, storage, enterprise applications, developer technologies, and industry solutions.
* Develop strategy with Specialist Solutions Architects to enable the wider AWS business to succeed.
* Partner with Professional Services, service teams, and AWS Support to drive customer success.
* Plan, review, and author technical content (such as white papers and reference architectures) that customers can use to deploy secure, cloud-based solutions.
* Facilitate knowledge assessment across AWS business development and Solutions Architecture teams, and develop plans to address gaps.
* Work with industry groups to influence trends in cloud computing.
* Represent AWS at conferences, events, and meetups.

**Basic Qualifications**

01e8af71.title: Sr. Staff AI Architect
01e8af71.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

**About Company:**

ThermoFisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with revenues of more than $25 billion and approximately 1,30,000 employees globally. We help our customers accelerate life sciences research, solve elite analytical challenges, improve patient diagnostics, deliver medicines to market, and increase laboratory efficiency.

Through our world-class brands—Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, and Unity Lab Services—we offer an unmatched combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience, and comprehensive services.

**About Team:**

We are the Digital Foundation Platform team - the software center of excellence (CoE) for Thermo Fisher Scientific. We are responsible for developing and delivering foundational components and SaaS-based applications and digital lab (Cloud-based) tools, foundational AI and AI agentic solutions, to help scientists do their work more efficiently and with precision, enabling them to make our world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Our elite software products and solutions accelerate scientific discovery and lab productivity. These solutions

* Provide rich content, selection tools, teamwork tools, and scientific apps that allow our customers to focus on innovation and the complexities of their science.
* Build a connected world for our customers where discoveries happen in a thoughtful way — where every device/product is connected, self-aware, and self-healing—thereby enabling efficient workflows and collaborative science.
* Enable our customers to efficiently handle their labs by providing them with insight into workflow processes, asset uptime, and product availability.

We give them the flexibility to access what they need when they need it, allowing them to select and receive products and services across multiple channels. We apply industry-standard methodologies to the design, development, and deployment of best-in-class software products built to demonstrate the power and scalability of the cloud.  
  
**Purpose:**  
  
The Senior Staff Architect provides **enterprise-wide architectural, design, and technical leadership** for Generative AI and agentic AI solutions across multiple Scrum teams. As a strategic technical leader and hands-on architect, you will define the architecture, standards, and roadmap for an enterprise **agentic harness** that enables agents to reason, plan, use tools, access knowledge, maintain state, collaborate, and operate safely at scale.

The role requires deep expertise in designing **production-grade agentic systems**, cloud-native platforms, RAG architectures, LLM integrations, and AI engineering practices. You will influence platform strategy, mentor architects and engineers, and ensure AI-driven systems are **scalable, secure, resilient, observable, governable, and production-ready**.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Technical Leadership, Architecture & Design**

* Provide **enterprise architecture leadership** for Generative AI and agentic AI platforms across multiple teams.
* Define the architecture and roadmap for a reusable **agentic harness and runtime platform**.
* Own **high-level and low-level system design**, including component architecture, data flows, integration patterns, deployment topologies, and runtime interactions.
* Design and evolve **cloud-native, event-driven, API-first, and distributed architectures** for AI-enabled products.
* Define reference architectures, design standards, and best practices for:
  + Agentic systems
  + Multi-agent orchestration
  + RAG and knowledge-grounded agents
  + Tool and function execution
  + Agent memory and state management
  + Human-in-the-loop workflows
  + Agent-to-Agent communication
* Define architecture patterns for agent planning, task decomposition, reasoning, execution, retries, timeouts, compensation, and failure recovery.
* Establish standards for agent lifecycle management, including agent creation, versioning, testing, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retirement.
* Act as the **go-to authority** for architecture, design trade-offs, scalability decisions, and complex implementation challenges.
* Ensure architectural decisions address **Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)**, including performance, scalability, security, reliability, privacy, governance, cost, and observability.
* Lead architecture reviews, design reviews, technical investigations, and architecture decision records.

### **Agentic AI and Generative AI Engineering**

* Design and implement agentic systems using **LangGraph**, **LangChain**, and comparable orchestration frameworks.
* Architect the core capabilities of an agentic harness, including:
  + Agent runtime and execution management
  + Planning and task orchestration
  + Tool registry and tool discovery
  + Function calling and API integration
  + Agent memory and context management
  + Workflow state persistence
  + Multi-agent collaboration
  + Human approvals and intervention
  + Guardrails and policy enforcement
  + Execution tracing, auditability, and replay
* Design model-agnostic architectures supporting **Azure OpenAI**, **Anthropic Claude**, OpenAI-compatible APIs, and local models using **Ollama**.
* Define model routing, fallback, provider abstraction, latency optimization, token management, and cost-control strategies.
* Architect and implement **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)** solutions, including document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, grounding, and response synthesis.
* Integrate agents with APIs, enterprise systems, scientific applications, structured data, knowledge graphs, and domain ontologies.
* Apply advanced prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool-calling, memory patterns, and context optimization techniques.
* Define safe and reliable patterns for autonomous and semi-autonomous agent execution.

### **Agent Evaluation, LLMOps & Production Excellence**

* Define automated testing and evaluation strategies for agentic and GenAI systems.
* Establish evaluation frameworks for:
  + Task completion
  + Tool-use accuracy
  + Response correctness
  + Grounding and retrieval quality
  + Safety and policy compliance
  + Robustness and recovery
  + Latency and cost
* Design regression testing for prompts, models, tools, workflows, and agent behaviors.
* Define observability standards using execution traces, agent steps, tool calls, model interactions, latency, token usage, cost, and failure metrics.
* Establish mechanisms for agent debugging, replay, inspection, and root-cause analysis.
* Define secure deployment, monitoring, governance, and operational practices for AI systems.
* Ensure production systems support reliability, scalability, disaster recovery, data protection, and compliance requirements.

### **Development Excellence**

* Actively contribute to hands-on development using **Python** and modern backend frameworks such as **FastAPI**.
* Build reference implementations and reusable platform components for the agentic harness.
* Design and build well-structured, maintainable, and extensible APIs supporting AI, agent, and data-driven workloads.
* Define service boundaries, integration contracts, data models, workflow interfaces, and event schemas.
* Implement performance, scalability, security, and observability patterns for distributed AI services.
* Guide the use of PostgreSQL, pgvector, Qdrant, event streaming, caching, and persistent workflow storage.
* Promote clean code, automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, and engineering quality standards.

### **Collaboration, Mentorship & Culture**

* Mentor and guide architects, staff engineers, and senior engineers on:
  + Agentic architecture
  + Distributed systems
  + System design
  + GenAI engineering
  + Evaluation and observability
* Influence technical direction across multiple Scrum teams and product areas.
* Lead Communities of Practice focused on agentic AI, GenAI architecture, and AI engineering excellence.
* Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders through clear documentation, architecture diagrams, design reviews, and technical presentations.
* Partner with product, security, platform, data, and engineering leadership to align agentic AI capabilities with business and scientific objectives.
* Anticipate architectural risks and opportunities and guide the organization through technology evolution.

**Candidate Requirements**
--------------------------

### **Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Master’s degree in Computer Science with **15+ years of proven industry experience**, including significant experience in software architecture, platform engineering, and technical leadership.

**Mandatory Skills, Knowledge & Experience**
--------------------------------------------

### **Core Engineering and Architecture**

* **Enterprise Architecture:** Proven experience defining architecture and technical strategy across multiple products or engineering teams.
* **Python Backend Development:** 8+ years of experience building scalable backend systems and RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI.
* **Distributed Systems:** Strong knowledge of microservices, event-driven architecture, asynchronous processing, messaging, caching, and workflow orchestration.
* **API Design & Integration:** Strong experience with API lifecycle management, authentication, authorization, service-to-service communication, and integration patterns.
* **Cloud-Native Architecture:** Experience designing scalable and resilient solutions on Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* **Version Control & CI/CD:** Proficiency with Git, automated delivery pipelines, infrastructure automation, and release management.
* **Testing & Automation:** Experience with pytest, unittest, integration testing, contract testing, and automated quality strategies.
* **Technical Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to influence architecture and engineering decisions across multiple teams without relying solely on organizational authority.

### **Agentic AI, RAG & LLMs**

* Deep hands-on experience designing and implementing **agentic AI systems and agentic harnesses**.
* Strong experience with **LangGraph**, **LangChain**, or comparable agent orchestration frameworks.
* Practical experience with:
  + Agent planning and task decomposition
  + Tool and function calling
  + Multi-agent coordination
  + Agent memory and state management
  + Human-in-the-loop workflows
  + Guardrails and policy enforcement
  + Retry, recovery, and failure handling
  + Agent execution tracing and replay
* Experience integrating LLMs using **Azure OpenAI**, **Anthropic Claude**, OpenAI-compatible APIs, and local inference platforms such as **Ollama**.
* Strong prompt engineering skills, including structured prompting, few-shot learning, prompt versioning, context management, and output validation.
* Experience implementing RAG architectures, embeddings, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, grounding, and citation patterns.
* Hands-on experience with vector databases such as **PostgreSQL with pgvector** and **Qdrant**.
* Experience with model routing, fallback strategies, token optimization, latency management, and LLM cost control.

### **Agent Evaluation, Observability & Governance**

* Experience evaluating nondeterministic AI and agentic systems in production-like environments.
* Knowledge of evaluation-driven development, golden datasets, regression testing, and quality metrics for agents.
* Experience implementing observability for prompts, model calls, tool calls, agent steps, workflow state, latency, token usage, and cost.
* Understanding of AI security, data privacy, access control, responsible AI, auditability, and governance.
* Experience with LLMOps, model gateways, prompt management, model evaluation, monitoring, and deployment governance.

### **Data Engineering & Knowledge Systems**

* Design and manage data stores and vector indexes supporting GenAI and RAG workloads using **PostgreSQL, pgvector, and Qdrant**.
* Strong data engineering skills, including ETL pipelines, data ingestion, preprocessing, metadata management, and large-scale data processing.
* Experience integrating structured data, knowledge graphs, and domain ontologies with agentic systems.
* Expertise in Pandas, NumPy, and Python data-processing libraries.

### **Ways of Working**

* 5+ years of experience working in Agile/Scrum or comparable product development environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex architecture and AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring senior engineers, architects, and technical leads.

**Nice-to-Have Skills**
-----------------------

* **Cloud Platforms:** Azure preferred, including AKS, managed identity, Azure AI services, eventing, security, and monitoring.
* **Agent Protocols:** Experience with MCP, Agent-to-Agent communication protocols, or comparable tool and agent interoperability standards.
* **Workflow Platforms:** Experience with durable workflow engines or distributed orchestration platforms.
* **LLMOps / MLOps:** Familiarity with MLflow, Kubeflow, model gateways, prompt registries, evaluation platforms, and AI governance.
* **Machine Learning Frameworks:** Exposure to scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
* **Observability:** Experience with OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, logging, monitoring, and AI-specific telemetry.
* **Code Quality:** Experience with SonarQube, static analysis, secure coding, and enterprise engineering standards.
* **Scientific or Regulated Domains:** Experience supporting scientific workflows, healthcare, laboratory, or regulated environments.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* A reusable, secure, and scalable **enterprise agentic harness** adopted by multiple product teams.
* Production-grade agents capable of reliable planning, tool use, knowledge retrieval, collaboration, and recovery.
* Standardized agent development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and governance practices.
* Measurable improvements in workflow automation, developer productivity, scientific outcomes, product capability, and customer experience.
