6582e0bc.title: Senior Forward Deployed Architect, Generative AI
6582e0bc.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It's a unique legacy of innovation that's fueled by great technology and amazing people. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Join our team and discover how you can build a lasting impact on the world.
  
  
NVIDIA is looking for a Forward Deployed Architect to provide technical leadership and strategic guidance across AI Accelerator engagements with AI Native organizations, NeoCloud Providers, and ISVs. You'll advise on architecture and integration, define what good looks like, and bring learnings back to inform the DSX product roadmap. This role is engaged when standard product capabilities are not enough and the work needs to be specialized. Curious about novel hardware before it has a playbook? Excited to define how new platforms get used at scale? Our team works alongside customers and partners on infrastructure problems no one has solved yet, helping teams adopt NVIDIA technology the right way and shaping how new AI workloads get deployed.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Cross-Account Technical Leadership. Provide architectural direction across strategic engagements where standard capabilities are not enough and advanced implementation, optimization, or integration customization is needed.
* Outcome-Focused Implementation. Help customers integrate the right components to deliver on their outcomes. Where DSX software fits, advise on adopting it the right way. Where it doesn't, help them succeed with the right alternative and bring the gap back to product and engineering.
* Hands-On Technical Leadership. Dive into complex technical challenges hands-on when needed to solve critical problems, validate architectures, or prove out solutions.
* Strategic Initiative Ownership. Lead technically demanding programs end to end, including third-party performance benchmarking across hardware and workloads.
* Pattern Identification and Knowledge Sharing. Identify common challenges and solution patterns across engagements. Share findings with internal teams and the broader AI community.
* Technical Standardization. Develop standardized approaches, reference architectures, and structured guidance rooted in patterns from successful engagements.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration. Partner with product, engineering, and other customer-facing NVIDIA teams so what we learn in the field informs internal strategy and capabilities.
* Strategic Architecture. Design technical strategies for advanced AI workloads (distributed training, large-scale inference, model and pipeline optimization, MLOps) that apply across multiple customers and partners.
* New Hardware Enablement. Help develop new infrastructure patterns and playbooks for the latest NVIDIA hardware as it lands with customers and partners.

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelors degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years in technical roles such as solutions architecture, ML engineering, technical product management, or technical consulting across multiple customers or projects. Alternatively, 5+ years of specialist-level experience working at the frontier of AI infrastructure.
* Strong technical leadership with the ability to guide teams and influence technical decisions without direct authority.
* Systems thinking with the ability to understand customer outcomes and translate them into clear technical requirements and architectures.
* Willingness to prototype, implement, validate, and troubleshoot hands-on when needed to solve critical problems or prove out approaches.
* A solid technical foundation in the technologies AI infrastructure is built on, especially Linux systems administration.
* A self-directed learner who can ramp on brand new technologies and unfamiliar technical domains independently.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical teams, executives, and multi-functional collaborators.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Solutions architecture or technical consulting background across multiple customer engagements simultaneously, with experience bringing novel AI hardware or frameworks to production with frontier AI Native organizations, hyperscalers, NeoClouds, or ISVs.
* A foundational cloud or distributed systems background built at hyperscaler scale.
* A public technical voice: blog posts, talks, open-source contributions, or reference work that shows depth and opinion.
* Hands-On Technical Expertise in one or more of: NVIDIA Stack (CUDA, NeMo, Triton, TensorRT, NIM, DGX Cloud, and the broader DSX software portfolio), Inference Systems (large-scale inference with frameworks like vLLM and SGLang, prefill-decode disaggregation, performance optimization across hardware), Training Systems (distributed training, model and pipeline optimization, open-source generative AI frameworks), Infrastructure (SLURM, Kubernetes, GPU scheduling, distributed computing frameworks, rack-scale systems, multiple CSP or NCP cloud environments), and Observability and Automation (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, GPU performance monitoring).

5b3bf46a.title: SENIOR SOLUTION DELIVERY ENGINEER
5b3bf46a.description:
**Innovation Starts With You**
Propel your career at Belden, where innovation creates possibilities—for our people, our customers, and the communities we serve. We connect people, information, and ideas to solve the world’s most complex connectivity challenges, turning curiosity into meaningful impact. Here, you’ll take on work that challenges you, supports your growth, and empowers you to shape what’s next. You’ll collaborate with global teams, gain diverse perspectives, and contribute to solutions that extend beyond our business—creating value in the world around us.
  
  
Together, we are shaping the future of digitization and paving the way for the next generation of innovation.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Senior Solution Delivery Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting secure network architectures and platform-based solutions. This includes enterprise and industrial firewall configurations, data flow and integration from field to cloud, and developing dashboards for customer-focused use cases. The role also involves creating network hardening guidelines for wired and wireless networks, testing new technologies, and troubleshooting complex security and platform integration issues.
  
  
This role reports to the Solution Delivery Manager.
  
  
You will make an impact in the following way:
  
  

* Develop and deploy network security solutions, including firewall design, configuration, and optimisation across enterprise and industrial environments.
* Prepare and maintain best-practice guidelines for network hardening and secure configurations for wired and wireless networks.
* Test and validate new security and platform solutions for enterprise and industry projects, ensuring compliance with performance, reliability, and cybersecurity standards.
* Design, implement, and troubleshoot platform solutions including data ingestion, manipulation, and integration from field devices to cloud environments.
* Provide concepts for creating dashboards and visualisation tools to present network and platform analytics for customer-specific use cases.
* Work closely with sales, solution consultants and other team members to deliver end-to-end secure solutions and support Proof-of-Concept (PoC) deployments.
* Research emerging technologies and recommend improvements to enhance platform robustness, scalability, and security.
* Document solution configurations, field reports, and technical feedback for continuous improvement.
* Provide customer and partner training on technologies, tools, and deployment best practices.
* Managing the day-to-day operations to achieve qualitative and quantitative targets at the team/staff level and to maintain overall quality standards.

What you will bring:
  
  

* Education - Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, or Computer Science Engineering (or related field).
* Experience - 5-7 years of hands-on experience in technical support, service, or after-sales in networking system solutions which include network security design, implementation, or platform for data and cloud solutions.
* Expertise - Good understanding of L2/L3 networking (TCP/IP Stack), VLANs, routing protocols. Experience with network management, monitoring, and troubleshooting tools. Solid understanding of network security concepts, VPNs, NAT, VLANs, and segmentation, along with NOC/SOC operations. Strong hands-on experience with firewall solutions.

Knowledge of data ingestion pipelines, cloud integration and APIs. Experience with Python or similar programming/scripting, dashboarding tools (Grafana, Power BI, or similar) is an advantage.
  
  

* Customers Define our Success – Results-oriented with a process mindset. Excellent interpersonal communication skills with strong ownership & should be comfortable with communication/engagement with customers and partners. The candidate should be willing to dedicate extra time and travel to meet objectives.

**Let’s Create Possibilities Together.**
Join a global community shaping the future of intelligent connectivity. At Belden, you’ll help push the boundaries of technology and write the next chapter of innovation, creating possibilities for your career, your future, and the world around you.
  
  
These statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work involved for this job. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of this job.

cc1f214f.title: Salesforce FSC Solution Architect – Banking
cc1f214f.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Salesforce FSC Solution Architect – Banking based in India.**
This is a senior technical leadership role focused on architecting sophisticated Salesforce Financial Services Cloud solutions for the banking industry.
  
  
You will define scalable, secure, and high-performance architectures that connect customer needs with robust technical execution.
  
  
The role spans data modeling, enterprise integrations, custom development, and digital banking transformation.
  
  
You will work across complex banking ecosystems, connecting Salesforce with legacy core banking platforms and third-party financial services.
  
  
A strong focus on KYC and AML requirements makes regulatory compliance an important part of the solution architecture.
  
  
You will also guide cross-functional stakeholders and evaluate emerging technologies to strengthen platform capabilities and security.
  
  
This opportunity is suited to an experienced Salesforce architect who can lead large-scale banking implementations and translate complex business requirements into practical technical solutions.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Define high-level technical architectures for Salesforce-based banking solutions, ensuring they align with business objectives, technical standards, scalability requirements, security expectations, and industry best practices.
* Design comprehensive Financial Services Cloud data models that support complex customer, account, and relationship structures commonly found within banking environments.
* Architect robust integration patterns between Salesforce, legacy core banking systems, and third-party financial services using REST and SOAP APIs to enable reliable enterprise data exchange.
* Lead the design and development of custom banking functionality using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce Flow to address specialized business requirements and customer journeys.
* Architect and implement OmniStudio solutions that simplify customer interactions, streamline internal processes, and support complex guided experiences and business logic.
* Ensure solution designs incorporate applicable Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) requirements, supporting secure and compliant financial services operations.
* Provide strategic technical and solution architecture guidance to cross-functional teams and stakeholders while evaluating emerging technologies and recommending innovations that improve platform capabilities, performance, and security.

**Requirements**

* Bring 15 to 20 years of professional experience in software architecture and enterprise technology, with substantial hands-on experience within Salesforce ecosystems and large-scale implementations.
* Demonstrate expert-level knowledge of the Salesforce Financial Services Cloud data model and the ability to apply it effectively to complex banking scenarios.
* Have proven experience architecting and delivering integrations between Salesforce, core banking platforms, and external financial data sources.
* Possess advanced development expertise with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce Flow, with the ability to design custom applications for sophisticated financial use cases.
* Have deep knowledge of REST and SOAP APIs and enterprise integration patterns, including the ability to design reliable and scalable system-to-system integrations.
* Demonstrate specialized expertise with Salesforce OmniStudio for creating guided customer experiences, streamlined workflows, and complex business logic.
* Understand financial-sector regulatory requirements, particularly KYC and AML processes, and be able to incorporate compliance considerations into solution architecture.
* Bring a strong background in Salesforce Solution and Technical Architecture, combined with the strategic communication and stakeholder-management skills required to lead complex banking technology initiatives.

**Benefits**

* Competitive compensation of ₹20–25 LPA.
* Full-time remote opportunity based in India.
* Opportunity to lead complex Salesforce Financial Services Cloud architecture initiatives within the banking domain.
* Exposure to enterprise-scale integrations, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, and emerging financial technology capabilities.
* Senior-level scope with significant influence over solution architecture, technical strategy, security, and platform innovation.

**How Jobgether Works**

**AI-powered matching process**
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
  
  
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
  
  
Why Apply Through Jobgether?

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). **About IDrive**

IDrive is a leading provider of secure and scalable cloud backup, S3-compatible object storage, and remote access solutions. Trusted by over 5 million users worldwide, we empower individuals and businesses to protect, access, and manage their data with high-performance tools built for speed, reliability, and security.

**RemotePC** is a secure remote access platform that enables real-time connectivity to computers and servers across distributed locations. Supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, and web browsers, it allows users to remotely control systems, transfer files, and provide IT support. Trusted by businesses worldwide, RemotePC delivers encrypted, reliable remote access for productivity and secure operations.

  

**About the Job**

As a **Technical Architect - Remote Access Solutions**, you will lead the architecture and technical direction of our next-generation remote connectivity platforms. This role requires deep expertise in secure remote access technologies, distributed systems, and high-performance networking.

You will work closely with product, engineering, security, and DevOps teams to design and build scalable remote access platforms that enable secure connectivity across devices and environments. Your architectural decisions will directly influence the reliability, performance, and security of products used by millions of customers globally.

  

**What you will be doing:**

Architecture & System Design

* Lead the architectural design for remote access platforms including secure remote desktop solutions, VPN alternatives, zero-trust access systems, and device management services.
* Architect high-availability, low-latency remote access infrastructure capable of supporting global deployments across cloud and on-prem environments.
* Design and guide the implementation of distributed microservices-based systems that handle authentication, session management, connectivity, and device orchestration at scale.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies in remote access, networking, virtualization, and cybersecurity to drive innovation in our platform.

Remote Access & Connectivity Technologies

* Architect systems leveraging modern remote desktop and media streaming technologies, including GPU acceleration and efficient video encoding.
* Design systems using image processing pipelines and hardware acceleration technologies supporting video codecs such as H.264 and H.265 for high-performance remote rendering.
* Design resilient networking layers using TCP/IP, UDP, NAT traversal, relay servers, and firewall-friendly communication mechanisms.
* Optimize remote session performance, bandwidth usage, latency, and reliability across geographically distributed users.

Security & Compliance

* Define best practices for authentication, authorization, encryption, and identity management across remote access systems.
* Architect solutions aligned with zero-trust principles and modern enterprise security standards.
* Ensure secure data transmission and storage through encryption, secure key management, and robust access control mechanisms.
* Ensure adherence to industry standards, security frameworks, and regulatory compliance requirements.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

* Lead architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision-making across engineering teams.
* Provide technical mentorship to senior engineers and development teams, guiding best practices in scalable architecture and system design.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Security, and DevOps teams to translate product requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Drive long-term architectural vision for remote access platforms and ensure alignment with product roadmaps and business goals.

  

**What we expect from you:**

* 10 to 15 years of experience in software development and system architecture with significant exposure to remote access technologies.
* Strong understanding of remote desktop technologies, connectivity frameworks, and secure remote access architectures.
* Solid knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, NAT traversal techniques, firewall behavior, and real-time communication protocols.
* Experience designing highly scalable distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proficiency in one or more system-level or backend programming languages such as C++, C# (.NET), or Go.
* Proven experience leading architectural initiatives, design reviews, and large-scale system design.
* Excellent analytical thinking and ability to solve complex technical challenges.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to clearly articulate architecture decisions and collaborate across teams.
* Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Information Science, or a related field.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience working in product-based companies in remote access, virtualization, or cybersecurity domains.
* Exposure to endpoint security, device management, or enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Experience designing and optimizing systems that require real-time performance and minimal latency.
* Prior experience serving as a Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, or Technical Architect.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic thinking and architectural vision
* Strong stakeholder communication
* Decision-making and technical ownership
* Mentoring and team leadership
* Innovation mindset and technology leadership

  

**Why join us?**

At IDrive, you will work with backup, storage, virtualization, and remote access technologies, contributing to products like RemotePC, our widely used secure remote access platform. You will collaborate with experienced engineers, ship features used at scale, and help architect systems powering products trusted by millions of users and businesses worldwide.

As the platform evolves, you will have the opportunity to influence product architecture, mentor engineering teams, and drive innovation in secure remote connectivity and remote work infrastructure through RemotePC.

  
  

Startup spirit

* Dynamic work culture where ideas are encouraged and innovation is celebrated
* Opportunity to take ownership of large-scale architectural initiatives

* Direct impact — design systems used globally

ef22c9bc.description:
Position Description
  
  
Company Profile:
  
  
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
  
  
Position: Manager Consulting Delivery- Technical Program Manager- DevOps-Cloud Platform Engineering
  
  
Experience: 12+Years
  
  
Category: Software Development/ Engineering
  
  
Shift: General Shift (Flexibility required for global stakeholder engagements)
  
  
Location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Pune/Mumbai
  
  
Position ID: J1026-0343
  
  
Employment Type: Full Time
  
  
Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 12 years of relevant experience.
  
  
Technical Program Manager accountable for delivering the CCOE transformation program: an Operations Control Plane and SaaS operating model for CGI Advantage, serving 50+ State & Local Government clients. The role is AI-first by mandate: the TPM is expected to design, prove, and scale AI-assisted operations across the program. It combines hands-on technical credibility — someone who still builds, prototypes, and reviews code — with large-scale program leadership across engineering, operations, and executive stakeholders, and a demonstrated bias for speed and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Your future duties and responsibilities
  
  

* Plan and run PI cadences: scope, dependencies, capacity, exit criteria, and transparent re-planning across all CCOE workstreams.
* Drive wave-based rollouts (e.g., observability across multi-tenant AKS estates) within client change windows and government compliance constraints.
* Build funding and business cases spanning multiple internal organizations; force decisions through steering with stated cost of delay.
* Referee build-vs-buy and competing-architecture decisions against written criteria; time-box debates and document decisions with revisit conditions.
* Lead vendor evaluation and enterprise contract negotiation for platform tooling — pricing, support SLAs, security and compliance terms.
* Report program outcomes without spin: MTTR, escalation rate, automation coverage, and SLA adherence.
* Partner with operations leadership on workforce transition: reskilling, redeployment, and adoption of new tooling and workflows — including AI literacy and safe, governed use of AI tooling.
* Own the AI roadmap for operations: LLM-assisted triage, RAG over runbooks, tickets, and telemetry, agentic remediation, and AI-assisted engineering workflows — from prototype through production with evaluation, guardrails, and cost controls.
* Define AI governance with security and compliance: data residency, PII handling, prompt and output logging, human-in-the-loop gates, and model/version change control for government clients.
* Drive urgency through time-boxed delivery: bias to 2–4 week proof points, kill or scale decisions on evidence, and visible burn-down of the riskiest unknowns first.

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
Must to Have Skills:
  
  

* Azure platform depth (primary cloud): AKS at multi-tenant production scale, Azure networking (VNet, Private Link, Front Door, App Gateway), Entra ID, Azure Policy and landing-zone/Well-Architected design, autoscaling, tenancy isolation, and cost management (FinOps, reservations, tagging, chargeback).
* Azure services breadth: Azure Monitor and Log Analytics (KQL), Managed Grafana, Key Vault, Storage, API Management, Functions and Container Apps, Service Bus/Event Hubs, Azure SQL, and DevOps/GitHub integration.
* Observability: Understanding of OpenTelemetry-based stacks (traces, logs, metrics), sampling and retention economics, and alert tuning at scale.
* CI/CD and GitOps: Understanding of GitHub Actions, Argo CD, incremental builds, and policy-as-code gates (OPA, Kyverno, Conftest) with container signing and scanning.
* Infrastructure-as-code and configuration management: Terraform/OpenTofu, Ansible, and configuration-in Git with drift detection.
* Identity and security: Understanding of SSO, RBAC, and JIT access patterns (Entra ID, Keycloak); secrets and certificate lifecycle automation (Key Vault, cert-manager, ACME).
* AI and GenAI fundamentals: LLM capabilities and limits, prompt engineering, context engineering, structured output and function/tool calling, fine-tuning vs. prompting trade-offs, token and inference cost management, and latency/quality trade-offs.
* RAG and knowledge systems: chunking and embedding strategies, vector and hybrid search (Azure AI Search, pgvector, or equivalent), re-ranking, grounding and citation, retrieval evaluation, and mitigation of hallucination and data leakage.
* Agentic and AI-assisted operations: multi-step agents and orchestration frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent), Model Context Protocol (MCP) style tool integration, and evaluation and observability of AI systems (eval harnesses, golden datasets, tracing, drift monitoring).
* Understanding of Azure AI stack: Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, model deployment and quota management, private networking for AI endpoints, content safety, and responsible-AI controls.
* Hands-on engineering ability: comfortable in Python (and/or Go or TypeScript), Git-based workflows, SQL/KQL, and shipping working prototypes without waiting for a team to be assigned.
* Program tooling fluency: PI and agile planning at scale, RICE or equivalent prioritization, and dependency and risk management.

Good-to-Have Skills:
  
  

* 12+ years in technology, including 5+ years running multi-team technical programs (8–15 initiatives) as a TechPM, program lead, or platform delivery lead.
* Operations transformation: moving support and operations organizations from reactive firefighting to problem management and SRE practices.
* FOSS-biased platform strategy with explicit commercial buy triggers; hands-on vendor MSA negotiation.
* Developer platform delivery (e.g., Backstage) and production delivery of AI-assisted operations — LLM assisted triage, RAG-backed knowledge and runbook assistants, and self-healing workflows with measured deflection.
* Azure certifications or equivalent demonstrated depth (e.g., AZ-305 Solutions Architect, AZ-400 DevOps Engineer, AI-102 Azure AI Engineer).
* Active hands-on builder — personal projects, open-source contributions, or side builds using AI tooling; genuinely passionate about development and fast iteration.
* Presenting to executive leadership: funding asks, program reviews, and candid at-risk status narratives.

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  
  
That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
  
  
Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

b19b7c04.title: Hardware Engineering Program Manager
b19b7c04.description:
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.

This role leads integrated new product introduction (NPI) programs for complex hardware platforms from architecture through production release. Working across Hardware Engineering, Firmware, Software, FPGA, Systems, Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and external partners, the role drives cross-functional execution, technical risk management, compliance, and production readiness. The position combines strong program leadership with hands-on hardware understanding to resolve issues, manage phase gates, and maintain alignment across engineering and operational teams. This work enables Gigamon to deliver reliable, compliant, high-performance networking and security products on schedule.

### **What you’ll do:**

* Own the integrated NPI program plan, including milestones, critical path, dependencies, resources, risks, issues, decisions, and phase-gate readiness from architecture through production release.
* Drive engineering validation test (EVT), design validation test (DVT), production validation test (PVT), pilot production, and mass-production readiness, including entry and exit criteria, build plans, go/no-go reviews, recovery plans, and executive reporting.
* Coordinate board spins, rework, engineering changes, defect triage, root-cause analysis, retesting, and closure of critical hardware issues.
* Serve as the primary liaison across Hardware Engineering, Firmware, Software, FPGA, Systems, Mechanical, Thermal, Reliability, Quality, Manufacturing, Product Management, Supply Chain, and Product Operations.
* Lead requirements reviews, integration reviews, technical risk reviews, supplier checkpoints, build-readiness reviews, phase gates, and leadership updates.
* Manage JDM and OEM partners, contract manufacturers, PCB assembly suppliers, component suppliers, test laboratories, and other external technology providers.
* Track BOM and AVL readiness, long-lead components, capacity, tooling, manufacturing test, DFM/DFA, design-for-test, yield, quality issues, corrective actions, and production ramp readiness.
* Manage external hardware vendors, technical service agreements, tool subscriptions, certification vendors, and license renewals.
* Drive configuration management and controlled change processes for schematics, PCB layouts, FPGA releases, BOMs, mechanical drawings, firmware, test procedures, manufacturing documentation, and released products.
* Provide concise status reporting on milestone health, critical path, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, compliance status, and recovery actions.
* Own the hardware compliance plan, certification schedule, regulatory dependencies, and release evidence for applicable markets.
* Coordinate pre-compliance assessments, formal testing, test-house activities, failure analysis, retesting, corrective actions, declarations of conformity, regulatory marks, certificates, and technical documentation.
* Maintain traceability between compliance requirements, design evidence, test results, deviations, waivers, certification decisions, and engineering changes.
* Assess the compliance and certification impact of PCB revisions, component substitutions, enclosure changes, firmware updates, and manufacturing-site changes.
* Partner with Product Security and Engineering on applicable hardware security requirements, including secure boot, root of trust, key storage, debug-port controls, component provenance, and SBOM inputs.
* Apply knowledge of applicable EMI/EMC, product safety, environmental, and materials compliance requirements throughout the product lifecycle.

### **What you’ve done:**

* Earned a bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent hardware or engineering program management experience may be considered.
* Built significant experience managing complex hardware development programs, preferably for networking, telecommunications, cloud infrastructure, or security products.
* Demonstrated understanding of the complete hardware lifecycle, including architecture, schematic and PCB development, FPGA verification, prototype builds, board bring-up, system integration, qualification, certification, production ramp, and sustaining engineering.
* Gained hands-on hardware lab experience troubleshooting boards and systems with engineering teams and driving issue resolution from observed data.
* Brought up at least one PCB or complex hardware platform from initial power-on through functional validation.
* Developed working knowledge of high-speed interfaces, power delivery, signal integrity, thermal management, chassis design, manufacturing test, reliability, and system validation.
* Coordinated EMI/EMC testing, product safety evaluations, environmental qualification, reliability testing, and regulatory certification.
* Applied expert program management practices, including integrated planning, risk and issue management, dependency tracking, change control, stakeholder management, and executive communication.
* Delivered complex programs against challenging schedule, quality, cost, and performance targets in a large organization.

### **Who you are:**

* A technically grounded program leader who can connect engineering details with business and product outcomes.
* A collaborative partner who builds alignment across cross-functional teams, suppliers, manufacturing organizations, and executive stakeholders.
* An effective influencer who leads teams without direct authority and drives accountability through clear decisions, ownership, and follow-through.
* A structured and disciplined operator who maintains visibility into critical paths, dependencies, risks, compliance requirements, and recovery actions.
* A hands-on problem solver who is comfortable working in the hardware lab, interpreting technical data, and guiding issues to closure.
* A clear and concise communicator who can translate complex technical and program information into actionable updates for varied audiences.

Morgan and Chase brands. a35f8ec0.title: Technical Program Manager - IoT
a35f8ec0.description:
**Quin | About the Company**
Quin is a safety-technology company. Our technology ships inside products from leading global brands across motorcycling, cycling, sport and industrial PPE. We are becoming the primary source of real-world crash data across every protective gear category, and we build the data tools that manufacturers and testing bodies use to engineer safer products and standards. Our engineering and product centre is in Hyderabad, with helmet testing labs in Hyderabad and London, and teams across India, the UK and the US.
  
  
**Why this role exists**
Every Quin release can involve hardware, firmware, mobile, cloud and design, often for several products at once. We are looking for a technical delivery leader who sees the whole system, and coordinates cross-functionally efficiently. This Technical Program Manager must understand the technology well enough to challenge an estimate, read a firmware or API change and know what it breaks downstream, and be able to automate coordination wherever possible, so the team spends more time building with clarity.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Cross-functional delivery**

* Own the delivery plan across embedded, mobile, backend, web, QA and design, from requirement to release.
* Map dependencies, surface risks early and drive decisions to close them.

**Release management**

* Own release cadence and release readiness across multiple apps, firmware versions and cloud services.
* Work with QA on release sanity, regression coverage and go/no-go calls.
* Keep release notes, versioning and rollback plans clean and current.

**Escalations and clarity**

* Be the single named owner for delivery escalations. Bring leadership a clear recommendation, not just a problem.
* Give leadership one honest view of status, risk and dates, without anyone having to chase.

**Documentation and knowledge**

* Make documentation part of how work gets done: decision records, runbooks, release notes and handovers.
* Build a shared, searchable knowledge base so no system depends on human memory.
* Run it with access controls that protect confidential and product data.

**Lightweight, automated process**

* Set up planning, estimation and tracking that is lean and useful.
* Use automation to cut down status meetings, manual reporting and copy-paste work.
* Support team growth, and champion initiatives to ensure people and achievements are celebrated at Quin.

**Must-haves**

* 5+ years in software or hardware engineering delivery, with 2+ as a TPM or delivery lead for connected products.
* An engineering background, or equivalent hands-on depth. You can hold your own in an architecture review.
* Shipped products that span at least two of: firmware/embedded, mobile apps, cloud backend.
* Release management across multiple products or customers at once.
* Strong written communication skills, without AI polish. Your docs and updates are short, clear and trusted.
* You use AI tools daily to plan, track, write and automate, but can work without it.

**Strong pluses**

* IoT, BLE devices, wearables or consumer hardware launches.
* Able to excel in fast-paced, high ownership environment.
* Built documentation or knowledge-management systems that people used.
* Experience with test automation, CI/CD and release pipelines.

**How We Work**
We are a small team of senior doers. We hire people who move fast and own their work, not people who manage others to do the work. You will own delivery outcomes, not just track them.
  
  
**Our hiring process & AI use**
Use AI tools freely on any exercise. The only rule:
**declare what you used and be ready to defend every decision live.**
The recruitment process will involve at least 2 interviews, and 1 assignment and live debrief.
